15. 倡议书——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
参考答案
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．Embracing the Magic of Print Media
As the digital revolution sweeps through our lives, the appeal of screens and the convenience of online content have quietly caused print media to lose its charm. Peeking into our library, we’ll see newspapers gathering dust, like long-forgotten friends. 
However, print media offers a unique reading experience. It encourages a slower and more reflective reading process, allowing readers to digest information more thoroughly. Besides, it endows readers with the feel of the pages, the ink smell, and the freedom to flip through pages at our own pace, which offers us an escape into another world and a deeper dive into knowledge.
So, let’s bring back the joy of turning pages! Together, we can foster a culture of curiosity and lifelong learning that surpasses digital screens.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生假定是校英语报主编李华，你发现随着信息技术的发展，高中生阅读纸质媒体的热情在逐步减少，请你写一篇英语短文，呼吁学生重拾对纸质阅读的热情。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
吸引力：appeal→attraction
培养：foster→develop
快乐：joy→happiness
此外：besides→in addition
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：However, print media offers a unique reading experience. It encourages a slower and more reflective reading process, allowing readers to digest information more thoroughly.
拓展句：However, print media offers a unique reading experience, which encourages a slower and more reflective reading process, allowing readers to digest information more thoroughly.
【点睛】
[高分句型1] As the digital revolution sweeps through our lives, the appeal of screens and the convenience of online content have quietly caused print media to lose its charm. (运用了as引导时间状语从句)
[高分句型2] Besides, it endows readers with the feel of the pages, the ink smell, and the freedom to flip through pages at our own pace, which offers us an escape into another world and a deeper dive into knowledge. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)
2．Regular Exercise, Energetic Life
It goes without saying that physical education is of great benefit to our heath. However, as far as I am concerned, the situation is not so optimistic in our school. Many a student tends to skip PE classes and chooses to stay in the classroom, which is unacceptable. 
As we all know, exercising on a regular basis can energize our body, so that our learning efficiency can be improved. Additionally, exercising makes us energetic, helping us avoid being sleepy in class and keep away from certain diseases. Lastly, by overcoming difficulties during exercise, we can be stronger both physically and mentally, and more willing to accept challenges. 
Let’s engage ourselves in sports! Make a change now, and you will become better in the future.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生就你校体育部计划与学习部合办主题为“体育与健康”的英语征文比赛写一篇短文投稿，内容包括：1．学生参与体育运动的情况；2．体育运动的重要性；3．提出倡议。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
很有益的： of great benefit→very beneficial
定期地：on a regular basis→regularly
此外：Additionally→In addition
远离：keep away from→stay away from
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Additionally, exercising makes us energetic, helping us avoid being sleepy in class and keep away from certain diseases.
拓展句：Additionally, exercising makes us energetic, which helps us avoid being sleepy in class and keep away from certain diseases.
【点睛】
[高分句型1] Many a student tends to skip PE classes and chooses to stay in the classroom, which is unacceptable.(运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2]As we all know, exercising on a regular basis can energize our body, so that our learning efficiency can be improved. (运用了as引导的非限制性定语从和so that引导的目的状语从句)
3．Dear fellow students,
I am head of the School Environmental Protection Club. Our club is dedicated to promoting sustainable practices and raising the awareness of environmental protection.
The use of plastics on our campus has reached alarming levels, leading to significant environmental consequences. Single-use plastic items, such as water bottles, food containers, and plastic bags, are widely used and thrown away, contributing to pollution and waste.
To address this issue, I would like to propose two concrete measures. First, we suggest using a waste sorting system, which will encourage students to separate plastic waste from other trash. In addition, it’s recommended that reusable and eco-friendly shopping bags should be provided in school stores and canteens, thereby reducing the demand for plastic bags.
In the light of the above, we kindly request your support and attention to this matter. Let’s work together to create a more sustainable and plastic-free campus.
The School Environmental Protection Club
【导语】
本书面表达是一篇应用文写作。要求考生根据所给提示，为学校英文报纸写一封倡议书。要点如下：1. 简要介绍你所在的校园环保社团；2.指出校园塑料大量使用的情况；3. 发出减少塑料使用的倡议。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
致力于：be dedicated to→be devoted to
保护：protection→preservation
此外：in addition→besides/additionally/furthermore/moreover
提供：provide→supply
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：I am head of the School Environmental Protection Club. Our club is dedicated to promoting sustainable practices and raising the awareness of environmental protection.
拓展句：I am head of the School Environmental Protection Club, which is dedicated to promoting sustainable practices and raising the awareness of environmental protection.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
First, we suggest using a waste sorting system, which will encourage students to separate plastic waste from other trash. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】
In addition, it’s recommended that reusable and eco-friendly shopping bags should be provided in school stores and canteens, thereby reducing the demand for plastic bags. (运用了that引导的主语从句和现在分词作结果状语)
4．One possible version:
Grow Up Healthy
Good morning, everyone!
As we grow up, we are expected to lead a healthy life. However, there is a growing concern that problems like eating junk food, lacking exercise and being addicted to online games still exist among us teenagers.
To improve the present situation, I suggest that we stick to a healthy diet and regular exercise, which can work wonders for us. Besides, less exposure to electronic devices will do good to both our mental and physical health. More importantly, we should learn to look at the bright side and stay positive when facing challenges.
In conclusion, let’s take action from this very moment to grow up healthy and sound.
That’s all. Thank you.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生以Grow Up Healthy为题，写一篇发言稿参赛。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
提高：improve→enhance
除此以外：besides→in addition
对……有好处：do good to→be beneficial to
总之：in conclusion→to sum up
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：More importantly, we should learn to look at the bright side and stay positive when facing challenges.
拓展句：What’s more important is that we should learn to look at the bright side and stay positive when facing challenges.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
However, there is a growing concern that problems like eating junk food, lacking exercise and being addicted to online games still exist among us teenagers.（运用了that引导的同位语从句）
【高分句型2】
To improve the present situation, I suggest that we stick to a healthy diet and regular exercise, which can work wonders for us.（运用了that引导的宾语从句以及which 引导的非限制性定语从句）
5．Dear students,
April 23rd is World Book Day. Our school will hold a series of activities with the theme of “Read More, Read Better, and Love Reading”. As president of the English Literature Club, I call on everyone to actively participate in these activities.
Reading is of great significance. It can not only expand our knowledge, but also improve our language skills and thinking abilities. Through reading, we can explore the world, experience different lives and gain wisdom and inspiration.
The activities include book sharing, reading salons and essay competitions. These activities provide a good opportunity for us to share reading experiences, exchange ideas and show our talents. Let’s read more books, read good books, and enjoy reading. Looking forward to your participation!
Thank you!
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生用英语写一篇倡议书，号召大家积极参与校将举办的以“多读书、读好书、好读书”为主题的一系列活动。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
举行：hold→throw
参加：take part in→participate in
提高：improve→promote
获得：gain→acquire
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Our school will hold a series of activities with the theme of “Read More, Read Better, and Love Reading”.
拓展句：Our school will hold a series of activities whose theme is “Read More, Read Better, and Love Reading”..
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
Through reading, we can explore the world, experience different lives and gain wisdom and inspiration.（运用了介词短语作状语）
【高分句型2】
It can not only expand our knowledge, but also improve our language skills and thinking abilities.（运用了not only…but also连接并列谓语）

16. 书面通知——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
【写作指导+常用句型+常用模版+最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
【写作指导】
通知是上级对下级、组织对成员或平行单位之间部署工作、传达事情或召开会议等所使用的应用文。通常包括三部分内容：1.通知的内容；2.通知的时间、地点及对象；3.通知的注意事项及活动意义。通知要求言简意赅、措辞得当、时间及时。通知标题一般为NOTICE/Notice，居中。然后是正文，最后通知发布的单位或个人通常放在右下角，发布时间也放在右下角。
►书面通知三步走 引入话题→具体事项→结尾
【常用句型】
1．开头句
(1)“目的”的常用表达
in order to/aim to do sth/be aimed at doing sth/with the aim of doing sth为了……
promote one’s understanding of...提高某人对……的理解 
have a better understanding of...更好地了解……
arouse/arrest one’s interest in...引起人们对……的兴趣 
raise/increase/enhance people’s awareness of...
提高人们对……的意识 
learn more about the development of...更多地了解……的发展
make your school life colourful/add colour to your school life让你的校园生活多姿多彩
(2)“主题”的常用表达
We’ll hold...with the topic/theme of.../(which is) entitled/themed on.../whose topic/theme is...我们要举办一个主题为……的……
2．中间句
(1)“安排”的常用表达
...is scheduled/expected/due to be held in...at...将于…… (时间)在……(地点)举行……
As scheduled，...will be held in...at...按计划，将在……(地点)……(时间)举办……
...is going to be held in...at...，which is located in...将于……(时间)……(地点)举办……，该……位于……
(2)“时间”的常用表达
in May,2023在2023年5月
in May 3,2023在2023年5月3日
on Wednesday，May 3,2023 在2023年5月3日星期三
at 8：00 am on Wednesday，May 3,2023在2023年5月3日星期三的上午8点
from 8：00 am to 10：00 am on Wednesday，May 3，2023在2023年5月3日星期三的上午8点到10点
at 8：00 pm next Tuesday在下周二晚上8点
(3)“地点”的常用表达
in the meeting room 在会议室
in the lecture/school hall在报告厅/礼堂 
in the stadium在体育场 
in the teachers’ office在老师办公室 
at the school gate/on the playground在学校大门口/操场 
in Room 105在105室
(4)“对象”的常用表达
Everyone is welcome.欢迎每个人参加。
All the students are welcomed to attend...on time，especially those who...
欢迎所有的学生准时参加……，尤其是那些……
3．结尾句
(1)“注意事项”的常用表达
What’s more，you need to be informed of the following requirements.Firstly，remember to do...Secondly，you are expected to do...此外，还需要向你们告知以下要求。首先，记住做……第二，你应该做……
Participants are required to...要求参加者……
You’re required to bring...so that you can...你需要携带……，这样你才能……
(2)“活动意义”的常用表达
It offers us a chance to...它给我们提供了一个机会去……
The activity will provide a good platform for promoting...这项活动将提供一个促进……良好的平台。
【常用模版】
STUDENTS UNION(发布通知的单位、组织名称)
Sep 22, 2019(发布日期。如果没给可不写)
Notice
      ,(称呼)
We are very happy to announce that      .(通知的事情) Now please let me inform you about some important things.      .(语句一)      .(语句二). You are welcome to take part in it.      .(语句三) I believe you will have a wonderful time.
We are looking forward to your joining us.
      (署名)
      (日期)
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．（2024·湖南永州·三模）假定你是校学生会主席李华，国际五一劳动节即将来临，学校摄影俱乐部将举办以“最美劳动者”为主题的短视频作品大赛。请你写一则比赛通知张贴到校国际部，内容包括：
1. 作品要求；
2. 作品提交的截止日期和地点。
参考词汇：短视频大赛 short video competition
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Notice
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The Student Union
2．（2024·山东·二模）假定你是某国际学校文艺部部长李华，学校决定在校园文化节上举办“学生唐装秀”活动，现征召模特。请你写一则通知，内容包括：
1.活动目的；
2.对模特的要求。
注意：
1.写作词数应为80个左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Models Wanted
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Literature & Art Department
3．（2024·全国·模拟预测）你校英文报计划下周日举办主题为“绿色出行”的英语演讲比赛，请你写一则活动通知。内容包括: 
1. 介绍活动目的; 
2. 说明参赛要求。
注意: 
1. 写作词数应为80左右; 
2. 请按如下格式作答。
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
4．（2024·青海·二模）你校英文报计划举办主题为“志愿服务，互帮互助(Volunteer to help each other)”的征文活动。请你写一则活动通知，内容包括：
1.介绍活动目的；
2.说明参加要求。
注意：
1.词数100左右；
2.题目己为你写好。
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．（2024·河北邯郸·三模）假定你是李华，你校英文报Youth拟组织一场以“Wildlife Protection”为主题的摄影展，请你写一份通知，发布在校英文报上，内容包括：
1. 活动目的；2. 作品要求；3. 交稿时间。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Notice
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

16. 书面通知——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
参考答案
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．Notice
With the International Labor’s Day approaching, a short video competition will be held in our school to celebrate the festival in a novel way. The title of the competition is the most beautiful worker. 
To participate, you are expected to prepare your short video entries which must be focused on the theme, showing examples of diligent and inspiring works, whether it’s in a factory, farm, office, of any other workplace. Videos should be accompanied by a brief description explaining the inspiration and story behind the video. All videos submissions must be received by July 30 th, 2024 to the School Photography Club office.
Don’t hesitate to take part! Waiting for your talent!
【导语】
本篇书面表达为一篇应用文。要求学生写一则通知，通知学生随着国际五一劳动节即将来临，学校摄影俱乐部将举办以“最美劳动者”为主题的短视频作品大赛这件事。
【解析】
1.词汇积累：
临近：approach→come/around the corner
参加：participate→take part/be involved/be engaged
犹豫：hesitate→be uncertain about
新颖的：novel→creative/innovative
句式拓展：
简单句变复杂句
原句：With the International Labor’s Day approaching, a short video competition will be held in our school to celebrate the festival in a novel way. The title of the competition is the most beautiful worker.
拓展句：With the International Labor’s Day approaching, a short video competition will be held in our school to celebrate the festival in a novel way, the title of the which is the most beautiful worker.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
To participate, you are expected to prepare your short video entries which must be focused on the theme, showing examples of diligent and inspiring works, whether it’s in a factory, farm, office, of any other workplace.(运用了不定式作目的状语，which引导非限制性定语从句，现在分词作状语，whether引导让步状语从句。)
【高分句型2】
Videos should be accompanied by a brief description explaining the inspiration and story behind the video.(运用了现在分词作状语。)
2．Models Wanted
Aimed to promote traditional Chinese culture and add charm to the upcoming school culture festival, a special and refreshing activity, Student Tang Costume Show, is to be included! Now we’re recruiting models for this event.
The requirements for models are as follows. First, a good figure and confident stage presence are essential. Second, participants must have a genuine love for the Tang costume, only in which case can its true charm be displayed well. Plus, being punctual for our scheduled rehearsals is also a must.
If interested, please contact the Literature & Art Department and submit your application and profile by May 16. Looking forward to everyone’s active involvement.
Literature & Art Department
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文写作中的通知。要求考生写一则通知，告知全校学生学校因在校园文化节上举办“学生唐装秀”活动，特征召模特。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
首先：first→ first of all
必要的：essential → necessary
真诚的：genuine → actually/sincere
计划好的：scheduled→ planned
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Aimed to promote traditional Chinese culture and add charm to the upcoming school culture festival, a special and refreshing activity, Student Tang Costume Show, is to be included!
拓展句：Aimed to promote traditional Chinese culture and add charm to the upcoming school culture festival, a special and refreshing activity, which is called Student Tang Costume Show, is to be included!
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
Second, participants must have a genuine love for the Tang costume, only in which case can its true charm be displayed well.（运用了which引导的定语从句）
【高分句型2】
If interested, please contact the Literature & Art Department and submit your application and profile by May 16.（运用了状语从句的省略）
3．
Notice
An English speech contest themed “Green Travel” will be held by our school English newspaper next Sunday. The activity aims to raise awareness of environmentally friendly travel modes and promote sustainable living among students. 
Participants are required to prepare a speech related to green travel, delivered in English, within 5 minutes. The speech should be original, creative, and relevant to the theme. All students are welcome to join. Please sign up at the English newspaper office before Friday. 
We hope this contest will inspire more of us to adopt green travel habits and contribute to a better environment.
【导语】
本篇是应用文写作。你校英文报计划下周日举办主题为“绿色出行”的英语演讲比赛，要求写一则活动通知。
【解析】
1. 词汇积累
比赛：contest→competition
活动：activity→event
促进：promote→develop
激励：inspire→stimulate
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：An English speech contest themed “Green Travel” will be held by our school English newspaper next Sunday.
拓展句：Our school English newspaper will be holding an English speech contest next Sunday, which is themed “Green Travel”.
【点睛】
[高分句型1]Please sign up at the English newspaper office before Friday.(祈使句型)
[高分句型2]We hope this contest will inspire more of us to adopt green travel habits and contribute to a better environment.(省略that的宾语从句)
4．参考范文：
Welcome to our essay contest!
In order to promote the spirit of volunteerism and mutual assistance among students, our school newspaper is planning to hold an English essay contest themed “Volunteer to help each other”. The purpose of this activity is to encourage students to share their volunteering experiences and inspire others to participate in community service.
All students are welcome to participate in the contest. Submissions should be in English and should reflect personal experiences or perspectives related to volunteer work. Essays should be around 500 words and submitted by April 20, 2024.
Let’s join hands and make a positive impact on our community through volunteer service.
Thank you for your attention and look forward to your active participation!
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生写一则活动通知，介绍校英文报计划举办主题为“志愿服务，互帮互助(Volunteer to help each other)”的征文活动，介绍活动目的，说明参加要求。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
为了：in order to→aim to
举办：hold→ host
影响：impact→effect
期待：look forward to→expect
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：In order to promote the spirit of volunteerism and mutual assistance among students, our school newspaper is planning to hold an English essay contest themed “Volunteer to help each other”.
拓展句：In order to promote the spirit of volunteerism and mutual assistance among students, our school newspaper is planning to hold an English essay contest whose theme is “Volunteer to help each other”.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
The purpose of this activity is to encourage students to share their volunteering experiences and inspire others to participate in community service. (运用了动词不定式作表语和补足语)
【高分句型2】
Submissions should be in English and should reflect personal experiences or perspectives related to volunteer work. (运用了过去分词短语related to作后置定语)
5．One possible version:
Notice
In order to enhance students’ consciousness of wildlife protection, our school English newspaper Youth will organize a photography exhibition with the theme of “Wildlife Protection”.
We are now soliciting photography works. The works should be related to wildlife and clearly show the beauty and importance of wildlife. They can be in color or black and white, and the format is not limited. However, they must be original and not processed by any software. The deadline for submitting works is next Friday. Please send your works to the specified email address.
We sincerely hope that every student can actively participate and show their unique perspectives on wildlife protection through their works. Let’s work together to protect these precious lives.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文写作中的通知。题目要求考生为校英文报Youth组织的以“Wildlife Protection”为主题的摄影展写一份通知。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
和……有关：be related to→be associated with
重要性：importance→significance
真诚地：sincerely→genuinely
参加：participate→take part
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：We are now soliciting photography works. The works should be related to wildlife and clearly show the beauty and importance of wildlife.
拓展句：We are now soliciting photography works, which should be related to wildlife and clearly show the beauty and importance of wildlife.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
The deadline for submitting works is next Friday.（运用了动名词短语作宾语）
【高分句型2】
We sincerely hope that every student can actively participate and show their unique perspectives on wildlife protection through their works.（运用了that引导的宾语从句）

17. 人物介绍——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
【写作指导+常用句型+常用模版+最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
【写作指导】
人物介绍的文章一般都是对所写之人的基本概况(如年龄、出生地、家庭背景、受教育情况等)作简单的概述，继而再叙述其事迹或在某个领域中做出的贡献，最后对其进行评价。
►人物介绍写作三步走 
1. 点明叙述人物；2. 叙述人物的具体情况；3. 对人物做出评价。
【常用句型】
1．开头句
(1)The person I admire most is...我最敬佩的人是……
(2)Of all the outstanding people，I admire...most.在所有杰出的人当中，我最钦佩……
(3)There are many respectable people around us.The one who I admire most is...我们周围有许多可敬的人。我最崇拜的人是……
(4)When it comes to the person who I think highly of，I would say...without hesitation.说到我高度评价的人，我会毫不犹豫地说……
2．中间句
(1)Born in...，on...，...is one of...出生在……，在……，……是……之一。
(2)Graduating from...，he worked as...毕业于……，他担任……
(3)In order to...，he made up his mind to do...为了……，他决定做……
(4)With strong will and great determination，he achieved the great success in...凭借坚强的意志和决心，他在……方面取得了巨大的成功。
(5)Despite many difficulties，he/she managed to overcome them.尽管有许多困难，他/她还是设法克服了。
(6)He/She put his/her heart into...and made great contributions to...他/她全身心投入……中去，为……做出了巨大贡献。
3．结尾句
(1)As a great...，he/she will be remembered by us forever.作为一个伟大的……，他/她将永远被我们铭记。
(2)It is his determination that inspires me to go on when I have difficulty in learning.是他的决心激励我在学习上有困难时继续前进。
(3)Having set a great example for us，he is an excellent person who fully deserves our admiration and respect.他为我们树立了一个很好的榜样，是一个非常优秀的人，完全值得我们钦佩和尊重。
(4)It’s her/his encouragement that contributes to shaping my personalities and inspires me to accomplish my goals persistently.正是她/他的鼓励，有助于塑造我的个性，激励我坚持不懈地完成目标。
(5)．..is such an respectable and admirable person that I will model myself after...and be a person like...……是一个令人尊敬和钦佩的人，我将以……为榜样，做一个像……的人。
【常用模版】
___人名_____ is a well-known figure in Chinese history. _____贡献_______ emphasized the importance of moral values，respect for elders，and social harmony. ___人名_____traveled throughout the country，__________ and __________.(引入历史人物的事迹）
The significance of __________ cannot be overstated. __________ shaped__________，__________，__________，and __________. Even today，__________ and communities in China and beyond.（介绍该历史人物的重要性）
__________ about self-cultivation，respect for elders，and the pursuit of knowledge serve as a guiding light in our fast-paced and interconnected world，which __________（介绍该历史人物的影响或做出评价）
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．（高三下·河南郑州·期末）假设你校正在组织题为“The person who inspires me”的英语征文比赛，请你写一篇短文参赛。内容包括：
1. 该人物的简单介绍；
2. 激励或鼓舞你的原因。
注意∶
1. 词数100左右；
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
The person who inspires me
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
2．（江苏连云港·期中）假定你是李华。北京冬奥会在即，请给你的外国朋友Chris写一封邮件，向他介绍一位你最喜欢的中国运动员。邮件内容包括：1.人物简介；2.喜欢的原因。
注意：1.词数80左右；2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Dear Chris,
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
3．（23-24高三上·全国·课后作业）某中学生英文报开设了“人物介绍”栏，请根据以下内容，为该栏目写一篇介绍林巧稚的英文稿件。要点如下：
1.1901年出生在福建；
2.1929年大学毕业；
3.1932年去英国进修；
4. 一生接生了五万多个婴儿；去世后将自己的财产捐赠给幼儿园。
注意:1.词数80左右；
2.可以适当增加细节,以使行文连贯。
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
4．（20-21高二上·全国·课时练习）假如你是李华，准备参加一家英文报社举办的演讲比赛，你需要写一篇演讲稿。你打算写一篇介绍马可·波罗的文章，内容包括：
人物
马可·波罗(Marco Polo)
职业
意大利著名旅行家
事件
1.于13世纪沿着古代丝绸之路来到中国；
2.在中国居住了17年，参观过很多地方，惊叹于中国的美丽和强大；
3.把中国的文化和科技发明介绍到世界其他地区。
你的评价
注意：
1.词数80左右；
2.开头和结尾已为你写好，不计入总词数；
3.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Hello, everyone,
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Thank you.
5．（23-24高三·宁夏吴忠·期末）你校《英语报刊》人物专栏正在征稿，请你用英语介绍一位你所敬佩的人物(如志愿者，体育明星，父母等)并投稿。要点如下：
1.对该人物的简单介绍：
2.敬佩该人物的理由。
注意事项：字数100左右。
We have a lot of respectable people around us.
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

17. 人物介绍——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
参考答案
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．One possible version:
The person who inspires me
Su Bingtian, the first Chinese athlete to compete in the men’s 100-meter track and field final at the Olympic Games, was one of the “People Who Moved China” in 2021.
He is my hero, who inspires me deeply. Actually, what impresses me most is his process to success as well as setting the record. Injury from practices and competitions seriously affected his career and once he even planned to retire. But it was the call to win glory for our motherland and challenge himself that brought him back. He trained harder than before and all his efforts paid off.
Learning from him, I’ll study hard, face difficulties and challenge myself bravely to contribute more to our country in the future.
【导语】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生以“The person who inspires me”为题写一篇英语征文比赛，介绍该人物并写出该人物激励自己的原因。
【详解】1.词汇积累
事实上：Actually→In fact
过程：process→course
影响：affect→influence
奉献：contribute to→dedicate to
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句： Injury from practices and competitions seriously affected his career and once he even planned to retire.
拓展句： Once he even planned to retire because injury from practices and competitions seriously affected his career.
【点睛】【高分句型1】Actually, what impresses me most is his process to success as well as setting the record. （运用了what引导的主语从句）
【高分句型2】But it was the call to win glory for our motherland and challenge himself that brought him back.（运用了强调句型）
2．Dear Chris,
With the Beijing Winter Olympics around the corner, are you also expecting your favorite athletes’ performance?
My favorite is Su Bingtian, the first athlete in China to break into the men’s 100m finals of the Olympic Games. His hard work, discipline and strength inspire me a lot. As an associate professor at Jinan University, Su is indeed expert at sports science. Isn’t it amazing?
Who is your favorite athlete? Looking forward to hearing from you.
Yours,
Li Hua
【分析】这是一篇应用文。要求考生给外国朋友Chris写信，介绍自己最喜欢的中国运动员。
【详解】1.词汇积累
即将来临：on the way→around the corner
的确：really→indeed
努力：diligence→hard work
激励，鼓励：encourage→inspire
2.句型拓展
变强调句
原句：His hard work, discipline and strength inspire me a lot.
拓展句：It is his hard work, discipline and strength that inspire me a lot.
【点睛】[高分句型1]With the Beijing Winter Olympics around the corner, are you also expecting your favorite athletes’ performance?（句中使用了with复合结构）
[高分句型2]My favorite is Su Bingtian, the first athlete in China to break into the men’s 100m finals of the Olympic Games. （使用了不定式作后置定语）
3．范文
Lin Qiaozhi, known as the “mother of ten thousand babies”, was a famous doctor who won respect from all the Chinese people.
She was born in 1901 in Fujian Province when girls seldom received an education. Facing great difficulties, Lin Qiaozhi chose to study medicine when she was 18 years old. In 1929, Lin graduated from university and realized her dream of becoming a doctor. After that, she went to England for further study in 1932. When studying abroad, she gave up the chance to stay abroad. In her life, she delivered over 50,000 babies. When she died in 1983, she left her savings to a kindergarten.
Such was Lin Qiaozhi, a woman inspiring others to make a difference.
【导语】本篇书面表达属于记叙文。某中学生英文报开设了“人物介绍”栏，请根据提纲内容，为该栏目写一篇介绍林巧稚的英文稿件。
【详解】1.词汇积累
机会：chance→opportunity
几乎不：seldom→hardly
出名的：famous→well-known
去世：die→pass away
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Such was Lin Qiaozhi, a woman inspiring others to make a difference.
拓展句：Lin Qiaozhi was so great a woman that she inspired others to make a difference.
【点睛】[高分句型1] Lin Qiaozhi, known as the “mother of ten thousand babies”, was a famous doctor who won respect from all the Chinese people. (运用了who引导定语从句)
[高分句型2] Facing great difficulties , Lin Qiaozhi chose to study medicine when she was 18 years old. (运用了when引导时间状语从句和现在分词作状语)
4．One possible version:
Hello, everyone,
Among all the foreign travellers, my favourite is Marco Polo, a famous Italian traveller who travelled along the ancient Silk Road to China in the 13th century.
He lived in China for 17 years, visiting many parts of China and was amazed to find how beautiful and powerful China was. He introduced Chinese culture and scientific inventions to other parts of the world.
In my opinion, Marco Polo was really a great traveller, whose mission was to promote the exchange of different cultures and spread the seeds of civilisation.
Thank you.
【分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一篇演讲稿，介绍马可·波罗。
【详解】1. 词汇积累
著名的：famous→well-known
惊讶的：amazed→astounded
强大的：powerful→mighty
促进：promote→accelerate
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：He lived in China for 17 years, visiting many parts of China and was amazed to find how beautiful and powerful China was.
拓展句：He lived in China for 17 years, during which time he visited many parts of China and was amazed to find how beautiful and powerful China was.
【点睛】[高分句型1] Among all the foreign travellers, my favourite is Marco Polo, a famous Italian traveller who travelled along the ancient Silk Road to China in the 13th century. (运用了who引导的限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] In my opinion, Marco Polo was really a great traveller, whose mission was to promote the exchange of different cultures and spread the seeds of civilisation. (运用了whose引导的非限制性定语从句)
5．We have a lot of respectable people around us. One of the most admirable people in my life is my mother. She is a kind and loving person who dedicates her life to taking care of her family. She always puts the needs and wants of others before her own.
My mother has always been there for me when I need her most. She is my biggest supporter and encourages me to pursue my dreams. Despite facing many personal challenges and setbacks in her own life, she continues to remain positive and optimistic.
What I admire most about my mother is her unwavering strength and resilience. She has faced many obstacles in her life but has always managed to come out on top. Her determination and perseverance are truly inspiring.
Overall, my mother is an amazing person and an incredible role model. I am blessed to have her in my life and I truly believe that the world would be a better place if there are more people like her.
【导语】本篇书面表达属于开放性作文。要求考生给用英语介绍一位自己所敬佩的人。
【详解】1.词汇积累
鼓励：encourage→inspire
追求：pursue→seek
积极的：positive→active
障碍：obstacles→barriers
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：She is my biggest supporter and encourages me to pursue my dreams. 
同义句：She is my biggest supporter who encourages me to pursue my dreams. 
【点睛】【高分句型1】She is a kind and loving person who dedicates her life to taking care of her family.(运用了关系代词who引导的定语从句以及动名词作宾语)
【高分句型2】What I admire most about my mother is her unwavering strength and resilience.(运用了连接代词what引导的主语从句)

documents.local_content:
其他类型——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
【写作指导+常用句型+常用模版+最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
口头通知
【写作指导】
►口头通知三步走 
引起注意→ 通知内容→ 邀请参加及注意事项
【常用模版】
►口头通知模板:
Boys and girls,
Attention, please! I have something important to tell you. Here’s an announcement, please listen to me!
First of all, I am glad to tell you that      .(语句一) And then,      .(语句二) After that,      .(语句三) In addition, I’d also like to remind that all the people are required to attend it on time,
That’s all. Thanks for your attention!
【常用句型】
►常用句式
开头句 --引起注意
1. Hello, everybody/ everyone.
2. Ladies and gentlemen.  Boys and girls.
3. May I have your attention, please? I have an announcement to make. 请注意，好吗？我要通知一件事情。
4. Attention, please! I have something important to tell you. 请注意！我有重要的事情要告诉你们。 
5. Be quiet. There is something important I have to tell you. 请安静，我有重要事情要告诉大家。
正文句--通知主要内容
1. There will be a party/speech/contest held by ... in the hall of the library on Saturday evening.
周六晚上，在图书馆大厅，...将会举行一场聚会/演讲/比赛。
2. In order to welcome our friends from the United States, the Students' Union will organize a party in the school hall on Saturday evening, August 15.
为了欢迎我们来自美国的朋友，学生会将会在8月15号星期六晚上组织一场聚会。
3. Our school has decided to hold an activity to ....this Sunday. 我们学校决定这周六组织...。
4. It will begin at 5 pm and last about two hours. 它将在下午5点开始，持续大约2个小时。
5. The school will arrange several buses to take us there. 学校会安排几辆公交车带我们去那里。
6. There will colourful activities then, such as singing, dancing, exchanging gifts with one another and so on. 到时会有丰富多彩的活动，比如唱歌、跳舞、互换礼物等等。
7. All the teachers and students are required to attend it. Please take your notebooks and make notes. Please listen carefully and we'll have a discussion in groups. 所有的老师和学生都被要求参加。请带上笔记本做笔记。请认真聆听，之后我们会有分组讨论。
结尾句--邀请参加+注意事项
1. Those who are interested in the activity are welcome. 欢迎对此活动感兴趣的人参加。
2. Those who want to take part in it please sign up at the Students' Union. 想要参加的人请在学生会报名。
3. Please come and join in it. Everyone is welcom to attend it. 请来参加。每个人都是受欢迎的。
4. Remember to take your hats and gloves. 记得带上你的帽子和手套。
5. Remember that we are required hats and water. 记得我们被要求带帽子和水。
6. Please come on time and don't be late.= Be sure not to be late. 请准时到来，不要迟到。
Everyone is required to be present on time. 要求大家准时出席。
7. You might as well take a camera in case you want to take some photos of the beautiful scenery. 
你不妨带个相机以防你想要给美丽的风景拍照。
8. Please pass on this message to those who are not here today. 请把这个消息告诉不在场的人。
9. I hope that you will have a nice time there. 我希望你在那里过得愉快。
10. I am sure you will have a good time there/then. 我保证你在那里/到时会过得愉快。
11. I believe you will have a wonderful time then. 我相信到时你会过得非常愉快。
12. I think you will enjoy it very much. 我想你会非常喜欢它的。
13. There's sure to be a lot of fun. Everyone is welcome. 一定会有很多的乐趣。欢迎大家。
14. Please be present on time. 请准时出席。
15. That's all. Thank you. 我说完了。谢谢！
【必背热点范文】
►通知你班美国学生参加学校为交换生举办的一次讲座。
Boys and girls, 
May I have your attention, please? I have something to tell you. 
There will be a lecture in our library, at 4:00 on Wednesday afternoon. Our history teacher Mr. Zhang will be invited to talk about Chinese traditional festivals. I'm sure you'll learn more about Chinese culture and customs.Please be present on time and you might take a notebook and a pen with you. After the lecture, you are welcome to ask questions and I'm sure Mr. Zhang will be glad to communicate with you. 
That's all. Thank you
日记
【写作指导】
►三步走 书端（星期，日期，天气等）→正文（第一人称、过去式）→感受
【常用句型】
I had an unforgettable experience in Guangzhou today
We had such a good time that we didn't realize it was very late 
From this experience, I learned that….
They were very grateful to me for my help.
They showed much gratitude to me for my help.
They appreciate my help quickly.
Seeing them go on the bus, I felt very happy.
With candles lit, we sang happy birthday out loud and clapped.
L led them to the nearby bus stop and advised them to take Bus No.20, which could take them there directly.
【常用模版】
[星期]，[日期]                                                         [天气]
Today is a sunny day. Our class went to      .(地点) Start from the beginning, we      .(总括)
In the morning,      .(语句一) In the afternoon,      .(语句二)
We had a very good time there. I will never forget the memorable day! We returned at       . (时间) and got home safely.
【必背热点范文】
►写日记，昨天你校举办了“我最喜欢的一本书”演讲比赛。
Friday  2nd May 2014                                                     Fine
Yesterday afternoon,I attended the English speech contest held by my school. The topic of it is “The book I like best”.it is “The book I like best”When I knew that the first five candidates performed very well, l felt a little worried.
At the thought of the words “I can do it”, I became calm a lot. Soon it was my turn,when I “The book I like best” is Three Days to See written by Helen Keller. From the book, realize that it would be an excellent rule to live happily each day as if we should tomorrow." my teachers and classmates cheered for me. I gained much confidence and went on to do my best.Finally I won first prize.
Be happy every day and try my best to do everything. I'll keep it in my mind and make it come true.
招领启事
【常用模版】
Found
      .(描述丢失物品的特征)
I hope to find out the owner as soon as possible, so if you are the very one, please call me at      (电话) or come to       .(地址) I will be available at       (招领时间) or you can also contact me by emailing me at       .(邮箱) Last but not least, I would like to remind you that I will only keep it until       .(截至日期)
      (单位)
      (署名)
【必背热点范文】
►招领启事，捡到了一个书包
Found
At about 5:00 p.m. on May 19, 1 found a white Adidas schoolbag on the football field when I was running there. To be specific, the bag is made of canvas, inside which you can find a Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English, an umbrella as well as a bunch of keys,
I hope to find out the owner as soon as possible, so if you are the very one, please call me at 13965899981 or come to my dormitory，Room 212, Building C, which is located to the south of our canteen. I will be available at 12:00 a. m. or afer10:30 p. m. every day or you can also contact me by emailing me at zp@ qq. com.  Last but not least, I would like to remind you that I will only keep it until June 9.
Class5, Senior3
Zhang ping
招聘启事
►【常用模版】
(职位)Wanted
      .(职位介绍) The main responsibilities of the      (职位) include        .(职位描述)
The applicant should      .(招聘要求)
If you are interested, please call     (姓名) at      (电话) for an interview.    .(报酬)
      (单位)
【必背热点范文】
►招聘启事：招聘一名留学生做英语学习顾问
English Advisor Wanted
The Student Union of our school decides to invite an international student to work as an English Study Advisor next term. The main responsibilities of the advisor include helping students to practice their oral English, answering their questions, and helping organize activities such as singing English songs, English evenings, or lectures on interesting topics.
The applicant should be a native speaker of English. Fluency in Chinese is preferred. The advisor is expected to work 4 hours per week. 
If you are interested, please call Li Hua at 13030542381 for an interview. Payment for the service will be discussed during the interview.
Student Union
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．（2024·福建泉州·模拟预测）假如你是李华，本周末国外友好学校学生将参观你校的“菜园”。菜园是学生平时种菜种花的地方。请用英文准备一篇解说词。内容包括：1. 表示欢迎；2. 相关介绍。
Hello everyone,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
2．（2024·河南三门峡·一模）假定你是李华，在某网站看到一则英语启事：外国中学生Lily想找一位中国学生帮她学习汉语，同时帮对方学习英语，请给她写一封邮件。要点如下：
1. 说明自己能力，表达合作意向；
2. 询问对方汉语水平、合作学习方式等情况。

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
3．（2024·河南濮阳·二模）假定你是李华，你校为了让学生走出校园，走进自然，传承红色文化，上周组织了全体学生赴南京参加红色教育之旅三日游研学活动。请你就此事写一篇短文发表在班级的英语角，内容包括：
1. 活动目的；

3. 你的感受。
注意：1. 写作词数应为80左右；

4．（2024·江西南昌·二模）假定你是李华，上周你参加了学校组织的消防安全演习，请你在校英文论坛发表一篇帖子，分享此次经历，内容包括：
1．活动过程；
2．个人感悟。
注意：
1．词数80左右；

5．（2024·广东深圳·模拟预测）随着科技的快速发展，人工智能产品开始走进校园。校英文网站正在就“AI and Study”这一话题发起讨论，请你在该网站上发一篇帖子，内容包括：
1.你的观点；
2.说明理由。
注意：
1.词数80左右；
2.请在答题卡的相应位置作答。
AI and Study
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
6．（23-24高三下·福建·阶段练习）假定你是李华，你班在校英语戏剧节中获得一等奖，外教James打算为此庆祝，并委托你调查同学们喜欢的方式。请你根据调查结果，给外教写一封邮件，内容包括：
1. 表达感谢；
2. 提出个人建议；
3. 说明理由。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 请在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear James,

Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
7．（23-24高一下·安徽阜阳·阶段练习）假定你是校学生会主席李华，暑假即将来临，你按计划招募一些擅长英语或其他外语的学生为来你市旅游的外国游客提供咨询服务。请就此写一则招募广告，内容包括：
1.工作内容；
2.申请条件及方式。
注意：
1.词数80左右 (题目已给出，不计入总词数)；
2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。

Volunteers Wanted

The Students’ Union

18. 其他类型——2025年高考备考英语应用文写作快速突破
参考答案
【最新真题、模拟题、联考试题】
1．One possible version:
Hello everyone,
Welcome to our school's vegetable garden! We are thrilled to have students from our friendly school abroad visiting our garden this weekend.
Our vegetable garden is a place where students come to plant and nurture a variety of vegetables and flowers. It provides a hands-on learning experience for our students, teaching them about the importance of labour. We students have put in a lot of hard work and dedication to maintain this garden, and we are excited to share the fruits of our labour with you.
We hope you enjoy exploring our vegetable garden and learning about the joys of gardening. Thank you for visiting us today!
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生用英文写一篇解说词，向国外友好学校学生介绍学校的“菜园”。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
高兴的，兴奋的：thrilled→excited/delighted
愉悦，快乐：joy → happiness/pleasure/delight
维持，维护：maintain→keep
提供：provide…for→ offer…to
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：We are thrilled to have students from our friendly school abroad visiting our garden this weekend.
拓展句：We are thrilled that students from our friendly school abroad have come to visit our garden this weekend.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
Our vegetable garden is a place where students come to plant and nurture a variety of vegetables and flowers.（运用了where引导的定语从句）
【高分句型2】
It provides a hands-on learning experience for our students, teaching them about the importance of labour.（运用了现在分词短语做状语的非谓语动词）
2．Dear Lily,
I came across your notice on a website and I would love to cooperate with you.
I’m a Chinese student who is also interested in language exchange. I am quite confident of my Chinese level and I am sure that I can help you improve your Chinese skills. I am willing to learn English from you as well.
Could you please tell me more about your Chinese level and what the best way for us to cooperate is? Do you prefer online communication, speaking practice, or written exercises? Any information you can provide would be helpful.
I look forward to hearing from you soon.
Yours,
Li Hua
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求学生给Lily写封邮件，说明自己能力，表达合作意向，询问对方汉语水平、合作学习方式等情况。
【解析】
1. 词汇积累
与……合作：cooperate with→collaborate with/work together with 
对……感兴趣：be interested in→have interest in
对……有信心：be confident of→have faith in
提供：provide→offer
2. 句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Any information you can provide would be helpful.
拓展句：It would be helpful if you can provide any information.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
I’m a Chinese student who is also interested in language exchange.(使用了who引导定语从句)
【高分句型2】
I am quite confident of my Chinese level and I am sure that I can help you improve your Chinese skills. (使用了that引导宾语从句、help sb. do…结构)
3．参考范文
The Study Tour to Nanjing
In order to let us students go out of campus, get close to nature, and experience the red culture, our school organized a three-day study tour to Nanjing last week.
During the tour, we visited some historical sites and museums to learn about Chinese history and culture. Not only did we enjoy the beautiful views in Xuanwu Lake Park, but we also rowed the boat on the lake. What’s more, we also tasted some delicious food, among which Nanjing Salted Duck impressed me most.
In my view, this study tour is meaningful, as it helps us relax and know more about Chinese culture at the same time.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。考生所在学校上周组织了全体学生赴南京参加红色教育之旅三日游研学活动。要求考生就此事写一篇短文发表在班级的英语角。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
欣赏：enjoy→appreciate
有意义的：meaningful→significative
拜访：visit→pay a visit to
帮助：help→assist
2.句式拓展
简单句变强调句
原句：During the tour, we visited some historical sites and museums to learn about Chinese history and culture.
拓展句：It is during the tour that we visited some historical sites and museums to learn about Chinese history and culture.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
In my view, this study tour is meaningful, as it helps us relax and know more about Chinese culture at the same time.（运用了as引导的原因状语从句）
【高分句型2】
Not only did we enjoy the beautiful views in Xuanwu Lake Park, but we also rowed the boat on the lake.（运用了部分倒装句）
4．     Last week I took part in a safety drill organized by our school, which left me a deep impression.
We were having a math class when suddenly the fire alarm rang. Under the guidance of our teacher, we immediately left the classroom. With my hands covering my mouth, I bent down a bit and ran downstairs quickly on our evacuation route. At last, we landed on the playground successfully. 
The drill not only raised our fire safety awareness but also offered me a real scene in case of a fire, greatly improving our survival skills. I have a firm belief that it will truly save lives in emergencies.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生在校英文论坛发表一篇帖子，分享上周参加的学校组织的消防安全演习活动，说明活动过程和个人感悟。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
参加：take part in → participate in
立即：immediately → instantly
快速地：quickly →fast
提高/加强：improve → strengthen
2.句式拓展
变倒装句
原句：The drill not only raised our fire safety awareness but also offered me a real scene in case of a fire, greatly improving our survival skills.
拓展句：Not only did the drill raise our fire safety awareness but it also offered me a real scene in case of a fire, greatly improving our survival skills.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
Last week I took part in a safety drill organized by our school, which left me a deep impression.（运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句）
【高分句型2】
We were having a math class when suddenly the fire alarm rang.（运用了when引导的时间状语从句）
5．范文
AI and Study
In my opinion, the integration of AI into the academic sphere is a welcome development. 
Firstly, AI-powered tools like smart assistants and learning platforms can personalize learning experiences, catering to each student's unique needs and abilities. Secondly, AI's data-driven insights help teachers track progress and identify areas for improvement, enhancing teaching effectiveness. However, it's crucial to strike a balance, ensuring AI complements rather than replaces human interaction in the learning process. 
Overall, AI has the potential to revolutionize education, making it more accessible, efficient, and tailored to individual learners.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生就“AI and Study”这一话题写一篇帖子。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
在我看来：in my opinion→as far as I can see
重要：crucial→vital
提高：enhance→strengthen
满足：cater→satisfy
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Firstly, AI-powered tools like smart assistants and learning platforms can personalize learning experiences, catering to each student's unique needs and abilities.
拓展句：Firstly, AI-powered tools like smart assistants and learning platforms can personalize learning experiences because it can cater to each student's unique needs and abilities.
【点睛】
[高分句型1] However, it's crucial to strike a balance, ensuring AI complements rather than replaces human interaction in the learning process. (运用了现在分词作伴随状语)
[高分句型2] Overall, AI has the potential to revolutionize education, making it more accessible, efficient, and tailored to individual learners. (运用了现在分词作状语)
6．Dear James,
I hope this email finds you well. We are grateful for your enthusiasm in celebrating our class winning the first prize at the English Drama Festival. Your support means a lot to us!
Based on the survey I conducted, 88% of us are enthusiastic about a weekend outing, while 59% favour an English movie night, followed by 32% who prefer a food party. My preference is in line with the majority, so I suggest a hiking trip along the nearby greenway, which has lively plants and stunning views. Such an outing is perfect for us to take a break from study routines, strengthen friendship and make our success more memorable.
Thanks again for your thoughtful gesture. Looking forward to our exciting celebration!                                     
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生给外教写一封邮件，陈述你的调查结果，向他表达感谢，提出个人建议并说明理由。
【解析】
1. 词汇积累
感谢的：grateful→thankful
对……感兴趣：be enthusiastic about→be interested in
与……一致：be in line with→be consistent with
建议：suggest→recommend
贴心的：thoughtful→considerate
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：We are grateful for your enthusiasm in celebrating our class winning the first prize at the English Drama Festival.
拓展句：We are grateful that you are enthusiastic in celebrating our class winning the first prize at the English Drama Festival.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
Based on the survey I conducted, 88% of us are enthusiastic about a weekend outing, while 59% favour an English movie night, followed by 32% who prefer a food party. (运用了省略关系词的定语从句、while连接表示对比的句子、过去分词作状语、who引导定语从句)
【高分句型2】
My preference is in line with the majority, so I suggest a hiking trip along the nearby greenway, which has lively plants and stunning views. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)
7．Volunteers Wanted
Do you want to improve your language skills by doing something meaningful? If so, here is a great opportunity for you. Aiming to provide counselling services for the foreign tourists visiting our city during the summer vacation, our school is recruiting some volunteers.
As for the requirements, you must be fluent in at least one foreign language, which allows you to better communicate with the foreigners. Besides, you should have a good knowledge of some popular tourist attractions in our city or be familiar with the map of our city. If you are interested and meet the requirements, please send your application to lihua@126.com before Jul y 10th.
Looking forward to your joining.
The Students’ Union
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生写一则招募广告。招募一些擅长英语或其他外语的学生为来你市旅游的外国游客提供咨询服务。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
有意义的：meaningful →significant
机会：opportunity→ chance
为了：Aiming to →In order to
允许：allow→ permit
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Aiming to provide counselling services for the foreign tourists visiting our city during the summer vacation, our school is recruiting some volunteers.
拓展句：Our school is recruiting some volunteers in order that we can provide counselling services for the foreign tourists visiting our city during the summer vacation.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】
If so, here is a great opportunity for you. (使用了省略句)
【高分句型2】
As for the requirements, you must be fluent in at least one foreign language, which allows you to better communicate with the foreigners (使用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
8．范文
An English Teacher Wanted
Are you passionate about teaching English in China? Are you willing to devote yourself to helping those students who are struggling in learning English? If so, here is a wonderful chance.
Our school’s English club is seeking a native English speaker who is qualified for teaching. You need to be a patient person who loves children. Moreover, you are required to be proficient in singing and dancing. Teaching experience will be a priority. The pay is ¥10,000 per month, with free accommodation and free lunch offered. The deadline is February 15.
Want further information? Please contact us at 0551-39408988 or send an email to englishclub@163.com.
【导语】
本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生写一则招聘启事，发表在某英语网站上。
【解析】
1.词汇积累
奉献：devote oneself to→commit oneself to
提供：offer→supply
喜爱：love→be fond of
胜任：be qualified for→be competent for
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：You need to be a patient person who loves children.
拓展句：If you are patient and love children, you are the right person.
【点睛】
[高分句型1] Are you willing to devote yourself to helping those students who are struggling in learning English? (运用了who引导定语从句)
[高分句型2] Please contact us at 0551-39408988 or send an email to englishclub@163.com. (运用了肯定祈使句)

建议信
【试题探究】
(2023· 新高考Ⅰ卷)
　　假定你是李华, 外教Ryan准备将学生随机分为两人一组, 让大家课后练习口语, 你认为这样分组存在问题。请你给外教写一封邮件, 内容包括: 
　　1. 说明问题; 
　　2. 提出建议。
Step 1:  审题布局
类 型
建议信
人 称
第三人称
时 态
一般现在时
要 点
1. 随机分组的弊端1
2. 随机分组的弊端2
3. 我的口语分组建议1
4. 我的口语分组建议2
Step 2:  巧饰亮点
要点1:  首先, 随机配对的学生可能会导致小组内的语言能力不平衡。

 By focusing on age, employers might miss out on talented individuals who don’t fit within the required age range. Instead, I believe job advertisements should focus on skills, qualifications, and experience.
 I suggest that you discuss this issue in your newspaper. Encouraging businesses to prioritize capabilities over age can make our local job market fairer.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生以李华的身份，给当地英文报写一封邮件，对招聘广告中的年龄限制现象提出看法和建议。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累 
不合适的：inappropriate→unsuitable 
问题：issue→problem 
建议：suggest→advise
集中于：focus on→ concentrate on
2. 句式拓展 
同义句转换
原句：I suggest that you discuss this issue in your newspaper. 
拓展句：It is suggested that this issue be discussed in your newspaper.
【高分句型1】By focusing on age, employers might miss out on talented individuals who don’t fit within the required age range. (运用了who引导的限制性定语从句) 
【高分句型2】These age limits may also be seen as discriminatory, potentially leading to negative attitudes towards these companies. (运用了现在分词作结果状语)
【高分句型3】Encouraging businesses to prioritize capabilities over age can make our local job market fairer. (运用了动名词作主语)
10．Dear Alice,
I am worried to know that you should be so addicted to TikTok these days. Playing with TikTok too much is bad for your health. Besides, if you spend so much time on it, I’m afraid you will fall behind your classmates sooner or later.
In my opinion, you should find something interesting to do if you want to relax. For example, take a walk on the playground with your friends. Alternatively, you can chat with your classmates, which will cheer you up. It doesn’t mean that TikTok should be completely refused in our life, but playing too much will surely affect our study.
I know you have a strong will and you are clever. I believe you can get rid of this bad habit quite soon.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给Alice写一封电子邮件，因为她最近沉迷于抖音，你非常担心她。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
担心：worried→concerned
沉迷于：be addicted to→be obsessed with
例如：for example→for instance
此外：besides→in addition
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：I know you have a strong will and you are clever. I believe you can get rid of this bad habit quite soon.
拓展句：Because I know you have a strong will and you are clever, I believe you can get rid of this bad habit quite soon.
[高分句型1] I am worried to know that you should be so addicted to TikTok these days. (运用了that引导宾语从句)
[高分句型2] Alternatively, you can chat with your classmates, which will cheer you up. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)

邀请信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 你校将举办外国人汉语演讲比赛。请给你的英国朋友George写一封信邀请他参加, 内容包括: 
　　1. 比赛时间和地点; 
　　2. 演讲主题; 
　　3. 报名方式。
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称(I)为主, 第二人称(you)为辅
时态
一般现在时, 一般将来时
要点
1. 点明写信目的、比赛时间和地点
2. 此次活动的主题并邀请他参加此次活动
3. 再一次真诚地邀请
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  很荣幸邀请你参加下周六在我校举办的外国人汉语演讲比赛。
一般表达: 
I am honored to invite you to take part in the Chinese Speech Contest for foreigners at my school next Saturday. 
词汇或句式升级(高级词汇)
It is a great privilege for me to invite you to participate in the Chinese Speech Contest for foreigners at my school next Saturday. 
要点2: 你的演讲会给听众留下深刻的印象。
一般表达: 
 Your speech will leave a deep impression on the listeners. 
升级表达(丰富内容, 双重否定)
无疑, 你流利的汉语、精湛的公共演讲技能以及非常广博的知识会给听众留下很深的印象并激励他们。
Undoubtedly, your fluent Chinese, excellent public speaking skills, and especially extensive knowledge will not fail to impress and inspire the audience. 
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear George, 
　　It is a great privilege for me to invite you to participate in the Chinese Speech Contest for foreigners at my school next Saturday. 
　　The theme of the upcoming speech contest is British culture which we sincerely expect to listen to from a native of Britain. Undoubtedly, your fluent Chinese, excellent public speaking skills, and especially extensive knowledge will not fail to impress and inspire the audience. If you accept our invitation, we will be more than pleased to welcome you to register at the Student Organization Office. 
　　We are looking forward to your participation. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明活动, 发出邀请
①I’d like to invite you to attend the Chinese Excellent Calligraphy Show and admire the great works with me. 
我想邀请你参加中国优秀书法展, 和我一起欣赏这些优秀的作品。
②Knowing you are very interested in Chinese history and culture, I’m more than pleased to invite you to visit Suzhou Gardens with me. 
得知你对中国历史和文化很感兴趣, 我很高兴地邀请你和我一起到苏州园林游玩。
2. 篇中——详细描述, 讲清细节, 表达好处
①Here are arrangements for the activity. 
The following are arrangements for the activity. 
Arrangements for the activity are as follows. 
活动安排如下。
②There will be various activities, including short drama performances, playing musical instruments, as well as other wonderful shows. 
将会有各种各样的活动, 包括短剧表演, 乐器演奏和其他精彩的表演。
③This is such a golden chance to experience traditional Chinese culture that it can’t be missed. 这是体验中国传统文化的绝佳机会, 不容错过。
3. 结尾——望应邀, 盼回复
①I’d appreciate it if you could confirm your participation at your early convenience. 
如果你能尽早确认参加, 我将不胜感激。
②We’d be very delighted if you could come and share the unforgettable moment with us. 
如果你能来和我们共度这个难忘的时刻, 我们将十分高兴。
③I do hope you will accept my invitation if it is convenient for you. 
我真心希望你方便的话能接受我的邀请。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华, 下周你的家乡将举办一场红色旅游文化展, 你打算邀请留学生Alex参加, 请根据以下提示写一封邀请信。
　　1. 文化展的时间:  下周六、周日; 
　　2. 文化展的地点:  人民广场; 
　　3. 文化展的活动。
注意: 1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
参考词汇:  红色旅游red tourism
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
【参考范文】
Dear Alex, 
　　Next Saturday and Sunday, a red tourism culture exhibition will be held at the People’s Square. Knowing you are interested in it, I’m writing to invite you to attend with us. 
　　This exhibition will show you some revolutionary tourist attractions of our hometown, which can help you learn about some Chinese revolutionary history and culture. Not only can you appreciate the fantastic pictures but also you’ll be moved by the spirits of the Chinese historical heroes. 
　　I’m looking forward to your reply. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假定你是李华，你班计划在周末组织农场研学(agritourism)，请给你的外教Chris写封邮件邀请他参加，内容包括：1.活动时间和内容；2.注意事项。
注意：1.词数80左右；2.可适当增加细节，使内容充实，行文连贯。
Dear Chris, 
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours, 
Li Hua
2．假定你是学校英语俱乐部负责人李华，你们准备举办“汉语成语英语翻译大赛（English Translation Contest of Chinese Idioms)”。请用英文给在你校学习汉语的英国交换生George 写封邮件，邀请他参加，内容包括：
1.告知消息；
2.比赛安排。
注意：
1.词数100左右；
2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
3．假定你是李华，你校计划拍摄一部有关学校历史与发展的英文纪录片，你是该项目的负责人之一。请你给交换生好友Eric写封邮件，请他负责此片的英文解说。内容包括：
1. 说明意图；
2. 介绍纪录片的内容。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。

Dear Eric,
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
4．假设你是某国际学校艺术俱乐部主席李华，你们正在准备校艺术节活动。请你给Mr. Herman写一封邮件。内容包括：
(1)邀请他担任导师；
(2)简要介绍活动。
注意：
(1)写作词数应为80个左右；
(2)请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。

___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．为了激发学生们对运动的热爱、增强学生们的体质，你校计划举办第一届乒乓球比赛，请你以李华的名义给你校的交换生David写一封邮件邀请他参加。内容包括：
1．介绍写信目的；
2．讲述相关事宜；

6．假定你是李华，请写信给留学生朋友James，鼓励他参加国际学生服务中心(International Students Service Center) 面向留学生开展的主题为“My China Surprise”的短视频征集活动。内容包括：

Dear James,

7．假定你是李华，下周你校将举办中医文化节（Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Festival），请你给外教Ryan写一封邮件，邀请他来参加，内容包括：

8．假定你是李华，你校计划举办一场主题为“Colorful World”的展览，向同学们展示不同国家的手工艺品。请你写一封邮件邀请交换生Tom参加，内容包括：
1. 活动的目的、时间和地点；

3. 期待他的参加。

1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。

Dear Tom,

1.发明该项产品的背景；
2.该产品的功能和优势；
3.提出邀请。
要求：

10．假定你是李华，你校下周要举办中文戏剧节(Chinese Drama Festival)，请给你校对此感兴趣的外教Mr. Alfred写封邮件，邀请他参加。内容包括：
1. 戏剧节简介；
2. 活动时间和地点；
3. 期盼回复。
注意：1.词数80左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
参考答案
1．Dear Chris,
How is everything going recently? I’m writing to invite you to join us in an exciting agritourism this Saturday, which promises to be both educational and enjoyable.
As scheduled, we will gather at school gate at 8:00 a. m. and depart promptly at 8:30 a. m. by bus. This agritourism covers a wide range of agricultural activities, ranging from visiting a workshop on organic farming to enjoying a farm-to-table meal. You can not only gain much hands-on experience in planting, harvesting, as well as interacting with farm animals, but also exploring the natural surroundings. Remember to wear casual clothes and hats for outdoor activities, and to protect the environment, we encourage everyone to bring reusable water bottles and minimize waste.
Your participation will be highly expected and we’re all looking forward to your favorable reply.
Warmest regards,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生写邮件邀请外教Chris参加在周末组织的农场研学。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
准时：promptly→punctually/on time
获得：gain→attain
探索：explore→probe
渴望：look forward to→anticipate
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：This agritourism covers a wide range of agricultural activities, ranging from visiting a workshop on organic farming to enjoying a farm-to-table meal.
拓展句：This agritourism covers a wide range of agricultural activities, which range from visiting a workshop on organic farming to enjoying a farm-to-table meal.
【高分句型1】I’m writing to invite you to join us in an exciting agritourism this Saturday, which promises to be both educational and enjoyable.（运用了不定式作目的状语，which引导非限制性定语从句）
【高分句型2】This agritourism covers a wide range of agricultural activities, ranging from visiting a workshop on organic farming to enjoying a farm-to-table meal.（运用了现在分词作状语）
2．Dear George,
Good news for you! Our school English club is going to hold a English Translation Contest of Chinese Idioms. I know you are learning Chinese and have great interest in Chinese idioms. So I'm writing to sincerely invite you to participate in this meaningful event.
The contest will be held in the school lecture hall from 2:00 to 3:00 next Friday afternoon. In this contest, you'll be required to translate 20 Chinese idioms in writing, which cover various aspects of Chinese culture. Five English teachers will act as judges to score the translation, and select the top three. The English Club will give each winner a Chinese—English Dictionary of Idioms as a prize.
Looking forward to your participation!
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。请考生请用英文给在你校学习汉语的英国交换生George 写封邮件，告知“汉语成语英语翻译大赛（English Translation Contest of Chinese Idioms)”的相关情况，邀请他参加。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
参加：participate in→take part in
要求：require→request
翻译：translate→interpret
举行：hold→host
2.句式拓展
合并句子
原句：I know you are learning Chinese and have great interest in Chinese idioms. So I'm writing to sincerely invite you to participate in this meaningful event.
拓展句：Because I know you are learning Chinese and have great interest in Chinese idioms, I'm writing to sincerely invite you to participate in this meaningful event..
【高分句型1】I know you are learning Chinese and have great interest in Chinese idioms.（运用了省略引导词that的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】In this contest, you'll be required to translate 20 Chinese idioms in writing, which cover various aspects of Chinese culture. （运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句）
3．Dear Eric,
I am writing to share an exciting opportunity with you. As you know, our school is planning to produce an English documentary. And I believe you are the perfect fit for providing the English voice-over.
The documentary is aimed at highlighting the history and development of our school. It will cover various aspects, such as its founding and significant events. Having had the pleasure of hearing your exceptional voice firsthand, I am confident that your involvement will greatly enhance the overall quality of the documentary.
Please let me know if you are interested. Looking forward to your early reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。假定你是李华，你校计划拍摄一部有关学校历史与发展的英文纪录片，你是该项目的负责人之一，要求考生给交换生好友Eric写封邮件，请他负责此片的英文解说。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
机会：opportunity→chance
重要的：significant→important
提供：provide→offer
活动：event→activity
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：The documentary is aimed at highlighting the history and development of our school.
拓展句：The documentary is aimed at highlighting the history and development of our school, which has a rich heritage and fascinating growth story.
[高分句型1]As you know, our school is planning to produce an English documentary.(运用了as引导的非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2]Having had the pleasure of hearing your exceptional voice firsthand, I am confident that your involvement will greatly enhance the overall quality of the documentary.(运用了现在分词作状语及that引导的宾语从句)
4．
Dear Mr. Herman, 
I am Li Hua, president of School Art Club. We are currently in the process of organizing our school’s annual Art Festival, and I would like to extend to you an invitation to serve as an advisor for the event. 
The Art Festival, a pivotal occasion within our school community, aims to showcase students’ artistic talents through a range of captivating performances and exhibitions. With your profound expertise in art education, we are confident that your support will enable us to create a vibrant and educational space that will benefit our entire school community. I have attached a brief outline of the event for your reference.
Looking forward to the possibility of working with you and to making our Art Festival a resounding success. 
Warm regards, 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。考生是某国际学校艺术俱乐部主席李华，正在准备校艺术节活动，要求考生按照要求给Mr. Herman写一封邮件。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
当前，目前：currently→ presently
充当：serve as → act as
核心的，关键性的：pivotal→ critical
才能，天赋：talent→ gift
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句 
原句：I am Li Hua, president of School Art Club.
拓展句：I am Li Hua, who is the president of School Art Club.
【高分句型1】We are currently in the process of organizing our school’s annual Art Festival, and I would like to extend to you an invitation to serve as an advisor for the event.（运用了动名词organizing作宾语）
【高分句型2】With your profound expertise in art education, we are confident that your support will enable us to create a vibrant and educational space that will benefit our entire school community.（运用了that引导的宾语从句、that引导的定语从句修饰先行词a vibrant and educational space）
5．Dear David,
How are you? I’m Li Hua. I’m sending this email to invite you to participate in the first table tennis competition of our school! This competition is all about getting students excited about sports and helping them stay fit. It’s going to be a lot of fun!
The event will take place next week. There’ll be great prizes for the winners. Whether you’re a pro or just enjoy playing, it’s a fantastic opportunity to have a good time and meet new people. So, don’t hesitate to sign up! I know you’ll do great!
Looking forward to seeing you on the court!
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于邀请信。要求考生给学校的交换生David写一封邮件邀请他参加学校举办的第一届乒乓球比赛。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
参加：participate in→ take part in
兴奋的：excited → thrilled
保持健康：stay fit → keep fit/stay healthy
玩得开心：have a good time→ have fun
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：I’m sending this email to invite you to participate in the first table tennis competition of our school! This competition is all about getting students excited about sports and helping them stay fit.
拓展句：I’m sending this email to invite you to participate in the first table tennis competition of our school, which is all about getting students excited about sports and helping them stay fit.
【高分句型1】This competition is all about getting students excited about sports and helping them stay fit.（运用了and连接的并列宾语和动名词作宾语）
【高分句型2】Whether you’re a pro or just enjoy playing, it’s a fantastic opportunity to have a good time and meet new people.（运用了whether引导的状语从句）
6．Dear James.
Good news! The International Students Service Center is organizing a video shooting contest themed “My China Surprise”, and I strongly recommend you give it a shot.
All foreign students living in China are welcome to share their unexpected adventures, surprising moments and cultural revelations through the lens. There are no strict restrictions on the topics, allowing participants ample freedom to capture whatever they find captivating and intriguing. Submission is open until Jan. 15th, 2024, and there are very exciting prizes awaiting the winners. 
Considering your colorful life, singular creativity and considerable expertise in photography, your video will definitely make a very competitive entry. I’m looking forward to your excellent performance in the contest! Best wishes!
Yours
Li Hua
【写作解析】这是一篇邀请信。要求考生给留学生朋友James写信，鼓励他参加由国际学生服务中心 (International Students Service Center) 组织的名为“My China Surprise”的短视频征集活动。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
① 组织：organizing → hosting, arranging
② 推荐：recommend → endorse, suggest
③ 冒险：adventures → journeys, escapades
④ 奖品：prizes → awards, rewards
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：All foreign students living in China are welcome to share their unexpected adventures, surprising moments and cultural revelations through the lens.
拓展句：All foreign students who live in China are welcome to share their unexpected adventures, surprising moments and cultural revelations through the lens.
【高分句型1】All foreign students living in China are welcome to share their unexpected adventures, surprising moments and cultural revelations through the lens.（运用了现在分词作定语）
【高分句型2】There are no strict restrictions on the topics, allowing participants ample freedom to capture whatever they find captivating and intriguing.（现在分词作状语，whatever引导的宾语从句）
7．Dear Ryan,
I am writing to invite you to the Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Festival, which will be held next Monday afternoon on the school sports ground.
This festival aims to celebrate the rich heritage of traditional Chinese medicine. It will feature a variety of activities to provide insights into this ancient practice. For example, there will be lectures in introducing the theories and practices. Another highlight is an exhibition of Chinese herbal medicines, demonstrating their importance in TCM. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to experience therapies such as acupuncture, known for promoting wellness and relieving pain.
Looking forward to your reply.
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给外教Ryan写一封邮件，邀请他来参加中医文化节。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
举行：hold→host
机会：opportunity→chance
例如：for example→for instance
此外：additionally→besides
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Another highlight is an exhibition of Chinese herbal medicines, demonstrating their importance in TCM.
拓展句：Another highlight is an exhibition of Chinese herbal medicines, which demonstrates their importance in TCM.
[高分句型1] I am writing to invite you to the Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Festival, which will be held next Monday afternoon on the school sports ground. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] Another highlight is an exhibition of Chinese herbal medicines, demonstrating their importance in TCM. (运用了现在分词作状语)
8．Dear Tom,
How are you doing? I am excited to extend an invitation to you for an upcoming event at our school, the “Colorful World” exhibition. This event aims to showcase the diverse cultures and handicrafts from around the globe, promoting mutual understanding and appreciation among students.
The exhibition will be held on May 18th in the school hall. We will have the opportunity to view a wide range of handicrafts from various countries, and engage in discussions with fellow students about their artistic and cultural significance.
We would be thrilled if you could join us and share your own cultural insights. Looking forward to your early reply.
Yours, 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生写一封邮件邀请交换生Tom参加展览活动。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
表达：extend→convey
机会：opportunity→chance
举行：hold→host
欣赏：appreciation→admiration
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：This event aims to showcase the diverse cultures and handicrafts from around the globe, promoting mutual understanding and appreciation among students.
拓展句：This event aims to showcase the diverse cultures and handicrafts from around the globe, which promotes mutual understanding and appreciation among students.
[高分句型1] This event aims to showcase the diverse cultures and handicrafts from around the globe, promoting mutual understanding and appreciation among students. (运用了现在分词作状语)
[高分句型2] We would be thrilled if you could join us and share your own cultural insights. (运用了if引导条件状语从句)
9．Dear Jack,
I hope this letter finds you well. It’s been a while since we last met, and I’m thrilled to share with you an exciting idea that has been brewing in my mind lately — an innovative technological invention that I believe could make a real difference.
The inspiration stems from the pressing issue of environmental degradation(恶化) and the urgent need for sustainable living solutions. With global warming, pollution, and resource shortage worsening at an alarming rate, I have envisioned a “Smart Eco-Home System”— a comprehensive, AI-driven designed to optimize energy efficiency, minimize waste, and foster a greener lifestyle. This product has many functions but mainly integrates with a household existing infrastructure, monitors and regulates energy consumption, lowering both carbon footprint and family bills.
Considering your profound interest in cutting-edge technology, I couldn’t resist extending an invitation to you for the upcoming National Science and Technology Week to be held from May 25th to June 1st in China.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本书面表达属于应用文，要求用英文给新西兰好友Jack写一封信，向他分享一款你想要发明的科技产品，并邀请他来中国参加全国科技周活动，内容要点包括：1.发明该项产品的背景；2.该产品的功能和优势；3.提出邀请。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
最近：lately→recently
令人震惊的：alarming→shocking/astonishing
减少：lower→diminish/reduce
即将到来的：upcoming→forthcoming
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Considering your profound interest in cutting-edge technology, I couldn’t resist extending an invitation to you for the upcoming National Science and Technology Week to be held from May 25th to June 1st in China.
拓展句：Considering your profound interest in cutting-edge technology, I couldn’t resist extending an invitation to you for the upcoming National Science and Technology Week, which will be held from May 25th to June 1st in China.
【高分句型1】It’s been a while since we last met, and I’m thrilled to share with you an exciting idea that has been brewing in my mind lately — an innovative technological invention that I believe could make a real difference. (运用了since引导的时间状语从句和that引导的限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】This product has many functions but mainly integrates with a household existing infrastructure, monitors and regulates energy consumption, lowering both carbon footprint and family bills. (运用了现在分词作状语)
10．Dear Mr. Alfred,
Hearing that you take a great interest in Chinese dramas, I am glad to tell you that there will be a Chinese Drama Festival held in our school.
The festival enjoys widespread popularity among us students, which has been held for thirteen times. Short plays of 5­10 minutes by each class are well prepared. Scheduled to take place at 2: 00 p.m. in our stadium next Friday, the activity will last two hours or so.
Please let me know whether you are available at your earliest convenience.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生给外教Mr. Alfted写封邮件，介绍中文戏剧节展演的情况并邀请他参加。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
高兴的：glad → delighted
举行、组织：hold → conduct
对……感兴趣：take a great interest in → be very interested in
告知：tell → inform
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Scheduled to take place at 2: 00 p.m. in our stadium next Friday, the activity will last two hours or so.
拓展句：The activity, which is scheduled to take place at 2: 00 p.m. in our stadium next Friday, will last two hours or so.
【高分句型1】The festival enjoys widespread popularity among us students, which has been held for thirteen times. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】Hearing that you take a great interest in Chinese dramas, I am glad to inform you that there will be a Chinese Drama Festival held in our school. (运用了现在分词短语作状语以及that引导的宾语从句)
