第 1 页
邀请信

第 2 页
【真题再现】
　　假定你是李华, 你校将举办外国人汉语演讲比赛。请给你的英国朋友George写一封信邀请他参加, 内容包括: 
　　1. 比赛时间和地点; 
　　2. 演讲主题; 
　　3. 报名方式。

第 3 页
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称(I)为主, 第二人称(you)为辅
时态
一般现在时, 一般将来时
要点
1. 点明写信目的、比赛时间和地点
2. 此次活动的主题并邀请他参加此次活动
3. 再一次真诚地邀请

第 4 页
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  很荣幸邀请你参加下周六在我校举办的外国人汉语演讲比赛。
一般表达: 
I am honored to invite you to take part in the Chinese Speech Contest for foreigners at 
my school next Saturday. 
词汇或句式升级(高级词汇)
It is a great _________ for me to invite you to ___________ in the Chinese Speech 
Contest for foreigners at my school next Saturday. 
privilege
participate

第 5 页
要点2: 你的演讲会给听众留下深刻的印象。
一般表达: 
Your speech will leave a deep impression on the listeners. 
升级表达(丰富内容, 双重否定)
无疑, 你流利的汉语、精湛的公共演讲技能以及非常广博的知识会给听众留下很
深的印象并激励他们。
_____________, your fluent Chinese, excellent public speaking skills, and __________ 
___________________will not fail to impress and inspire the audience. 
Undoubtedly
especially
extensive knowledge 

第 6 页
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear George, 
　　It is a great privilege for me to invite you to participate in the Chinese Speech Contest for foreigners at my school next Saturday. 

第 7 页
　　The theme of the upcoming speech contest is British culture which we sincerely expect to listen to from a native of Britain. Undoubtedly, your fluent Chinese, excellent public speaking skills, and especially extensive knowledge will not fail to impress and inspire the audience. If you accept our invitation, we will be more than pleased to welcome you to register at the Student Organization Office. 
　　We are looking forward to your participation. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 8 页
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明活动, 发出邀请
①I’d like to invite you to attend the Chinese Excellent Calligraphy Show and admire the great works with me. 
我想邀请你参加中国优秀书法展, 和我一起欣赏这些优秀的作品。
②Knowing you are very interested in Chinese history and culture, I’m more than pleased to invite you to visit Suzhou Gardens with me. 
得知你对中国历史和文化很感兴趣, 我很高兴地邀请你和我一起到苏州园林游玩。

第 9 页
2. 篇中——详细描述, 讲清细节, 表达好处
①Here are arrangements for the activity. 
The following are arrangements for the activity. 
Arrangements for the activity are as follows. 
活动安排如下。
②There will be various activities, including short drama performances, playing musical instruments, as well as other wonderful shows. 
将会有各种各样的活动, 包括短剧表演, 乐器演奏和其他精彩的表演。
③This is such a golden chance to experience traditional Chinese culture that it can’t be missed. 这是体验中国传统文化的绝佳机会, 不容错过。

第 10 页
3. 结尾——望应邀, 盼回复
①I’d appreciate it if you could confirm your participation at your early convenience. 
如果你能尽早确认参加, 我将不胜感激。
②We’d be very delighted if you could come and share the unforgettable moment with us. 
如果你能来和我们共度这个难忘的时刻, 我们将十分高兴。
③I do hope you will accept my invitation if it is convenient for you. 
我真心希望你方便的话能接受我的邀请。

第 11 页
【拓展训练】
　　假定你是李华, 下周你的家乡将举办一场红色旅游文化展, 你打算邀请留学生Alex参加, 请根据以下提示写一封邀请信。
　　1. 文化展的时间:  下周六、周日; 
　　2. 文化展的地点:  人民广场; 
　　3. 文化展的活动。
注意: 1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
参考词汇:  红色旅游red tourism
_________________________________________________________________

第 12 页
【参考范文】
Dear Alex, 
　　Next Saturday and Sunday, a red tourism culture exhibition will be held at the People’s Square. Knowing you are interested in it, I’m writing to invite you to attend with us. 

第 13 页
　　This exhibition will show you some revolutionary tourist attractions of our hometown, which can help you learn about some Chinese revolutionary history and culture. Not only can you appreciate the fantastic pictures but also you’ll be moved by the spirits of the Chinese historical heroes. 
　　I’m looking forward to your reply. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

申请信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 暑假在伦敦学习, 得知当地美术馆要举办中国画展览。请写一封信申请做志愿者, 内容包括: 
　　1. 写信目的; 2. 个人优势; 3. 能做的事情。
Step 1:  审题布局
类 型
申请信
人 称
第一人称(I)
时 态
一般现在时; 一般将来时
要 点
1. 写信目的
2. 个人优势
3. 能做的事情
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1: 自我介绍, 写信目的
我是来自中国的学生李华。
一般表达: I am Li Hua, a student from China. 
→我是李华, 一个来自中国的学生, 暑假期间在伦敦学习。(增加细节)
I am Li Hua, a student from China, who is studying in London during the summer holiday. 
要点2:  个人优势 
我的英语说得非常流畅。
一般表达: I speak English fluently. 
→我英语说得很流利, 这使我可以毫无困难地与来访者交流。(补充细节)
I speak English fluently, which allows me to communicate with visitors without difficulty. 
要点3: 能做的事情
我认为我有资格成为一名志愿者。
I think I am qualified to be a volunteer. 
Step 3:  衔接成篇
Dear Sir, 
　　I am Li Hua, a student from China, who is studying in London during the summer holiday. Knowing an exhibition of Chinese paintings will be held at the local gallery next month, I am writing to apply to become a volunteer. 
　　I have the following advantages. First of all, I speak English fluently, which allows me to communicate with visitors without difficulty. Second, as a Chinese painting lover, I know a lot about this art form. If accepted, I can introduce Chinese painting skills to visitors, helping them know more about Chinese culture. 
　　I think I am qualified to be a volunteer. I would be grateful if you could give me a chance. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——自我介绍, 点明主题
①I’m writing in the hope that I can obtain an opportunity to be the one of the volunteers. 
我写这封信是希望我能有机会成为其中的一名志愿者。
②Learning that volunteers are needed/wanted/recruited to offer service to the coming international students, I am writing to apply for a chance. 
得知贵处招募志愿者为即将到来的国际学生提供服务, 我写信申请一个机会。
2. 篇中——陈述优势和特长
①So good at English am I that I can communicate with others fluently and accurately. 
我英语好, 可以流畅地、准确地与他人交流。
②As an outgoing and patient boy, I always find myself getting along well with others. 
我是一个外向且有耐心的男生, 善于与人友好相处。
③Young boy as I am, I have rich/ample/adequate/sufficient experience in activities of this kind. 
我虽然年轻, 但在这种活动方面颇有经验。
3. 结尾——表示感谢和希望
①Hopefully, you will kindly consider my application, and a reply at your earliest convenience will be fully appreciated. 
希望您能考虑我的申请, 如能尽快回复, 我将不胜感激。
②I’d appreciate it if you could give me the opportunity. 
如果您能给我这个机会, 我将不胜感激。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华, 你校英语协会招聘志愿者, 接待来访的国外中学生, 请你写信应聘, 内容包括: 
　　1. 口语能力;  2. 相关经验;  3. 应聘目的
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
【参考范文】
Dear Sir or Madam, 
　　I am Li Hua, a student coming from Grade 3. Learning that volunteers are needed/wanted/recruited to offer service to the coming international students, I am writing to apply for a chance. 
　　First, having been learning English for many years, I am now able to communicate with foreigners fluently. Second, so much related experience did I have that I can cope with emergencies. I have a keen passion for this voluntary service, in which case, not only can I improve my overall competence, but also I can cultivate a multicultural perspective. 
　　Hopefully, you will kindly consider my sincere application, and a reply at your earliest convenience will be fully appreciated. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假定你是李华，你校要和美国友好学校开展一场线上交流活动，主题为“语言的力量”，现面向全体学生招募线上主持人（online host）。请你给负责人Terry写一封申请信，内容包括：
1. 写信目的；
2. 你的优势；
3. 表达愿望。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Terry, 
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours, 
Li Hua
2．假定你是李华，你校交换生Edward在校英文网站上发帖寻找寄宿家庭（host family）以更好地融入中国的生活。在与家人商量后，你家有意向申请成为他的寄宿家庭，请你给他写一封邮件，内容包括：
1. 写信目的；
2. 你家的优势；
3. 你的期望。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Edward,
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
3．假如你是红星中学学生李华，你学校的足球队正在招募球员，你对此非常感兴趣。请你写一封申请信。内容应包括：
1.简要介绍你自己；
2.你为什么符合要求。
注意：1. 词数：100左右
 2. 可以适当增加细节，使行文连贯。
Honored committee,
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
4．假如你是李华，与你校结对的美国布兰登中学(Brandon Hall School)将于下周到访你校进行为期两周的交流学习，你校正在招募能接待到访美国学生住家的学生志愿者。你有意申请，请给负责教师写一份申请书，内容包括：
1.家庭情况介绍；
2.申请理由；
3.希望选上。
注意：
1.词数80左右；
2.可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．假定你是李华, 你得知学校将招聘10名学生作为以“皮影戏 (shadow play)”为主题的中外文化交流活动的志愿者。请你给负责此事的外教Jessica写信申请参加该活动, 内容包括: 
1. 写信目的; 
2. 介绍自己的优势。
注意: 
1. 词数80左右; 
2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Dear Jessica, 
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
6．假如你是新华高中的学生李华，近年全球掀起了学汉语的热潮。来自美国的Tony也是汉语爱好者，他在网上招募一名汉语学习伙伴，帮助他提升汉语水平。你很感兴趣，请你给Tony写信申请成为他的汉语学习伙伴。内容包括：
1. 写信目的；
2. 个人优势；
3. 表达期望。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Dear Tony,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
7．假定你是李华，得知研学机构Global Camp正在招募市图书馆寒假“英语阅读沙龙”活动的主持人，请写一封英文申请信，内容需包括：
1.个人优势； 2.流程设想。
注意：1.写作词数应为100左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
To Whom It May Concern,
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
8．最近海航在你校招收飞行员(pilot)，请你根据提示，用英语写一封应聘信应包括以下要点：
个人信息：姓名，性别，身高，所在学校等；
申请条件：1. 身体，心理素质；
2. 自己的特长；
3. 自我控制能力和合作意识；
4. 对航空航天技术的兴趣。
注意：1. 词数100左右；
2. 可适当的增加细节，以使行文连贯。
3. 参考词汇：心理素质：mental quality    航空航天技术：aerospace
Dear Sir or Madam, 
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours truly,
Li Hua
9．假设你是新华中学学生会主席李华。你从官网得知，青少年艺术节（Youth Art Festival）组委会正在招募今年英语戏剧比赛的承办学校。请你代表学校给组委会写一封邮件，申请承办该活动，内容包括： 
1. 承办条件； 
2. 初步计划。
注意：
1. 词数100左右； 
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。 
Dear Sir or Madam,
I am Li Hua, president of the student union in Xin Hua High School．
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
10．假定你是李华，你校学生英语报Youth计划开设一个全新的专栏Growing Up Together，聚焦学生心理健康问题。校报现面向全体学生招募栏目编辑。你对此十分感兴趣，请用英语写一封信来应聘这个职位，内容包括：
1.对栏目的理解和内容建议；2.个人优势。
注意：1.写作词数应为 80左右；2.请按如下格式作答。
Dear Chief Editor,
__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
参考答案
1．Dear Terry, 
I’m writing to apply for the online host of the upcoming exchange activity between our school and the sister school in the US, with the theme of “The Power of Language”. 
I have excellent communication skills and I am good at expressing myself in English. I also have rich experience in hosting activities, which allows me to better control the progress of the event. Moreover, I am very interested in language and culture, and I believe I can bring a fresh perspective to this exchange. 
I hope to have the opportunity to be the host and look forward to your reply. 
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生给负责人Terry写一封申请信，申请成为学校要和美国友好学校开展的一场线上交流活动的主持人。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
主题：theme→subject
优秀的：excellent→brilliant
擅长：be good at→be adept at
并且：moreover→furthermore
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：I’m writing to apply for the online host of the upcoming exchange activity between our school and the sister school in the US, with the theme of “The Power of Language”.
拓展句：I’m writing to apply for the online host of the upcoming exchange activity between our school and the sister school in the US, the theme of which is “The Power of Language”.
[高分句型1] I also have rich experience in hosting activities, which allows me to better control the progress of the event. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] Moreover, I am very interested in language and culture, and I believe I can bring a fresh perspective to this exchange. (运用了省略that的宾语从句)
2．Dear Edward,
I am writing to express my family’s interest in hosting you during your exchange program in our school.
In the first place, our family is deeply rooted in Chinese culture, and we are eager to share our customs, traditions and cuisines with you. Additionally, staying with us will provide you with a supportive environment where you can practice speaking Chinese outside of the classroom and gain insights into everyday life in China. Lastly, our home is close to our school, ensuring your easy access to classes.
We are convinced that living with a local family like ours will greatly enhance your experience in China. Looking forward to your reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生给交换生Edward写封邮件，申请成为他的寄宿家庭。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
表达：express→convey
另外：additionally→moreover
最后：lastly→finally
首先：in the first place→first and foremost
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Lastly, our home is close to our school, ensuring your easy access to classes.
拓展句：Lastly, our home is close to our school, which ensures your easy access to classes.
[高分句型1] Additionally, staying with us will provide you with a supportive environment where you can practice speaking Chinese outside of the classroom and gain insights into everyday life in China. (运用了where引导的限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] We are convinced that living with a local family like ours will greatly enhance your experience in China. (运用了that引导的宾语从句)
3．
Honored committee,
I’m Li Hua, a senior two student. When conveyed that the school’s football team is recruiting players, I feel delighted and hasten to apply to join it. My advantages can be seen as follows.
As a dedicated student-athlete, I believe that I possess not only the passion but also the necessary skills and commitment required for success on the field. My agility, speed, and tactical awareness make me a valuable asset to any team dynamic. Additionally, my leadership experience from captaining previous squads ensures strong camaraderie among teammates and fosters a competitive spirit within the group. Last but not least, I have confidence in myself that I’d make contributions to the community.
Thank you for your kind consideration. Looking forward to your positive response.
Sincerely yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。学校的足球队正在招募球员，考生对此非常感兴趣，要求考生按照要求写一封申请信。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
招募：recruit→ enlist
高兴的：delighted→ glad
优点：advantage→ merit
专心致志的：dedicated→ concentrated
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句 
原句：I’m Li Hua, a senior two student.
拓展句：I’m Li Hua, who is a senior two student.
【高分句型1】As a dedicated student-athlete, I believe that I possess not only the passion but also the necessary skills and commitment required for success on the field. （运用了that引导的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】Additionally, my leadership experience from captaining previous squads ensures strong camaraderie among teammates and fosters a competitive spirit within the group. （运用了动名词captaining作宾语）
4．Dear sir or madam,
My name is Li Hua, a boy student from Class 7 Grade 2. I have learned that volunteer students are needed to receive the coming American students. Greatly interested, I’m writing to apply to be one.
Located in downtown Hangzhou, my cozy home has a spare room to accommodate the honored guest with good facilities. Both my parents are Chinese teachers, which makes it easier for the student to experience Chinese culture during his staying at my home. Above all, I myself am a keen English learner, eager to befriend foreign students, exchanging ideas in English and sharing fascinating glimpses of diverse culture. As a young Chinese student, I also hope to help to make the foreign students can have a good impression of China and Chinese young people. Thank you for reading and I’m looking forward to your favorable reply.
Yours sincerely
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一份申请书，申请接待到访美国学生住在你家。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
使位于：locate→situate
急切的：eager→anxious
迷人的：fascinating→charming
各式各样的：diverse→varied
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：My name is Li Hua, a boy student from Class 7 Grade 2.
拓展句：My name is Li Hua, who is a boy student from Class 7 Grade 2.
[高分句型1] I have learned that volunteer students are needed to receive the coming American students. (运用了that引导的宾语从句)
[高分句型2] Both my parents are Chinese teachers, which makes it easier for the student to experience Chinese culture during his staying at my home. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
5．Dear Jessica,
I’m Li Hua. Learning that our school will select 10 students to be the volunteers of the cultural exchange activity between China and other countries, I’m writing to apply for the opportunity. 
I’m confident that I am a right person for this activity. Firstly. I am fluent in English, which plays an important role in communicating with foreigners. Secondly, I have learned shadow plays for eight years and am capable of performing them well. What’s more, I’m outgoing and can get on well with others. 
I would appreciate it if you could give me this chance. 
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达是一篇应用文，要求考生外教Jessica写信，申请成为以“皮影戏 (shadow play)”为主题的中外文化交流活动的志愿者。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
挑选：select→pick up
首先：firstly→to begin with
重要的：important→significant
感激：appreciate→be grateful
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：What’s more, I’m outgoing and can get on well with others. 
拓展句：What’s more, I’m outgoing, which makes me get on well with others.
[高分句型1]
I’m confident that I am a right person for this activity.（运用了that引导宾语从句）
[高分句型2]
Firstly. I am fluent in English, which plays an important role in communicating with foreigners.（运用了which引导非限制性定语从句）
6．Dear Tony,
Learning that you are recruiting an partner to help you learn Chinese, I am writing to recommend myself.
I’m Li Hua, a student from Xinhua high school. First of all, I love making friends and helping them with their studies. Besides, I can speak both English and Chinese fluently. More importantly, I like reading books about western and Chinese culture and customs. I think we can help each other make progress.
I would appreciate it if you could choose me as your partner. Looking forward to your reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生请你给Tony写信申请成为他的汉语学习伙伴，内容包括：写信目的、个人优势和表达期望。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
帮助：help→ assist
此外：besides→ what’s more
喜欢：love→ like
了解到：learn → know
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Learning that you are recruiting an partner to help you learn Chinese, I am writing to recommend myself.
拓展句：Because I learn that you are recruiting an partner to help you learn Chinese, I am writing to recommend myself.
【高分句型1】First of all, I love making friends and helping them with their studies.（运用了动名词作宾语）
【高分句型2】I think we can help each other make progress.（运用了省略了that引导的宾语从句）
7．To Whom It May Concern,    
I am writing in response to your posting for a host in English Reading Salon in the City Library.
I believe I have the time and talent to be a good match. First, I can devote my vacation to this project. Second, my fluency in English and organizing ability make me equal to the job. If recruited, I will design customized activities to get every participant involved. I can also invite my foreign teacher as the guest speaker to lecture on strategies for reading the original.
Enclosed are my resume and a detailed project plan. Looking forward to your reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生对于得知研学机构Global Camp正在招募市图书馆暑期“英语阅读沙龙”活动的主持人这一情况，写一封英文申请信。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
天赋：talent→gift
胜任：equal→qualified
被录用：recruited→admitted
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Second, my fluency in English and organizing ability make me equal to the job.
拓展句：Second, I have fluent English and excellent organizing ability, which can make me equal to the job.
【高分句型1】I believe I have the time and talent to be a good match.（运用了省略引导词that的宾语从句。）
【高分句型2】If recruited, I will design customized activities to get every participant involved.（运用了if引导的条件状语从句的省略。）
8．Dear Sir or Madam,
I have learned the news that pilots are wanted in your company. I’d like to apply for that job very much. Below are my qualifications for the job.
I am Li Hua, male, aged 16. I am now studying at No. 5 Middle School. Since my childhood, I have showed special interest in space flight and have a good understanding of it. In addition, I am in good health, 1.77 meters tall and I have an excellent mental quality and good self-control. What's more, I show a high sense of team spirit, which I think is of vital importance for a pilot. If I am chosen, I will train hard and try my best to do it well.
Looking forward to your reply.
Yours truly,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。最近海航在你校招收飞行员(pilot)，请你根据提示，用英语写一封应聘信应包括以下要点：个人信息：姓名，性别，身高，所在学校等；申请条件：1. 身体，心理素质；2. 自己的特长；3. 自我控制能力和合作意识；4. 对航空航天技术的兴趣。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
工作：job→post
感兴趣：show interest in→be interested in
此外：in addition/what’s more→besides
尽最大努力：try one’s best→spare no effort
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Since my childhood, I have showed special interest in space flight and have a good understanding of it.
拓展句：Since I was young, I have showed special interest in space flight and have a good understanding of it.
[高分句型1] What's more, I show a high sense of team spirit, which I think is of vital importance for a pilot. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] If I am chosen, I will train hard and try my best to do it well. (运用了if引导条件状语从句)
9．Dear Sir or Madam,
I am Li Hua, president of the student union in Xin Hua High School. On behalf of our school, I am writing to you to apply to be the host school of this year’s English Drama Competition.
I’m convinced that our school is well qualified for (符合条件) hosting this activity. First of all, in the past three years, our school has successfully held three English Drama Competitions, each of which is widely welcomed and appreciated by all teachers and students (非限制性定语从句). Secondly, as for our arrangement, we will invite professional teachers to join us and give us guidance on English skills. Finally, we will use the English corner to warm up in advance and publicize this drama competition. I believe that the English Drama Competition this year will bring a visual feast if it could be held by our school.
I would appreciate it if you could take my application into consideration. Look forward to your early reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。青少年艺术节（Youth Art Festival）组委会正在招募今年英语戏剧比赛的承办学校，要求考生作为新华中学学生会主席代表学校给组委会写一封邮件，申请承办该活动。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
首先：first of all→first and foremost
最后：finally→lastly
感激：appreciate→be grateful
考虑：take…into consideration→take…into account
2. 句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：First of all, in the past three years, our school has successfully held three English Drama Competitions, each of which is widely welcomed and appreciated by all teachers and students.
拓展句：First of all, in the past three years, our school has successfully held three English Drama Competitions, each of them widely welcomed and appreciated by all teachers and students.
【高分句型1】First of all, in the past three years, our school has successfully held three English Drama Competitions, each of which is widely welcomed and appreciated by all teachers and students. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】I believe that the English Drama Competition this year will bring a visual feast if it could be held by our school. (运用了that引导的宾语从句以及if引导的条件状语从句)
10．Dear Chief Editor,
I’m Li Hua, a senior student in our school. Learning/Hearing that some editors are needed for the student English newspaper — Youth, I’m writing to apply for the post sincerely. 
From my perspective, Growing Up Together is aimed at popularizing knowledge of mental health and helping students tackle adolescent problems. The column can create a safe and warm place where students pour out their growing pains and confusion without being judged and we, as their peers, can offer our understanding and comfort. 
Fluent in English writing and always keen on exploring psychology science, I am definitely qualified for the post. Besides, I once worked as a chief editor of the English newspaper of our class, which I believe will be helpful for the job. 
I would appreciate it if my application could be taken into account. Looking forward to your reply. 
Yours sincerely，
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。假定你是李华，你校学生英语报Youth计划开设一个全新的专栏Growing Up Together，聚焦学生心理健康问题。校报现面向全体学生招募栏目编辑。你对此十分感兴趣，请用英语写一封信来应聘这个职位。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
真诚地：sincerely→genuinely
处理：tackle→ handle
此外：besides→ additionally
把……考虑在内：take...into account→take...into consideration
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Fluent in English writing and always keen on exploring psychology science, I am definitely qualified for the post.
拓展句：As I am fluent in English writing and always keen on exploring psychology science, I am definitely qualified for the post.
【高分句型1】The column can create a safe and warm place where students pour out their growing pains and confusion without being judged and we, as their peers, can offer our understanding and comfort.（运用了where引导的限定性定语从句）
【高分句型2】Besides, I once worked as a chief editor of the English newspaper of our class, which I believe will be helpful for the job.（运用了which引导的非限定性定语从句）

documents.local_content:
第 1 页
申请信

第 2 页

【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 暑假在伦敦学习, 得知当地美术馆要举办中国画展览。请写一封信申请做志愿者, 内容包括: 
　　1. 写信目的; 2. 个人优势; 3. 能做的事情。

第 3 页
Step 1:  审题布局
类 型
申请信
人 称
第一人称(I)
时 态
一般现在时; 一般将来时
要 点
1. 写信目的
2. 个人优势
3. 能做的事情

第 4 页
Step 2:  巧饰亮点
要点1: 自我介绍, 写信目的
我是来自中国的学生李华。
一般表达: ________________________________
→我是李华, 一个来自中国的学生, 暑假期间在伦敦学习。(增加细节)
I am Li Hua, a student from China, __________________________________________
________. 
I am Li Hua, a student from China. 
who is studying in London during the summer 
holiday

第 5 页
要点2:  个人优势 
我的英语说得非常流畅。
一般表达: I speak English fluently. 
→我英语说得很流利, 这使我可以毫无困难地与来访者交流。(补充细节)
I speak English fluently, ________________________________________________
_________. 
要点3: 能做的事情
我认为我有资格成为一名志愿者。
I think I ___________________________. 
which allows me to communicate with visitors without 
difficulty
am qualified to be a volunteer

第 6 页
Step 3:  衔接成篇
Dear Sir, 
　　I am Li Hua, a student from China, who is studying in London during the summer holiday. Knowing an exhibition of Chinese paintings will be held at the local gallery next month, I am writing to apply to become a volunteer. 
　　I have the following advantages. First of all, I speak English fluently, which allows me to communicate with visitors without difficulty. Second, as a Chinese painting lover, I know a lot about this art form. If accepted, I can introduce Chinese painting skills to visitors, helping them know more about Chinese culture. 

第 7 页
　　I think I am qualified to be a volunteer. I would be grateful if you could give me a chance. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 8 页
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——自我介绍, 点明主题
①I’m writing in the hope that I can obtain an opportunity to be the one of the volunteers. 
我写这封信是希望我能有机会成为其中的一名志愿者。
②Learning that volunteers are needed/wanted/recruited to offer service to the coming international students, I am writing to apply for a chance. 
得知贵处招募志愿者为即将到来的国际学生提供服务, 我写信申请一个机会。

第 9 页
2. 篇中——陈述优势和特长
①So good at English am I that I can communicate with others fluently and accurately. 
我英语好, 可以流畅地、准确地与他人交流。
②As an outgoing and patient boy, I always find myself getting along well with others. 
我是一个外向且有耐心的男生, 善于与人友好相处。
③Young boy as I am, I have rich/ample/adequate/sufficient experience in activities of this kind. 
我虽然年轻, 但在这种活动方面颇有经验。

第 10 页
3. 结尾——表示感谢和希望
①Hopefully, you will kindly consider my application, and a reply at your earliest convenience will be fully appreciated. 
希望您能考虑我的申请, 如能尽快回复, 我将不胜感激。
②I’d appreciate it if you could give me the opportunity. 
如果您能给我这个机会, 我将不胜感激。

第 11 页
【拓展训练】
　　假定你是李华, 你校英语协会招聘志愿者, 接待来访的国外中学生, 请你写信应聘, 内容包括: 
　　1. 口语能力;  2. 相关经验;  3. 应聘目的
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________

第 12 页
【参考范文】
Dear Sir or Madam, 
　　I am Li Hua, a student coming from Grade 3. Learning that volunteers are needed/wanted/recruited to offer service to the coming international students, I am writing to apply for a chance. 
　　First, having been learning English for many years, I am now able to communicate with foreigners fluently. Second, so much related experience did I have that I can cope with emergencies. I have a keen passion for this voluntary service, in which case, not only can I improve my overall competence, but also I can cultivate a multicultural perspective. 

第 13 页
　　Hopefully, you will kindly consider my sincere application, and a reply at your earliest convenience will be fully appreciated. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

sections.text: 申请信

【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 暑假在伦敦学习, 得知当地美术馆要举办中国画展览。请写一封信申请做志愿者, 内容包括: 
　　1. 写信目的; 2. 个人优势; 3. 能做的事情。

Step 1:  审题布局
类 型
申请信
人 称
第一人称(I)
时 态
一般现在时; 一般将来时
要 点
1. 写信目的
2. 个人优势
3. 能做的事情

Step 2:  巧饰亮点
要点1: 自我介绍, 写信目的
我是来自中国的学生李华。
一般表达: ________________________________
→我是李华, 一个来自中国的学生, 暑假期间在伦敦学习。(增加细节)
I am Li Hua, a student from China, __________________________________________
________. 
I am Li Hua, a student from China. 
who is studying in London during the summer 
holiday

要点2:  个人优势 
我的英语说得非常流畅。
一般表达: I speak English fluently. 
→我英语说得很流利, 这使我可以毫无困难地与来访者交流。(补充细节)
I speak English fluently, ________________________________________________
_________. 
要点3: 能做的事情
我认为我有资格成为一名志愿者。
I think I ___________________________. 
which allows me to communicate with visitors without 
difficulty
am qualified to be a volunteer

Step 3:  衔接成篇
Dear Sir, 
　　I am Li Hua, a student from China, who is studying in London during the summer holiday. Knowing an exhibition of Chinese paintings will be held at the local gallery next month, I am writing to apply to become a volunteer. 
　　I have the following advantages. First of all, I speak English fluently, which allows me to communicate with visitors without difficulty. Second, as a Chinese painting lover, I know a lot about this art form. If accepted, I can introduce Chinese painting skills to visitors, helping them know more about Chinese culture.

I think I am qualified to be a volunteer. I would be grateful if you could give me a chance. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

【句式储备】
1. 篇头——自我介绍, 点明主题
①I’m writing in the hope that I can obtain an opportunity to be the one of the volunteers. 
我写这封信是希望我能有机会成为其中的一名志愿者。
②Learning that volunteers are needed/wanted/recruited to offer service to the coming international students, I am writing to apply for a chance. 
得知贵处招募志愿者为即将到来的国际学生提供服务, 我写信申请一个机会。

2. 篇中——陈述优势和特长
①So good at English am I that I can communicate with others fluently and accurately. 
我英语好, 可以流畅地、准确地与他人交流。
②As an outgoing and patient boy, I always find myself getting along well with others. 
我是一个外向且有耐心的男生, 善于与人友好相处。
③Young boy as I am, I have rich/ample/adequate/sufficient experience in activities of this kind. 
我虽然年轻, 但在这种活动方面颇有经验。

3. 结尾——表示感谢和希望
①Hopefully, you will kindly consider my application, and a reply at your earliest convenience will be fully appreciated. 
希望您能考虑我的申请, 如能尽快回复, 我将不胜感激。
②I’d appreciate it if you could give me the opportunity. 
如果您能给我这个机会, 我将不胜感激。

【参考范文】
Dear Sir or Madam, 
　　I am Li Hua, a student coming from Grade 3. Learning that volunteers are needed/wanted/recruited to offer service to the coming international students, I am writing to apply for a chance. 
　　First, having been learning English for many years, I am now able to communicate with foreigners fluently. Second, so much related experience did I have that I can cope with emergencies. I have a keen passion for this voluntary service, in which case, not only can I improve my overall competence, but also I can cultivate a multicultural perspective.

Hopefully, you will kindly consider my sincere application, and a reply at your earliest convenience will be fully appreciated. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

咨询信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 打算今年暑假去美国旅游。请你给Travel America国际旅行社写一封电子邮件进行咨询, 内容如下: 
　　1. 请其推荐合适的旅游路线; 
　　2. 请其告知相关的旅游费用。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Step 1: 精准审题　谋篇布局
人称
第一人称 (I), 第二人称(you)
时态
一般现在时
要点
1. 写信目的
2. 咨询的内容: 旅游路线, 旅游费用
Step 2: 字斟句酌　巧饰亮点
要点1:  我打算在美国住10天左右, 希望能看一看那些独特的自然风景, 品味一下当地的风俗。
一般表达:  I intend to stay in America for about 10 days, and I hope to have a look at some unique natural scenery and have a taste of local customs. 
句式升级(定语从句)
I intend to stay in America for about 10 days, during which I hope to have a look at some unique natural scenery and have a taste of local customs. 
要点2:  除此之外, 我想了解路线的价格, 包括所有旅游费用。
一般表达:  In addition, I’d like to know the prices of the routes, and all the traveling expenses. 
句式升级(分词短语作定语)
In addition, I’d like to know the prices of the routes, covering all the traveling expenses. 
Step 3: 衔接过渡　斐然成篇
Dear Sir/Madam, 
　　I’m planning to travel to the USA in the coming July. Therefore, I’m writing to inquire about travel routes of your agency. 
　　I intend to stay in America for about 10 days, during which I hope to have a look at some unique natural scenery and have a taste of local customs. So, could you please recommend some suitable travel routes? In addition, I’d like to know the prices of the routes, covering all the traveling expenses. 
　　A reply at your earliest convenience is highly appreciated. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表明写信目的
I am Li Hua, a Chinese student, studying in New Zealand. I am writing to inquire about some information regarding/concerning travel. 
我是李华, 一名在新西兰学习的中国学生。我写信是想询问一些关于旅行的信息。
2. 篇中——陈述要咨询的内容
①First of all, I’m tempted to know the departure time and traveling route. 
首先, 我很想知道出发时间和旅行路线。
②Secondly, how much do I have to pay for the travel? 
其次, 我需要支付多少旅费?
③Thirdly, is there anything I should pay special attention to?
第三, 有什么我应该特别注意的吗?
3. 结尾——表感谢, 盼回复
①I would be much appreciated if you could furnish me with the above information and you can contact me via 1234456@df. erf. 
如果您能提供我上述信息, 我将不胜感激, 您可以通过1234456@df. erf与我联系。
②Thank you and your prompt reply will be highly appreciated. 
谢谢你, 如能及时回复我将不胜感激。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华, 高考过后计划暑假期间到美国去参加中美学生交流活动。请写一封咨询信, 询问相关事宜。内容包括: 
　　1. 对申请者的相关要求; 
　　2. 课程的相关事宜; 
　　3. 住宿和吃饭的条件; 
　　4. 需要做的相关准备。
注意: 1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Dear Sir or Madam, 
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
Yours, 
Li Hua
【参考范文】
Dear Sir or Madam, 
　　I am very interested in the exchange program you offered. I am writing to obtain some more detailed information about it. 
　　Firstly, I just graduated from an ordinary high school and I wonder what qualifications are required for applicants. Secondly, if admitted, what courses am I going to take, and do I need to buy any books ahead of time? In addition, would you be so kind to introduce to me the conditions of board and accommodations? By the way, if I need to make any other preparations, let me know, will you?
　　Thanks again for your time and I’m looking forward to your early reply. 
　　Best wishes!
Yours, 
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假如你是李华，一名高三学生，准备在毕业后参加英国牛津大学的暑期夏令营（Oxford Summer Camp2018）。请用英语写一封电子邮件给相关负责人Mr. William，说明自己的情况并咨询相关事宜。
注意：1.词数100词左右；
2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯；
3.邮件的开头和结尾已经给出。
Dear Mr. William,
I’m Li Hua, a Chinese student. ___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
2．假设你是苏华，上周创建了学校志愿者服务俱乐部，但成员不多。你决定写个email给外教，咨询如何进行一项系列广告活动来招募俱乐部成员。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 信中不要出现自己真实的姓名和学校名称；
3. 开头语和结束语已写好，不计入词数。
Dear sir，
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
3．假如你是大学生李华，想利用假期时间打工挣钱。你对报纸上的广告很感兴趣。请你根据下面的广告内容写一封信应聘工作并询问有关情况。字数100词左右。
Temporary Job Offer
Major catering Company has temporary jobs as chefs, waiters, kitchen staff and English secretary. For more information write to Ms. Kate Rees, 17Park End St.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
4．假定你是李华，你校英语俱乐部将举办英语作文大赛。你有意参加，请你用英语给负责人Mr. White写一封邮件，询问相关信息。要点如下：
1. 报名时间及方式；
2. 需要提供的信息；
3. 费用及其他。
注意：1. 词数100左右。2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
参考词汇：报名：sign up
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．假定你是李华，你的澳大利亚朋友David是中国功夫的爱好者，你得知今年七月你所在的城市将举办一次国际功夫比赛。请你用英语给他写封邮件，询问他是否有兴趣参加，要点包括:
1. 比赛的时间和地点
2. 比赛的目的
3. 参加比赛的益处
注意:
1.  词数100左右；
2.  可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯；
3.  开头和结尾已给出，但不计入总词数。
Dear David,
How is everything going?
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
I will accompany you during the competition. I’m looking forward to hearing from you.
Yours,
Li Hua
6．假如你是学生李华。圣诞节即将到来，你们班决定本周五晚上庆祝一番，由你负责为此选定一个场所。Miracle Inn的一则广告引起了你的注意，但有一些具体信息不明确（如箭头所指内容）。请根据你所做的Notes，给Miracle Inn发一封电子邮件询问有关情况。
注意：1. 词数100左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯；
3. 开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数。
Dear Sir/Madam，
I am writing for more information about the service at your inn.
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours，
Li Hua
参考答案
1．Dear Mr. William，
I’m Li Hua,a Chinese student．Having longed for Oxford for a long time, I really want to be part of the Oxford Summer Camp 2018. Therefore, I’m writing to introduce myself and ask several questions concerned.
I’m always an English-lover and have taken some optional courses related to English literature and culture. So I’m wondering whether there are any courses in this camp? If there are, how many courses will you offer and what subjects will they cover? Besides, can you give me the schedule of these courses to see whether I’ll have time to visit other places? Finally, do you provide accommodations during the Summer Camp? Are all the students living on campus or will you arrange home-stay?
Thank you in advance! Looking forward to your reply!
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作分析】本文是一封电子邮件。假如你是李华，一名高三学生，准备在毕业后参加英国牛津大学的暑期夏令营（Oxford Summer Camp2018）。请用英语写一封电子邮件给相关负责人Mr. William，说明自己的情况并咨询相关事宜。写作时要认真阅读前面的提示，认清写作要求，然后确定文章的主题、文体、人称和时态。根据提示充分发挥自己的想象力，灵活运用英语知识，采用不同的表达方式将各要点完整地表述出来。写作时注意时态、语态的合理运用，主次分明，详略得当，语言力求准确、简洁。同时应选用合适的连接词或过渡词，适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
【亮点说明】本文是一封电子邮件。格式正确，内容符合要求，重点突出，文中使用高级词汇和句子。现在分词完成式做原因状语；I’m writing to introduce myself and ask several questions concerned.过去分词做后置定语；So I’m wondering whether there are any courses in this camp?句中whether引导宾语从句； If there are, how many courses will you offer and what subjects will they cover?条件句和问句完美结合；句中一般疑问句使用巧妙，恰到好处；另外，Therefore, Besides, Finally,等的运用为文章增色添彩。
2．Dear sir，
I’m delighted to tell you an exciting news that the Voluntary Service Club of our school was set up last week. Its main purpose is to provide an opportunity for students to serve the society better and know more about the society．It can also help to develop our cooperative ability． 
In order to have more members, I plan to organize some advertising activities to attract more students. Students who are healthy, open-minded and willing to help others are welcome to join our Voluntary Service Club. They will be required to do voluntary work at weekends or during holidays. However, I have little experience in such advertising activities, could you help me and give me some advice about it?
I will be appreciative it if you could give me a hand. I'm looking forward to your early reply.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一封邮件，咨询外教如何进行一项系列广告活动来招募学校志愿者服务俱乐部成员。
【要点分析】第一步：审题
体裁：应用文
时态：根据提示，时态主要为一般现在时，也有部分一般过去时和一般将来时。
结构：总分法
总分法指把主题句作为总说，把支持句作为分说，并以这种方式安排所写内容。
要求：
1. 上周学校创建了志愿者服务俱乐部
2.  咨询外教如何进行一项系列广告活动来招募俱乐部成员。
第二步:列提纲 （重点词组）
be delighted to; set up;  main purpose; cooperative ability; open-minded; be willing to; voluntary work; have little experience in; give sb. a hand; look forward to 
第三步：连词成句
1. I’m pleased to tell you an exciting news that the Voluntary Service Club of our school was set up last week.
2. Its main purpose is to provide an opportunity for students to serve the society better and know more about the society．
3. Students who are healthy, open-minded and willing to help others are welcome to join our Voluntary Service Club. 
4. They will be required to do voluntary work at weekends or during holidays. 
5. I have little experience in such advertising activities.
6.I will be appreciative it if you could give me a hand. 
7. I'm looking forward to your early reply.
根据提示及关键词（组）进行遣词造句，注意主谓一致和时态问题。
第四步：连句成篇（衔接词）
1.表文章结构顺序：First of all, Firstly/First, Secondly/Second… And then, Finally, In the end, At last
2.表并列补充关系：What is more, Besides, Moreover, Furthermore, In addition As well as, not only…but (also), including,
3.表转折对比关系：However, On the contrary, but, Although+clause(从句), In spite of+n/doing,On the one hand…,On the other hand… Some…,while others…,as for, so…that… 
4.表因果关系：Because, As, So, Thus, Therefore, As a result 
连句成文，注意使用恰当的连词进行句子之间的衔接与过渡，书写一定要规范清晰，
第五步：润色修改
范文内容完整，要点全面，语言规范，语篇连贯，词数适当，上下文意思连贯，符合逻辑关系。作者在范文中使用了较多主从复合句，如：Students who are healthy, open-minded and willing to help others are welcome to join our Voluntary Service Club.这句话运用了关系代词who引导的定语从句；使用了一些固定词组，如be delighted to; set up; be willing to等。另外，文章思路清晰、层次分明，上下句转换自然，为文章增色添彩。
3．Dear Ms. Kate,
I’m writing in response to your advertisement for a temporary position as a waiter. 
I’m a 20-year-old college student. I would be able to work during June and July. I do not have any experience but I enjoy working with people and am interested in a career in the catering industry when I leave university.
I would be very grateful if you could send me more information about the post available.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一封信应聘工作并询问有关情况。
【写作分析】1.词汇积累
喜欢：like→enjoy
感激的：thankful→grateful
期待：expect→look forward to
收到某人的来信：receive a letter from sb.→hear from sb.
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：I’m a 20-year-old college student. I would be able to work during June and July.
拓展句：I’m a 20-year-old college student, who  would be able to work during June and July.
[高分句型1] I do not have any experience but I enjoy working with people and am interested in a career in the catering industry when I leave university. (我没有任何经验，但我喜欢与人打交道，并且对大学毕业后在餐饮行业发展很感兴趣。)
该句中“but”作为并列连词连接前后分句；“when”引导时间状语从句。
[高分句型2] I would be very grateful if you could send me more information about the post available. (如果您能寄给我更多关于这个职位的信息，我将非常感激。)
该句中“if”引导条件状语从句。
4．Dear Mr. White，
My name is Li Hua. I've learned that a competition for the English Writing will be held by the English Club. I'm writing to apply for the information about it. Would you be kind enough to tell me when and how to sign up? What kinds of personal information should be provided to enter the contest? What’s more, to be frank，how much should I pay for it?
I am expecting your reply. Thanks a lot !
Sincerely
 Li Hua
【分析】本文是一篇应用文中的书信，同时也是一篇开放性书面表达，要求考生把自己当成李华，给朋友Mr. White写信，咨询英语俱乐部举办的作文大赛的具体信息。要求考生自行组织要点，总体难度较大。
【写作分析】第1步：审题。根据文字提示可知本文是一篇应用文，要求考生写信咨询英语作文大赛的具体信息。全文以一般现在时和第一人称为主。
第2步：组织要点。1. 报名时间及方式；2. 需要提供的信息；3. 费用及其他。
第3步：根据提示及关键词组进行遣词造句，关键词为sign up、apply for等。同时注意书信的惯用语和习惯表达。
第4步：连句成文，注意使用恰当的连词进行句子之间的衔接与过渡，书写一定要规范清晰，保持整洁美观的卷面是非常重要的。
本篇范文结构完美，条理清晰。范文时态和人称运用准确，涵盖了文字提示要求的所有要点，且有适当的个人发挥。考生运用了多样式的句型结构，整篇文章富有变化并不死板。使用了较多的高级词汇，如sign up、apply for等；同时文章还运用了一些串联成分，如what’s more，这些串联词让各个要点更为紧密地结合在一起。以上写作技巧的运用提升了文章的层次，显示了考生具有很强的驾驭语言的能力。
5．Dear David，
How is everything going?  I'm writing to tell you that the 12th International Kung Fu Competition will be held in Daqing from July 20th to 24th at Daqing Gymnasium.
As we know, kung fu is an important part of Chinese culture and has become increasingly popular at home and abroad. This event aims to further expand the influence of kung fu worldwide. The organizers hope people will feel the charm of kung fu in this competition.
I know you are kung fu amateur. Are you interested in taking part in the event? You will be able to appreciate high-level kung fu performances and communicate with people sharing the same interest from all over the world. You can also improve your techniques.
I will accompany you during the competition. I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
Yours,
Li Hua
【分析】这是一篇应用文写作。
【写作分析】第1步：根据提示可知，要求写一封邮件；假定你是李华，你的澳大利亚朋友David是中国功夫的爱好者，你得知今年七月你所在的城市将举办一次国际功夫比赛。请你用英语给他写封邮件，询问他是否有兴趣参加，要点包括:1. 比赛的时间和地点；2. 比赛的目的；3. 参加比赛的益处
第2步：根据写作要求，确定关键词（组），如：International Kung Fu Competition（国际功夫比赛），Gymnasium（体育馆），at home and abroad（国内外），further expand（进一步扩大）；amateur（业余爱好者）等。
第3步：根据提示及关键词（组）进行遣词造句，注意主谓一致和时态问题。
第4步：连句成文，注意使用恰当的连词进行句子之间的衔接与过渡，书写一定要规范清晰，保持整洁美观的卷面是非常重要的。
范文内容完整，语言规范，语篇连贯，词数适当。作者在范文中使用了较多高级表达方式，如I'm writing to tell you that the 12th International Kung Fu Competition will be held in Daqing from July 20th to 24th at Daqing Gymnasium.运用了宾语从句；You will be able to appreciate high-level kung fu performances and communicate with people sharing the same interest from all over the world.运用了现在分词作后置定语。全文中没有中国式英语的句式，显示了很高的驾驭英语的能力。另外，文章思路清晰、层次分明，上下句转换自然，为文章增色添彩。
6．Dear Sir/Madam，
I am writing for more information about the service at your inn.
We are high school students and we have decided to hold a celebration party for Christmas. I would like to book a hall at your inn from 7 pm to 10 pm on Friday. Do you have a hall large enough for 50 people？Also，could you please tell me when the evening meal starts and ends？As for the price，do you offer discounts for students？What does the evening meal include？Do you have special meals for vegetarians？As for the drinks，we need more varieties，such as Coke，mineral water，orange juice and apple juice. How much will it cost to rent the disco for four hours？Is it allowed that we choose our own music？
Your kind reply would be much appreciated.
Yours，
Li Hua
【分析】这是一篇应用文，要求写一封信。
【写作分析】本题要求写一封电子邮件，并在信中咨询预订的时间、房间大小、晚餐及价格折扣等情况。书信类写作可以按照三段式来写作，第一段要开篇明义，说明写信的目的是请求帮助、提供建议、表达感谢还是歉意。第二段是书信的主体段，一定要根据写作的具体要求，切题发挥，展开写作。最后一段通常是表达感谢或歉意，以及期待回复。文中主要使用一般现在时，可适当加入一般将来时。文章要注意条理清晰，包含题中所要求的要点，合理安排结构。
文章思路清晰，语言规范，段落整齐，语篇连贯，层次清晰。使用了较为高级的句式:when引导的宾语从句Also，could you please tell me when the evening meal starts and ends. that 引导的主语从句Is it allowed that we choose our own music？
高级句式的应用提升了写作的档次，整个短文显示出了作者高水平的英语表达能力。

第 1 页
咨询信


第 2 页
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 打算今年暑假去美国旅游。请你给Travel America国际旅行社写一封电子邮件进行咨询, 内容如下: 
　　1. 请其推荐合适的旅游路线; 
　　2. 请其告知相关的旅游费用。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。

第 3 页
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称 (I), 第二人称(you)
时态
一般现在时
要点
1. 写信目的
2. 咨询的内容: 旅游路线, 旅游费用

第 4 页
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  我打算在美国住10天左右, 希望能看一看那些独特的自然风景, 品味一下当
地的风俗。
一般表达:  I ______________________________________, and I hope to have a look at 
some unique natural scenery and have a taste of local customs. 
句式升级(定语从句)
I intend to stay in America for about 10 days, _____________I hope to have a look at 
some unique natural scenery and have a taste of local customs. 
intend to stay in America for about 10 days
during which 

第 5 页
要点2:  除此之外, 我想了解路线的价格, 包括所有旅游费用。
一般表达:  In addition, I’d like to know the prices of the routes, and all the traveling 
expenses. 
句式升级(分词短语作定语)
In addition, I’d like to know the prices of the routes, _______________________
_________. 
covering all the traveling 
expenses

第 6 页
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear Sir/Madam, 
　　I’m planning to travel to the USA in the coming July. Therefore, I’m writing to inquire about travel routes of your agency. 
　　I intend to stay in America for about 10 days, during which I hope to have a look at some unique natural scenery and have a taste of local customs. So, could you please recommend some suitable travel routes? In addition, I’d like to know the prices of the routes, covering all the traveling expenses. 
　　A reply at your earliest convenience is highly appreciated. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 7 页
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表明写信目的
I am Li Hua, a Chinese student, studying in New Zealand. I am writing to inquire about some information regarding/concerning travel. 
我是李华, 一名在新西兰学习的中国学生。我写信是想询问一些关于旅行的信息。

第 8 页
2. 篇中——陈述要咨询的内容
①First of all, I’m tempted to know the departure time and traveling route. 
首先, 我很想知道出发时间和旅行路线。
②Secondly, how much do I have to pay for the travel? 
其次, 我需要支付多少旅费?
③Thirdly, is there anything I should pay special attention to?
第三, 有什么我应该特别注意的吗?

第 9 页
3. 结尾——表感谢, 盼回复
①I would be much appreciated if you could furnish me with the above information and you can contact me via 1234456@df. erf. 
如果您能提供我上述信息, 我将不胜感激, 您可以通过1234456@df. erf与我联系。
②Thank you and your prompt reply will be highly appreciated. 
谢谢你, 如能及时回复我将不胜感激。

第 10 页
【拓展训练】
　　假定你是李华, 高考过后计划暑假期间到美国去参加中美学生交流活动。请写一封咨询信, 询问相关事宜。内容包括: 
　　1. 对申请者的相关要求; 
　　2. 课程的相关事宜; 
　　3. 住宿和吃饭的条件; 
　　4. 需要做的相关准备。
注意: 1. 词数80左右; 
　　  2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。

第 11 页
Dear Sir or Madam, 
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 12 页
【参考范文】
Dear Sir or Madam, 
　　I am very interested in the exchange program you offered. I am writing to obtain some more detailed information about it. 
　　Firstly, I just graduated from an ordinary high school and I wonder what qualifications are required for applicants. Secondly, if admitted, what courses am I going to take, and do I need to buy any books ahead of time? In addition, would you be so kind to introduce to me the conditions of board and accommodations? By the way, if I need to make any other preparations, let me know, will you?

第 13 页
　　Thanks again for your time and I’m looking forward to your early reply. 
　　Best wishes!
Yours, 
Li Hua

告知信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是晨光中学高三学生李华, 你校于6月8日举办了成人礼活动, 你的英国朋友Chris很想了解该活动。你于当晚给Chris写一封信, 介绍相关情况, 内容包括: 
　　1. 成人礼活动内容(成长点滴回顾等); 
　　2. 对活动的感受; 
　　3对自己未来的展望。
注意: 
　　1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可以适当加入细节, 以使内容充实、行文连贯。
参考词汇: 成人礼 the coming-of-age ceremony
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称为主, 第二人称为辅
时态
一般现在时, 一般过去时
要点
1. 介绍成人礼活动内容
2. 成人礼活动感受
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  这次的成人礼仪式深深地打动了我们, 并且我们从中意识到了责任感始终伴随着我们的成长过程。
一般表达:  We are all deeply moved by the ceremony and we realize that the sense of responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth from it. 
句式升级(定语从句)
We are all deeply moved by the ceremony, from which we realize that the sense of responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth. 
要点2:  我明白了成长的意义。
一般表达: I have understood the meaning of growing up. 
句式升级(倒装句)
这就是我对成长的理解。
Such is my understanding about growing up. 
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear Chris, 
　　I’m so glad to hear from you. In your last letter, you showed great interest in the coming-of-age ceremony held in our school. The following is a brief introduction to the ceremony. 
　　The ceremony was scheduled on June 8, during which we reviewed the past events. We are all deeply moved by the ceremony, from which we realize that the sense of responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth. We are determined to follow the examples of our excellent schoolmates and make ourselves useful to the whole society. Such is my understanding about growing up. What about yours?
　　Looking forward to your reply. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明目的、原因等
①Delighted to learn that an important volleyball game will be launched in our school stadium, I’m writing to extend my excitement and inform you of some relevant information. 
很高兴得知一场重要的排球比赛将在我们学校的体育场举行, 我写信是为了表达我的兴奋, 并告诉你一些相关的信息。
②I’m more than delighted to tell you that an international cultural festival is to be held in my city. 
我非常高兴地告知你们国际文化节将在我市举行。
2. 篇中——详细介绍, 告知具体信息
①First and foremost, the competition to be held will begin at 2 p. m. and last for roughly 3 hours. 
首先, 比赛将于下午两点开始, 持续大约3个小时。
②Then you will be taken to the Tea Room, where you can taste some famous Chinese tea and watch performances of tea art. 
有人将你带至茶室, 品尝中国名茶、观看茶艺表演。
3. 结尾——作总结, 盼回复
①I highly expect the experience to be rewarding, perfectly mixing learning and fun. 
我非常希望这段经历是有益的, 将学习和乐趣完美地结合在一起。
②It would be nice if you could provide a bit more information on the arrangements of the meeting. 你要能提供更多有关此次会议安排的信息, 那将再好不过了。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华, 你因故不能参加下周二的音乐会, 想把票转赠给你的留学生朋友John。请你给他写一封邮件告知相关情况, 内容包括: 
　　1. 你不能参加音乐会的理由; 
　　2. 音乐会的基本情况; 
　　3. 如何获取门票。
注意: 1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
【参考范文】
Dear John, 
　　How’s everything going? I’ve got the chance to enjoy a concert. However, it’s a regret that I have to go to meet an honored foreign friend then. Thus, you’re the first person I want to present the ticket. 
　　The concert will be held in the city Cultural Plaza at 7 p. m. next Friday, lasting two hours. Some famous musicians from home and abroad will be invited to show their great works, among which piano pieces will bring you fascination. 
　　If convenient, please come to my classroom for the ticket. I’m sure you’ll have a feast for music. 
Yours,
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假定你是某国际越野赛（cross-country race）的负责人李华，请你给参与比赛的外国朋友发一封电子邮件，告知原定于下周五举行的越野赛有所变化，内容包括：
1.告知变化；2.解释原因；3.相关安排。
注意：1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 可适当加入细节，使内容充实、行文连贯。
Dear foreign friends,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
2．假设你是学生李津。你的英国朋友Chris热爱学习汉语，上周他在邮件中向你询问“活雷锋”这一表达是什么意思。请根据以下提示回复邮件：
(1 )解释“活雷锋”的意思；            注意：         
(2)举一个身边活雷锋”的例子；           (1)词数不少于80；
(3)鼓励他继续学习汉语。               (2)可适当加入细节,使内容充实、行文连贯；
参考词汇：活雷锋a living Lei Feng
Dear Chris,
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Jing
3．假定你是李华，你的留学生朋友Tom很想了解即将来临的中国传统节日“端午节”。请写一封电子邮件介绍相关情况。内容包括：
1. 节日基本情况；
2. 传统活动。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Dear Tom, 
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours
Li Hua
4．假定你是李华，你们学校开设了中国传统文化实践课(Chinese traditional culture practice class)。请给你的英国好友Peter写一封邮件，分享你上课的感受，内容包括：
1．课程内容，如书法、剪纸、国画等；
2．个人感受，如课程的意义，个人的收获；
3．邀请对方体验课程。
注意：1．词数80个左右；2．增加细节以使行文连贯。
Dear Peter,
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
5．假如你叫李华，你的美国朋友Steven对中国传统文化（Traditional Chinese Culture）感兴趣，并且正在学习中文，你校将举办中国诗词比赛(Chinese Poetry Contest)，请给他发一封电子邮件告知此事，主要内容包括：
1.活动简介
时间：下周日晚上七点。
地点：学校礼堂。
意义：提高中文水平，更好地了解并传播中国文化，丰富校园生活等等。
2.建议并且鼓励他参加。 
 3.预祝他取得好成绩。
相关词汇：学校礼堂school hall，提高improve，传播spread，丰富enrich。
注意：1.词数80左右； 2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
6．假定你是李华，你的英国朋友Peter来信询问你校上周组织的诗歌朗诵比赛（poetry recitation competition）的情况。请给他回信，内容包括：
1.介绍比赛的目的；
2.你参加此次活动的收获。
注意：
1.写作词数应为80个左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Peter, 
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Best regards, 
Li Hua
7．假定你是李华，你的英国朋友Terry来信询问你校“课间10分钟”活动的开展情况，请给他回复一封邮件。内容包括：
1.活动目的；
2.活动情况；
3.活动效果。
注意：
1.写作词数应为80左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Terry,
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
8．假定你是李华，重庆某中学高三学生。在寒假期间，你作为交换生（exchange student） 将前往美国进行为期三周的交流活动，你被安排在Peter家寄宿。请你用英语给Peter写一封email。要点如下：
1. 自我情况介绍；
2. 告之自己的生活习惯；
3. 询问注意事项。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Dear Peter,
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours, 
Lihua
9．假如你是李华，南京大学的灾难专家陈教授将于本周六上午9点在你们学校阶梯教室举办一个安全报告会，你用英语给你的美籍同学Mary发一封email，通知她去听报告。
内容包括：
1.报告内容：如何预防龙卷风(tornadoes)、飓风(hurricanes)等灾害，以及遇到灾害时如何保护自己；
2.注意事项：如按时参加、认真听讲做记录、举手或递纸条询问等。
注意：1.词数80左右；
2.可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Dear Mary,  
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
10．假定你是李华，你的美国笔友Tom发来邮件，提到他对中国所取得的科技成就感到无比钦佩，想了解一些中国科学家的事迹。请你用英语给他写一封邮件，为他介绍一位你最喜欢的中国科学家，内容包括：
1.科学家介绍；
2.对你的影响。
注意：
1.词数80左右；
2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Tom, 
I’m glad that you show admiration for Chinese scientific achievement. 
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours, 
Li Hua
参考答案
1．Dear foreign friends,
I am writing to inform you of a change about the upcoming cross-country race scheduled for next Friday. 
The reason for this change is to ensure the safety and smooth running of the race. Recent weather forecasts have predicted unfavorable conditions for Friday, including heavy rain and thunderstorms, which could pose risks to participants.
To ensure that all participants have the best possible experience, we reschedule the race to Sunday to provide better conditions for everyone involved.
If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本书面表达是一篇应用文写作，要求用英文写一封电子邮件。告知外国朋友原定于下周五举行的越野赛有所变化。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
关于：about→regarding
即将到来的：upcoming→forthcoming
提供：provide→supply
联系：contact →get in touch with
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：To ensure that all participants have the best possible experience, we reschedule the race to Sunday to provide better conditions for everyone involved.
拓展句：In order that all participants can have the best possible experience, we reschedule the race to Sunday to provide better conditions for everyone involved.
【高分句型1】Recent weather forecasts have predicted unfavorable conditions for Friday, including heavy rain and thunderstorms, which could pose risks to participants. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. (运用了if引导的条件状语从句)
2．Dear Chris，
Happy to hear from you. Knowing that you have difficulty understanding the expression “Huo Lei Feng”, I’m delighted to offer you some help. “Huo Lei Feng”, which means “living Lei Feng”,  is an expression referring to one who selflessly helps others. Lei Feng was a soldier who devoted his lifetime to helping those in need. For over sixty years Lei Feng has been a household name to the Chinese people. Learning from Lei Feng has become an important element of our national spirit Take my friend Li Hua as an example. He pays regular visits to a nursing home on weekends to help the elderly clean their rooms and read newspapers for them. We would say he is a living Lei Feng.
I’m very much impressed by your hard work in learning Chinese. Keep it up! If you have any questions, feel free to ask me. I’ll be your “living Lei Feng” always.
Yours,
Li J in
【写作解析】本篇书面表达是一篇应用文。要求考生给英国朋友Chris写信，解释“活雷锋”这一表达是什么意思。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
高兴的：delighted→cheerful
提供某人某物：offer sb. sth.→provide sb. with sth.
重要的：important→essential/significant
帮助：help→assist
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：He pays regular visit to a nursing home on weekends to help the elderly clean their rooms and read newspapers for them.
拓展句：He pays regular visit to a nursing home on weekends so that he can help the elderly clean their rooms and read newspapers for them.
[高分句型1]Knowing that you have difficulty understanding the expression “Huo Lei Feng”, I’m delighted to offer you some help.（运用了现在分词作状语和that引导宾语从句）
[高分句型2]“Huo Lei Feng”, which means “living Lei Feng”, is an expression referring to one who selflessly helps others.（运用了which引导非限制性定语从句和who引导限制性定语从句）
3．Dear Tom,
As you’re interested in Chinese traditional festivals, I’d like to tell you about the upcoming Dragon Boat Festival. 
It falls on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. To remember the famous poet Qu Yuan, people eat sticky rice dumplings called zongzi, which symbolize the rice balls thrown into the river to keep the fish from eating Qu Yuan’s body. One of the most important traditions is dragon boat racing, which symbolizes the search for Qu Yuan. 
I hope this gives you an overview of the Dragon Boat Festival. If you have any questions or want to join me to celebrate, please let me know. 
Yours
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。你的留学生朋友Tom很想了解即将来临的中国传统节日“端午节”。请你写一封电子邮件介绍相关情况。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
告诉：tell→inform
著名的：famous→well-known
重要的：important→essential
庆祝：celebrate→observe
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：One of the most important traditions is dragon boat racing, which symbolizes the search for Qu Yuan.
拓展句：One of the most important traditions is dragon boat racing, symbolizing the search for Qu Yuan.
【高分句型1】To remember the famous poet Qu Yuan, people eat sticky rice dumplings called zongzi, which symbolize the rice balls thrown into the river to keep the fish from eating Qu Yuan’s body.（运用了which引导的非限定性定语从句）
【高分句型2】If you have any questions or want to join me to celebrate, please let me know.（运用了if引导的条件状语从句）
4．Dear Peter,
I’m writing to share with you my experience of taking the Chinese traditional culture practice class in our school.
The course covers a wide range of topics, including calligraphy, paper cutting, Chinese painting, and tea ceremony. Through these courses, I have gained a deeper understanding of Chinese traditional culture and its rich heritage. Not only does it enhance my cultural awareness, but it also provides me with a platform to explore and appreciate the beauty of Chinese traditions.
If you have the opportunity, I would love to show you some of the skills I have learned.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。学校开设了中国传统文化实践课(Chinese traditional culture practice class)，要求考生给英国好友Peter写一封邮件，分享上课的感受。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
涵盖：cover → contain
获得：gain → obtain
传统的：traditional → conventional
增强：enhance → strengthen
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：The course covers a wide range of topics, including calligraphy, paper cutting, Chinese painting, and tea ceremony.
拓展句：The course, which includes calligraphy, paper cutting, Chinese painting, and tea ceremony, covers a wide range of topics.
[高分句型1] Not only does it enhance my cultural awareness, but it also provides me with a platform to explore and appreciate the beauty of Chinese traditions. (运用了倒装句型)
[高分句型2] If you have the opportunity, I would love to show you some of the skills I have learned. (运用了从属连词if引导条件状语从句和省略关系代词的限制性定语从句)
5．Dear Steven,
How is everything going? I have a good news for you. A Chinese Poetry Contest will be held by our school. Knowing that you are fond of Chinese culture, I am writing to you with the purpose of inviting you to take part in it.
The event will take place in our school hall on next Sunday. The aim of the program is to inherit and spread the Chinese traditional culture. I am convinced that your Chinese will be greatly improved and you will get a better understanding of our Chinese poetry. Moreover, there is a chance that you can make some like-minded friends.
I sincerely hope you can accept my invitation. I am looking forward to your early reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生向给美国朋友Steven写封信，告知其学习将举办中国诗词比赛，建议并鼓励他参加。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
参加：take part in → participate in
提高：improve → enhance
此外：moreover→ what’s more
真诚地：sincerely→ genuinely
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：The event will take place in our school hall on next Sunday. The aim of the program is to inherit and spread the Chinese traditional culture.
拓展句：The event, the aim of which is to inherit and spread the Chinese traditional culture, will take place in our school hall on next Sunday.
【高分句型1】Knowing that you are fond of Chinese culture, I am writing to you with the purpose of inviting you to take part in it.（运用了现在分词作状语及that引导的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】I am convinced that your Chinese will be greatly improved and you will get a better understanding of our Chinese poetry.（运用了省略连接词that的宾语从句）
6．Dear Peter,
Last Friday, our school organized a poetry recitation competition in the school hall. The competition was held to promote the appreciation of poetry among students. It was a great opportunity to share and explore the beauty of poetry. 
I actively participated in this competition. Through this competition, I not only deepened my understanding and appreciation of poetry but also learned more about its power to express emotions and ideas. 
If you have any questions or want to know more about the competition, please feel free to write back. 
Best regards. 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生给英国朋友Peter写一封回信，告诉他自己学校上周组织的诗歌朗诵比赛（poetry recitation competition）的情况。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
参加：participate in→join in
促进：promote→boost
机会： opportunity→chance
积极地：actively→energetically
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：The competition was held to promote the appreciation of poetry among students.
拓展句：The competition was held in order that we could promote the appreciation of poetry among students.
【高分句型1】It was a great opportunity to share and explore the beauty of poetry.(运用了it作形式主语不定式作真正主语的结构)
【高分句型2】If you have any questions or want to know more about the competition, please feel free to write back.(运用了if引导的条件状语从句和祈使句)
7．Dear Terry,
How are you doing? I’m writing to tell you about the “ten-minute break” activities in our school.
The purpose of these activities is to ensure that students really have a break and enjoy themselves. During the break, there are various activities such as rope skip-ping, playing basketball, and so on.
These activities turn out to be a great success. Not only do they enrich our school life but they also build up our body. Students are full of energy and enthusiasm in the next class.
Best wishes!
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。假定考生是李华，你的英国朋友Terry来信询问你校“课间10分钟”活动的开展情况，请给他回复一封邮件。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
告诉：tell…about→inform…of
确信：ensure→make sure
充满：be full of→be filled with
增强体质：build up our body→strengthen our body
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：During the break, there are various activities such as rope skip-ping, playing basketball, and so on.
拓展句：During the break, there are various activities that include rope skip-ping, playing basketball, and so on.
【高分句型1】The purpose of these activities is to ensure that students really have a break and enjoy themselves.（运用了that引导的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】Not only do they enrich our school life but they also build up our body.（运用了部分倒装句）
8．Dear Peter,
My name is Li Hua, a senior 3 student from Chongqing, China. I’m so lucky to be chosen as an exchange student to pay a three-week visit to the US and will be hosted in your home. Firstly, I’d like to say thank you for your reception during my stay in the US.
I will be a nice guest. I don’t smoke but I don’t mind if anybody smokes. Besides, I enjoy various foods, including pork, beef and mutton and I’m not particular about food. What’s more, I like pets, so it’s OK for me if your family keeps some pets.
If you have any requests or suggestions for me, don’t hesitate to tell me so that I can get well prepared before I go and pay attention to my behaviors when in your home. I believe I will have a good time and learn a lot in your home!
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。在寒假期间，你作为交换生（exchange student） 将前往美国进行为期三周的交流活动，将被安排在Peter家寄宿。要求考生给寄宿家庭写一封信，介绍自己的一些情况，告知对方自己的生活习惯，并询问注意事项。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
各种各样的：various→all kinds of
此外：besides→in addition
建议：suggestion→advice
对……挑剔：be particular about→be picky about
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Firstly, I’d like to say thank you for your reception during my stay in the US.
拓展句：Firstly, I’d like to say thank you for the reception you will provide during my stay in the US.
【高分句型1】What’s more, I like pets, so it’s OK for me if your family keeps some pets. (运用了so连接的并列句和if引导的条件状语从句)
【高分句型2】I believe I will have a good time and learn a lot in your home! (运用了省略that的宾语从句)
9．Dear Mary,
I have something important to tell you. There will be a safety lecture in the lecture room of our school this Saturday. It is about how to prevent tornadoes, hurricanes and other natural disasters and how we should protect ourselves when we are caught in them. The lecture will be given by Professor Chen, a famous disaster expert from Nanjing University. It begins at 9:00 in the morning. All of us are required to attend it on time, listen and take notes carefully. If we have any question, we can raise our hands or write them down on a piece of paper and pass it to the expert. Please do remember the time and the place and be sure not to be late. See you then.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生用英语给美籍同学Mary发一封email，通知她去听一个安全报告会。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
重要的：important→significant/vital/crucial
保护：protect→safeguard/conserve/preserve
举起：raise→put up/lift
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：The lecture will be given by Professor Chen, a famous disaster expert from Nanjing University. It begins at 9:00 in the morning.
拓展句：The lecture, which begins at 9:00 in the morning, will be given by Professor Chen, a famous disaster expert from Nanjing University.
【高分句型1】It is about how to prevent tornadoes, hurricanes and other natural disasters and how we should protect ourselves when we are caught in them.（运用了how to do作宾语、how引导的宾语从句和when引导的时间状语从句。）
【高分句型2】If we have any question, we can raise our hands or write them down on a piece of paper and pass it to the expert.（运用了if引导的条件状语从句）
10．Dear Tom,
I’m glad that you show admiration for Chinese scientific achievement.
One of my favorite Chinese scientists is Tu Youyou. She is renowned for her discovery of artemisinin, a breakthrough in the treatment of malaria. Tu Youyou’s work has had a profound impact on global health, saving countless lives in malaria-endemic regions.
Personally, Tu Youyou’s dedication to scientific research and her perseverance in the face of challenges have inspired me. Her groundbreaking discovery highlights the importance of scientific innovation in addressing global health challenges.
Sincerely, if you want to know more about this, you can write to me again.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。美国笔友Tom发来邮件，提到他对中国所取得的科技成就感到无比钦佩，想了解一些中国科学家的事迹。要求考生用英语给他写一封邮件，为他介绍一位你最喜欢的中国科学家。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
知名的： renowned →famous
影响：impact→ influence
奉献：dedication→devotion
真挚地：sincerely→ genuinely
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：One of my favorite Chinese scientists is Tu Youyou. 
拓展句：One of my favorite Chinese scientists is Tu Youyou, who is a great female scientist.
【高分句型1】Tu Youyou’s work has had a profound impact on global health, saving countless lives in malaria-endemic regions.（运用了现在分词作状语）
【高分句型2】 Her groundbreaking discovery highlights the importance of scientific innovation in addressing global health challenges.（运用了动名词作宾语的结构）
