documents.local_content:
第 1 页
告知信


第 2 页
【试题探究】
　　假定你是晨光中学高三学生李华, 你校于6月8日举办了成人礼活动, 你的英国朋友Chris很想了解该活动。你于当晚给Chris写一封信, 介绍相关情况, 内容包括: 
　　1. 成人礼活动内容(成长点滴回顾等); 
　　2. 对活动的感受; 
　　3对自己未来的展望。

第 3 页
注意: 
　　1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可以适当加入细节, 以使内容充实、行文连贯。
参考词汇: 成人礼 the coming-of-age ceremony

第 4 页
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称为主, 第二人称为辅
时态
一般现在时, 一般过去时
要点
1. 介绍成人礼活动内容
2. 成人礼活动感受

第 5 页
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  这次的成人礼仪式深深地打动了我们, 并且我们从中意识到了责任感始终
伴随着我们的成长过程。
一般表达:  We are all deeply moved by the ceremony and we realize that the sense of 
responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth from it. 
句式升级(定语从句)
We are all deeply moved by the ceremony, ___________________________________
_____________________________________________________. 
from which we realize that the sense of 
responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth

第 6 页
要点2:  我明白了成长的意义。
一般表达: ________________________________________. 
句式升级(倒装句)
这就是我对成长的理解。
________________________________________
I have understood the meaning of growing up
Such is my understanding about growing up. 

第 7 页
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear Chris, 
　　I’m so glad to hear from you. In your last letter, you showed great interest in the coming-of-age ceremony held in our school. The following is a brief introduction to the ceremony. 

第 8 页
　　The ceremony was scheduled on June 8, during which we reviewed the past events. We are all deeply moved by the ceremony, from which we realize that the sense of responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth. We are determined to follow the examples of our excellent schoolmates and make ourselves useful to the whole society. Such is my understanding about growing up. What about yours?
　　Looking forward to your reply. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 9 页
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明目的、原因等
①Delighted to learn that an important volleyball game will be launched in our school stadium, I’m writing to extend my excitement and inform you of some relevant information. 
很高兴得知一场重要的排球比赛将在我们学校的体育场举行, 我写信是为了表达我的兴奋, 并告诉你一些相关的信息。
②I’m more than delighted to tell you that an international cultural festival is to be held in my city. 
我非常高兴地告知你们国际文化节将在我市举行。

第 10 页
2. 篇中——详细介绍, 告知具体信息
①First and foremost, the competition to be held will begin at 2 p. m. and last for roughly 3 hours. 
首先, 比赛将于下午两点开始, 持续大约3个小时。
②Then you will be taken to the Tea Room, where you can taste some famous Chinese tea and watch performances of tea art. 
有人将你带至茶室, 品尝中国名茶、观看茶艺表演。

第 11 页
3. 结尾——作总结, 盼回复
①I highly expect the experience to be rewarding, perfectly mixing learning and fun. 
我非常希望这段经历是有益的, 将学习和乐趣完美地结合在一起。
②It would be nice if you could provide a bit more information on the arrangements of the meeting. 你要能提供更多有关此次会议安排的信息, 那将再好不过了。

第 12 页
【拓展训练】
　　假定你是李华, 你因故不能参加下周二的音乐会, 想把票转赠给你的留学生朋友John。请你给他写一封邮件告知相关情况, 内容包括: 
　　1. 你不能参加音乐会的理由; 
　　2. 音乐会的基本情况; 
　　3. 如何获取门票。
注意: 1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
_________________________________________________________________

第 13 页
【参考范文】
Dear John, 
　　How’s everything going? I’ve got the chance to enjoy a concert. However, it’s a regret that I have to go to meet an honored foreign friend then. Thus, you’re the first person I want to present the ticket. 

第 14 页
　　The concert will be held in the city Cultural Plaza at 7 p. m. next Friday, lasting two hours. Some famous musicians from home and abroad will be invited to show their great works, among which piano pieces will bring you fascination. 
　　If convenient, please come to my classroom for the ticket. I’m sure you’ll have a feast for music. 
Li Hua

sections.text: 告知信

注意: 
　　1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可以适当加入细节, 以使内容充实、行文连贯。
参考词汇: 成人礼 the coming-of-age ceremony

Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称为主, 第二人称为辅
时态
一般现在时, 一般过去时
要点
1. 介绍成人礼活动内容
2. 成人礼活动感受

Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  这次的成人礼仪式深深地打动了我们, 并且我们从中意识到了责任感始终
伴随着我们的成长过程。
一般表达:  We are all deeply moved by the ceremony and we realize that the sense of 
responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth from it. 
句式升级(定语从句)
We are all deeply moved by the ceremony, ___________________________________
_____________________________________________________. 
from which we realize that the sense of 
responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth

要点2:  我明白了成长的意义。
一般表达: ________________________________________. 
句式升级(倒装句)
这就是我对成长的理解。
________________________________________
I have understood the meaning of growing up
Such is my understanding about growing up.

Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear Chris, 
　　I’m so glad to hear from you. In your last letter, you showed great interest in the coming-of-age ceremony held in our school. The following is a brief introduction to the ceremony.

The ceremony was scheduled on June 8, during which we reviewed the past events. We are all deeply moved by the ceremony, from which we realize that the sense of responsibility always accompanies the process of our growth. We are determined to follow the examples of our excellent schoolmates and make ourselves useful to the whole society. Such is my understanding about growing up. What about yours?
　　Looking forward to your reply. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明目的、原因等
①Delighted to learn that an important volleyball game will be launched in our school stadium, I’m writing to extend my excitement and inform you of some relevant information. 
很高兴得知一场重要的排球比赛将在我们学校的体育场举行, 我写信是为了表达我的兴奋, 并告诉你一些相关的信息。
②I’m more than delighted to tell you that an international cultural festival is to be held in my city. 
我非常高兴地告知你们国际文化节将在我市举行。

2. 篇中——详细介绍, 告知具体信息
①First and foremost, the competition to be held will begin at 2 p. m. and last for roughly 3 hours. 
首先, 比赛将于下午两点开始, 持续大约3个小时。
②Then you will be taken to the Tea Room, where you can taste some famous Chinese tea and watch performances of tea art. 
有人将你带至茶室, 品尝中国名茶、观看茶艺表演。

3. 结尾——作总结, 盼回复
①I highly expect the experience to be rewarding, perfectly mixing learning and fun. 
我非常希望这段经历是有益的, 将学习和乐趣完美地结合在一起。
②It would be nice if you could provide a bit more information on the arrangements of the meeting. 你要能提供更多有关此次会议安排的信息, 那将再好不过了。

【参考范文】
Dear John, 
　　How’s everything going? I’ve got the chance to enjoy a concert. However, it’s a regret that I have to go to meet an honored foreign friend then. Thus, you’re the first person I want to present the ticket.

The concert will be held in the city Cultural Plaza at 7 p. m. next Friday, lasting two hours. Some famous musicians from home and abroad will be invited to show their great works, among which piano pieces will bring you fascination. 
　　If convenient, please come to my classroom for the ticket. I’m sure you’ll have a feast for music. 
Li Hua

感谢信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 经常帮助你学习英语的朋友Alex即将返回自己的国家。请你写一封邮件, 内容包括: 
　　1. 表示感谢; 
　　2. 回顾Alex对你的帮助; 
　　3. 临别祝愿。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称(I)为主, 第二人称(you)为辅
时态
一般过去时, 一般现在时
要点
1. 点明写作目的, 感谢对方的帮助
2. 具体指出曾经的帮助
3. 临别祝愿
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  你教我如何学英语。
一般表达:  You taught me how to learn English. 
句式升级 (强调句)
是你教我如何学英语。
It was you who taught me how to learn English. 
要点2: 你帮助我提高了英语并且给了我更多学习的自信。
一般表达:  You helped improve my English and gave me more confidence in learning. 
句式升级 (倒装句)
你不但帮助我提高了英语, 并且给了我更多学习的自信。
Not only did you help improve my English, but also you gave me more confidence in learning. 
Step 3: 衔接然成篇
Dear Alex, 
　　I’ve heard that you’re leaving China soon, so I’m writing to express my sincere blessing and thanks. 
　　I can well remember there was a time when I had difficulty in learning English. It was you who taught me how to learn English. Under your patient guidance, I gradually made progress and began to become interested in English. Not only did you help improve my English, but also you gave me more confidence in learning. Thanks again for your generous help. 
　　I wish you a pleasant journey home. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 写信原因和目的
①I’m writing to thank you for helping me spend wonderful days in London. 
我写信感谢你帮我在伦敦度过快乐的日子。
②I am writing to express/show/convey my sincere thanks to you for your help. 
我写信真诚地感谢你的帮助。
2. 篇中——描述对方对自己的帮助
①Without/But for your help(If it were not for your help), I would not have made so much progress in my English. 
要是没有你的帮助, 我的英语不会取得如此大的进步。
②Had it not been for your patient guidance, I couldn’t have prepared so well. 
如果没有你耐心的指导, 我不可能准备得这么好。
3. 结尾——表达谢意
①Again, no words are strong enough to convey how grateful I am. 
再一次, 没有任何言语能表达我的感激之情。
②Your kindness and help will always be remembered. 
我将永远铭记你的善意和帮助。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华, 你在你校举办的英语辩论赛上取得了不错的成绩。请给你的留学生朋友Chris写一封感谢信, 感谢他对你的帮助, 内容包括: 
　　1. 表达感谢; 
　　2. 感谢的原因; 
　　3. 表达祝愿。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
【参考范文】
Dear Chris, 
　　I’m writing to express my sincere gratitude to you for the help you offered me. 
　　To be honest, your assistance has a great impact on me. It was you who made my English improve greatly. Had it not been for your patient guidance, I couldn’t have prepared so well. Without your aid, I wouldn’t have done well in the English debate contest held in our school. I’ll bear your kindness in mind forever. 
　　Again, I’d like to thank you for what you did for me and wish you all the best. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假定你是李华，你被你心仪的大学录取了。请你给你在高中期间的外教Mr Potter写一封邮件表达对他的感谢，内容包括：
1.对老师的辛勤工作表示感谢；
2.感谢老师对自己的教导和帮助；
3.表达对老师的祝愿。
注意：1.可适当补充信息，以使行文连贯；
2.词数为80左右。
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
2．假定你是李华，前一段时间你的身体状况一直不好。你的网友Oliver时常关心着你。请你用英语写一封邮件，内容包括：
1.目前状况及感谢；
2.介绍健身计划。
注意：
1.写作词数应为80左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Oliver,
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
3．假定你是李华，你在你校上周举办的英语演讲比赛中获得了一等奖。此前，你的交换生好友Peter给予了你很多帮助。请你给他写封邮件，内容包括：
1. 分享获奖的喜悦；
2. 感谢他的帮助；
3. 邀请他到你家做客以表谢意。
注意：1. 写作词数应为80个左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Peter, 
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
4．假定你是学生会主席李华，学生会举办的首届生活技能云端展示活动Work Creates a Better Life得到了外教Patrick的大力支持。活动已经圆满结束，请你给他写一封感谢信。内容包括：
1．表示感谢；
2．外教的帮助；
3．活动的反响。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；
2．可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．假设你是李华，你的英国伦敦的朋友Peter在你暑期在伦敦旅游期间对你热情款待和帮助，写信对他表示感谢，内容包括：
1. 表示感谢；
2. 回顾你在伦敦时Peter对你的帮助；
3. 再次表达感谢，表达回报的愿望；
注意：1. 词数80到100之间；2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
Dear Peter,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours
Li hua
6．假定你是李华，你的交换生朋友 Robert 上周末参加了你校英语社团举办的探访养老院活动，请你给他写封邮件，内容包括：
1. 表示感谢；
2. 回顾活动内容；
3. 期待后续参与。
注意：1. 写作词数应为80 左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Robert,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours
Li Hua
7．假设你是高一学生李华。正在英国某国际中学交换学习。上周末你的同学Mark邀请你参加了学校组织的世界图书日（4 月 23 日）（World Book and Copyright Day）。请你给Mark写一封邮件。
内容包括：
1. 感谢邀请；
2. 分享感受。
注意：
1. 词数 80 左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
8．假设你是李华，上周六一外国乘客John发现了你落在地铁上的相机，并根据名牌上的Email联系你，将相机寄回。现你已经收到相机。请你给John写一封电子邮件。内容包括：
1. 事情过程；
2. 你的感受；
3. 表达感谢。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
9．假设你是李华，梁教授去年六月推荐你去悉尼大学学习，现在你已经被悉尼大学录取，请写一封信向梁教授表示感谢。
悉尼大学Sydney University；被录取be admitted into/to
Dear Professor Liang,
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours truly, 
Li Hua
10．假定你是李华，现在在美国某高中做交换生，你因为受伤在家休养，这期间有不少同班同学来看望你。现在你即将康复，请给他们写一封感谢信，内容包括：
1. 回忆同学们为你做的事；
2. 表达你的感谢之情。
注意：
1. 词数80左右； 
2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
参考答案
1．Dear Mr Potter,
I’m glad to write to share with you my happiness of being admitted to college, which I have been dreaming of. Firstly, I’d like to express my gratitude for your excellent teaching and your care as well as love for me! It’s you who cheered me up. Never will I forget what you said — doors open to the very man with full confidence and instant action. Without your help, I could never have enjoyed such a joyful harvest. And I really appreciate your instructions.
I wish more and more of your students could go to their ideal colleges. Wish you all the best!
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。假定你是李华，你被你心仪的大学录取了。请你给你在高中期间的外教Mr Potter写一封邮件表达对他的感谢。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
感激：gratitude→thankfulness
表达：express→extend
高兴的：glad→delighted
快乐：happiness→joy
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：Without your help, I could never have enjoyed such a joyful harvest. And I really appreciate your instructions.
拓展句：I really appreciate your instructions because without your help, I could never have enjoyed such a joyful harvest.
[高分句型1] I’m glad to write to share with you my happiness of being admitted to college, which I have been dreaming of. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] Never will I forget what you said — doors open to the very man with full confidence and instant action. (运用了否定词Never置于句首引起的部分倒装以及what引导的宾语从句)
2．Dear Oliver,
This winter, the cold was very popular and I lacked exercise, so my physical condition has been poor. It is your concern and encouragement that have continuously strengthened my confidence. I feel warm to have friends like you.
Spring has arrived. A year’s plan lies in spring. I am planning to develop a detailed fitness plan according to what you said. Firstly, participate in more outdoor activities and breathe fresh air. Secondly, handle the relationship between learning and health correctly, and emphasize the role of physical health in learning. In the future, I will continue to communicate with you about this situation. I also wish you better health.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生对于“前一段时间你的身体状况一直不好，你的网友Oliver时常关心着你”这一情况，用英语写一封回复邮件。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
缺乏：lacked→ was short of
增强，提升：strengthened → enhanced
参加：participate in→ take part in
强调：emphasize→ stress
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：This winter, the cold was very popular and I lacked exercise, so my physical condition has been poor.
拓展句：This winter, the cold was very popular and I lacked exercise, which led to my physical condition poor.
【高分句型1】It is your concern and encouragement that have continuously strengthened my confidence.（运用了It is…that…的强调句式。）
【高分句型2】I am planning to develop a detailed fitness plan according to what you said.（运用了连接代词what引导的宾语从句。）
3．Dear Peter,
I am thrilled to share with you that I just won the first prize in our school’s English speech competition last week! This accomplishment is undoubtedly a result of your invaluable assistance.
Your insights, suggestions, and encouragement were crucial in helping me prepare for the competition. I really appreciate your help.
To express my heartfelt gratitude, I would like to invite you to my home for a visit. It would be a pleasure to have you as my guest and to thank you in person for all your help.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给交换生好友Peter写封邮件，告诉他在上周举办的英语演讲比赛中获得了一等奖，同时感谢他的帮助。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
激动的：thrilled→ excited
帮助：assistance→ help
至关重要的：crucial→ vital
感谢：appreciate→ thank
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Your insights, suggestions, and encouragement were crucial in helping me prepare for the competition.
拓展句：Your insights, suggestions, and encouragement were crucial, which helped me prepare for the competition.
【高分句型1】I am thrilled to share with you that I just won the first prize in our school’s English speech competition last week!（运用了从属连词that引导的宾语从句。）
【高分句型2】To express my heartfelt gratitude, I would like to invite you to my home for a visit.（运用了非谓语动词中的动词不定式To express作目的状语。）
4．Dear Patrick, 
I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your kind help in the Work Creates a Better Life, which has turned out to be an amazing success.
It is so nice of you to have offered us a variety of presentation skills and creative suggestions on our show. It was under your professional guidance that the participants showed their skills of cooking, gardening, etc. Their impressive performances definitely fueled their passion for daily life skills. Most importantly, this activity helped students receive wide admiration and gain their tremendous confidence.
Many thanks for your time and support.
Yours, 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生写一封感谢信，感谢外教Patrick对学生会举办的首届生活技能云端展示活动的大力支持。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
感激：gratitude→appreciation
惊人的：amazing→astonishing
表达：express→convey
各种各样的：a variety of→various
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Their impressive performances definitely fueled their passion for daily life skills.
拓展句：Their performances which impressed people, definitely fueled their passion for daily life skills.
【高分句型1】I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your kind help in the Work Creates a Better Life, which has turned out to be an amazing success.(运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】It was under your professional guidance that the participants showed their skills of cooking, gardening, etc.(运用了it is...that强调句型)
5．Dear Peter,
I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your warm hospitality and assistance during my summer travel in London.
From the moment I arrived, you welcomed me with open arms and made me feel at home in your beautiful city. I still remember how you patiently showed me around the city, introducing me to its hidden gems and taking me to your favorite local spots. Moreover, your willingness to accompany me on various excursions made the trip even more enjoyable and memorable.
Once again, thank you from the bottom of my heart for being such an amazing host and friend. I would love to have the opportunity to host you in my country someday so that I can return the favor and show you the same level of hospitality and gratitude that you showed me.
Yours,
Lihua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。你的英国伦敦的朋友Peter在你暑期在伦敦旅游期间对你热情款待和帮助，请你给他写信对他表示感谢。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
诚挚的：sincere→genuine
此外：moreover→ what’s more
各种各样的：various→a variety of
机会：opportunity→ chance
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your warm hospitality and assistance during my summer travel in London.
拓展句：I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your warm hospitality and assistance during my summer travel in London, which are greatly precious for me.
【高分句型1】I still remember how you patiently showed me around the city, introducing me to its hidden gems and taking me to your favorite local spots. （运用了how 引导的宾语从句以及现在分词作伴随状语）
【高分句型2】 I would love to have the opportunity to host you in my country someday so that I can return the favor and show you the same level of hospitality and gratitude that you showed me.（运用了so that引导的目的状语从句）
6．
Dear Robert,
Knowing that you participated in the activity of visiting the nursing home last weekend, I would like to express my thanks to you. 
It is universally acknowledged that respecting the elderly is a traditional Chinese culture. To carry forward our tradition and also help the elderly, the English community launched an activity at the nursing home last Saturday. As soon as we got there early in the morning, we gave them our gifts and did some cleaning for the elderly. What a great day!
We all benefited a lot from this activity and hope we can participate in more meaningful activities in the future.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。交换生朋友 Robert 上周末参加了你校英语社团举办的探访养老院活动，要求考生按照要求给他写封邮件。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
参与：participate in→ take part in
感谢：thanks→ gratitude
一致地：universally→ solidly
承认：acknowledge→ recognize
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Knowing that you participated in the activity of visiting the nursing home last weekend, I would like to express my thanks to you.
拓展句：
As I know that you participated in the activity of visiting the nursing home last weekend, I would like to express my thanks to you.
【高分句型1】Knowing that you participated in the activity of visiting the nursing home last weekend, I would like to express my thanks to you.（运用了现在分词Knowing作原因状语、that引导的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】It is universally acknowledged that respecting the elderly is a traditional Chinese culture.（运用了It作形式主语、that引导的主语从句、动名词 respecting作主语）
7．
Dear Mark,
Thank you for inviting me to the World Book and Copyright Day last weekend. It was an amazing experience and I thoroughly enjoyed spending time with you. As we all know, reading is beneficial to us. In this activity, reading good books enriched our mind, broadened our horizons and gave us wisdom as well. Most importantly, being exposed to abundant Chinese folk stories gave me great pleasure. And I am looking forward to more opportunities to read  good books with you in future.
Best regards.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。上周末同学Mark邀请考生参加了学校组织的世界图书日，要求考生按照要求给Mark写一封邮件表示感谢以及分享感受。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
令人大为惊奇的：amazing→ surprising
有益的：beneficial→ helpful
大量的：abundant→ massive
快乐：pleasure→ joy
2.句式拓展
同义句转换 
原句：As we all know, reading is beneficial to us.
拓展句：It is known that reading is beneficial to us.
【高分句型1】As we all know, reading is beneficial to us.（运用了As引导的非限制性定语从句）
【高分句型2】Most importantly, being exposed to abundant Chinese folk stories gave me great pleasure.（运用了动名词短语being exposed to abundant Chinese folk stories作主语）
8．Dear John,
I’m Li Hua. I’m writing to express my sincere gratitude for your kind assistance in returning my lost camera.
Last Saturday, I took the subway and accidentally left my camera on it. Later, I received an email from you, informing me that you had found my camera and would mail it back to me. I was truly touched by your thoughtfulness and honesty.
I have already received the camera and everything is in good condition. Your kindness has saved me from the inconvenience and frustration of losing an important possession. Once again, thank you for your help.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文写作中的感谢信。要求考生给外国乘客John写封电子邮件，感谢其寄回自己丢失的相机。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
真诚的：sincere→ genuine
意外地：accidentally → by accident/by chance
感动的：touched → moved
重要的：important→ significant/essential
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：I have already received the camera and everything is in good condition.
拓展句：I have already received the camera which is in good condition.
【高分句型1】Later, I received an email from you, informing me that you had found my camera and would mail it back to me.（运用了that引导的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】I have already received the camera and everything is in good condition.（运用了and连接的并列句）
9．Dear Professor Liang,
I am writing to express my sincere gratitude to you. Had it not for your help, I wouldn't have been admitted into Sydney University. Last June, when I applied to become a student of Sydney University, you really gave me a lot of valuable help. Not only did you write a recommendation for me to the university but also gave me careful and patient instructions on how to fill the application forms and write the application letters. It is your unreserved help that enables me to obtain this splendid opportunity of further education. For the following two years I will study hard to reciprocate your sincere help and expectations with excellent grades.
Yours truly,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。假设你是李华，梁教授去年六月推荐你去悉尼大学学习，现在你已经被悉尼大学录取，请写一封信向梁教授表示感谢。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
报答：reciprocate→repay
表达：express→convey
宝贵的：valuable→precious
真地：really→truly
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：It is your unreserved help that enables me to obtain this splendid opportunity of further education.
拓展句：Had it not for your unreserved help, I wouldn't have obtained this splendid opportunity of further education.
[高分句型1] Last June, when I applied to become a student of Sydney University, you really gave me a lot of valuable help. (运用了when引导时间状语从句)
[高分句型2] Not only did you write a recommendation for me to the university but also gave me careful and patient instructions on how to fill the application forms and write the application letters. (运用了倒装句)
10．Dear classmates,
I’m writing to express my heartfelt gratitude and how much I enjoyed your visits when I suffered the injury. I clearly remember the days when you came to see me with beautiful flowers and bright smiles. Your letters and words encouraged me greatly. Most importantly, your warm company did guide me out of loneliness during my rest. I am making rapid progress towards a full recovery, and I’ll soon join you at school. 
Thank you again. I hope someday I can try my best to do something for you to return your love and help. 
Sincerely, 
Li Hua
【写作解析】本文是应用文。假定你是李华，现在在美国某高中做交换生，你因为受伤在家休养，这期间有不少同班同学来看望你。现在你即将康复，请给他们写一封感谢信，内容包括：1. 回忆同学们为你做的事；2. 表达你的感谢之情。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
真诚的：heartfelt→genuine
感激：gratitude→thankfulness
清楚地：clearly→distinctly
尽我最大努力：try my best→do my best
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Your letters and words encouraged me greatly. 
拓展句：It was your letters and words that encouraged me greatly. 
【高分句型1】 I clearly remember the days when you came to see me with beautiful flowers and bright smiles.(运用了when引导的时间状语从句)
【高分句型2】 I hope someday I can try my best to do something for you to return your love and help.(运用了省略that引导的宾语从句)

第 1 页
感谢信


第 2 页
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 经常帮助你学习英语的朋友Alex即将返回自己的国家。请你写一封邮件, 内容包括: 
　　1. 表示感谢; 
　　2. 回顾Alex对你的帮助; 
　　3. 临别祝愿。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。

第 3 页
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称(I)为主, 第二人称(you)为辅
时态
一般过去时, 一般现在时
要点
1. 点明写作目的, 感谢对方的帮助
2. 具体指出曾经的帮助
3. 临别祝愿

第 4 页
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1:  你教我如何学英语。
一般表达:  You _______________to learn English. 
句式升级 (强调句)
是你教我如何学英语。
_______________taught me how to learn English. 
taught me how 
It was you who 

第 5 页
要点2: 你帮助我提高了英语并且给了我更多学习的自信。
一般表达:  You _________________________and gave me more confidence in learning. 
句式升级 (倒装句)
你不但帮助我提高了英语, 并且给了我更多学习的自信。
______________________________________, but also you gave me more confidence in 
learning. 
helped improve my English 
Not only did you help improve my English

第 6 页
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear Alex, 
　　I’ve heard that you’re leaving China soon, so I’m writing to express my sincere blessing and thanks. 
　　I can well remember there was a time when I had difficulty in learning English. It was you who taught me how to learn English. Under your patient guidance, I gradually made progress and began to become interested in English. Not only did you help improve my English, but also you gave me more confidence in learning. Thanks again for your generous help. 
　　I wish you a pleasant journey home. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 7 页
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 写信原因和目的
①I’m writing to thank you for helping me spend wonderful days in London. 
我写信感谢你帮我在伦敦度过快乐的日子。
②I am writing to express/show/convey my sincere thanks to you for your help. 
我写信真诚地感谢你的帮助。

第 8 页
2. 篇中——描述对方对自己的帮助
①Without/But for your help(If it were not for your help), I would not have made so much progress in my English. 
要是没有你的帮助, 我的英语不会取得如此大的进步。
②Had it not been for your patient guidance, I couldn’t have prepared so well. 
如果没有你耐心的指导, 我不可能准备得这么好。

第 9 页
3. 结尾——表达谢意
①Again, no words are strong enough to convey how grateful I am. 
再一次, 没有任何言语能表达我的感激之情。
②Your kindness and help will always be remembered. 
我将永远铭记你的善意和帮助。

第 10 页
【拓展训练】
　　假定你是李华, 你在你校举办的英语辩论赛上取得了不错的成绩。请给你的留学生朋友Chris写一封感谢信, 感谢他对你的帮助, 内容包括: 
　　1. 表达感谢; 
　　2. 感谢的原因; 
　　3. 表达祝愿。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。 
_________________________________________________________________

第 11 页
【参考范文】
Dear Chris, 
　　I’m writing to express my sincere gratitude to you for the help you offered me. 
　　To be honest, your assistance has a great impact on me. It was you who made my English improve greatly. Had it not been for your patient guidance, I couldn’t have prepared so well. Without your aid, I wouldn’t have done well in the English debate contest held in our school. I’ll bear your kindness in mind forever. 
　　Again, I’d like to thank you for what you did for me and wish you all the best. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

推荐信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 你的美国网友David看完电影《哪吒之魔童降世》海外版后非常喜欢, 写信想请你再推荐一部中国电影。请你根据以下要点给他回信: 
　　1. 表示高兴; 
　　2. 推荐一部电影; 
　　3. 推荐的理由(至少两条)。
注意: 1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称 (I)为主
时态
一般现在时, 一般将来时
要点
1. 说明写信目的
2. 推荐的电影和推荐的理由
3. 表达希望
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1: 我很高兴知道你对中国电影《哪吒之魔童降世》感兴趣。
一般表达: I am glad to know you’re interested in the Chinese film, Ne Zha. 
句式升级(高级词汇, 被动语态): 
I’m delighted to know you’re fascinated by the Chinese film, Ne Zha. 
要点2:  这部动画电影也是以中国经典神话故事为基础, 和《哪吒之魔童降世》有许多相似之处。
一般表达:  This animated film is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales, and has much in common with Ne Zha. 
句式升级(定语从句): 
This animated film, which is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales, has much in common with Ne Zha. 
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear David, 
　　I’m delighted to know you’re fascinated by the Chinese film, Ne Zha. And I’m perfectly willing to recommend another impressive Chinese movie at your request. 
　　Since I know animated films are your favorites, you can’t miss Monkey King: Hero Is Back. This animated film, which is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales, has much in common with Ne Zha, so I think it’ll appeal to you. Additionally, Monkey King and Ne Zha are both regarded as heroes by Chinese people. Through these two movies, you will get a better understanding of Chinese culture. 
　　I hope you’ll find the movie well worth seeing. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明目的
①Our school’s approaching 100th birthday will be celebrated this July. Could you please recommend a student to address at the opening ceremony in English?
我们学校将在今年七月庆祝即将到来的百年校庆。你能推荐一位学生在开幕式上用英语发言吗?
②Hearing/Learning that you are coming to visit China, I would like to recommend several places of interest to you. 
听说你要来中国, 我想向你推荐几个名胜古迹。
2. 篇中——紧扣要点, 推荐理由
①He is an all-round student with excellent grades in all subjects. As a boy with great potential, he is good/skillful at solving difficult problems. 
他是一个全面的学生, 各科成绩优异。作为一个很有潜力的男孩, 他善于解决难题。
②In addition, what makes him a model student is his positive attitude towards life. 
此外, 使他成为模范学生的是他积极的生活态度。
3. 结尾——表达希望, 盼回复
①Your taking my recommendation into consideration will be highly expected. Keenly anticipate your prompt reply. 
希望您能考虑我的建议。热切期待您的及时答复。
②I do hope that you can find my recommendation beneficial. Looking forward to your early/prompt reply. 
我希望我的推荐对你有帮助。期待你的早日/及时回复。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华, 你的英国朋友Peter打算这个寒假来中国旅游, 让你推荐一个城市, 你想推荐杭州作为他旅游行程的首选。请用英语给他写封信, 内容包括: 
　　1. 推荐城市; 
　　2. 推荐理由; 
　　3. 你的祝愿。
注意: 
　　1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
【参考范文】
Dear Peter, 
　　I’m delighted to know you’re coming to China for your winter holiday. Personally, I’d like to recommend the city of Hangzhou to you. 
　　When it comes to Hangzhou, the first thing that comes to mind is West Lake, which has been a scenic spot for hundreds of years. Besides, there are many tourist attractions in and around the city, such as Tiger-running Spring, the Lingyin Monastery and Spring Dawn at Su Causeway. Most importantly, Hangzhou is home to delicious food, such as Dongpo Pork and Longjing Shrimp. 
　　I hope the nice weather and convenient transportation here can make your trip more enjoyable. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假定你是李华，你的交换生朋友William对学校开展的研学旅游活动很感兴趣。他来信希望你能给他推荐一个研学城市。请你给他回信，内容包括：
1. 推荐研学的城市；
2. 推荐理由；
3. 表示祝愿。
注意：1. 写作词数应为80左右； 
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear William,
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
2．假定你是某国际学校学生李华，你校将组织开展“走进文化遗产”主题活动，现向全校学生征求活动建议。请你给组织者写信，内容包括：
1. 推荐活动;
2. 说明理由。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80个左右;
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Organizers,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
3．假定你是李华，英国交换生Frank写信给你，希望你推荐一个中国成语，作为鼓励他学习中文的座右铭。请你回封信，推荐成语“愚公移山”，内容包括；
1. 简介成语故事和寓意；
2. 推荐理由。
注意：1. 写作词数80左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，使行文连贯。
生词：成语 idiom; 座右铭 motto; 愚公移山Yu Gong Yi Shan
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
4．假设你是晨光中学的学生李津，你校最近在举行“校园之星”优秀学生评选活动，请你用英语推荐你的同学王华，内容包括：
1.人物和事迹简介；
2.你从他/她身上学到了什么。
注意：1.词数不少于100；
2. 短文题目已为你写好，不计入总词数。
A role model around me
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．假定你是李华，你校的英国交换生Jim在邮件中提到他想报名参加主题为“了不起的中国人” (Amazing Chinese People)的网络短视频大赛，向你征求创意。请你给Jim回信，内容包括:
1．推荐拍摄人物；
2．说明推荐理由。
注意：
1．词数100左右;
2．可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
6．假定你是李华，你的外国朋友Peter对中文歌曲很感兴趣，要求你推荐一款学习中文歌曲的app，请你回复邮件。内容包括：
1. 介绍一款 app；
2. 分享使用体验。
参考词汇: 歌词: lyrics   网易云音乐: NetEase Music    QQ 音乐: QQ Music
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Dear Peter,
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
7．假定你是李华，你所在的社区正在进行年度美丽楼道服务之星(Service Star of the Year)评选活动。请给社区负责人Owen写信推荐员工张杰，内容包括：
1.写信目的；
2.推荐理由。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Owen,
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
8．假定你是李华，你的英国网友David计划在他毕业旅行时到中国来亲身体验和感受中国文化，请你用英文写信向他推荐你眼中最具代表性的城市。
1.城市概况；
2.推荐原因。
注意：
1.写作词数应为 80左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear David,
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
9．假定你是李华，你的英国笔友Sam最近在准备有关中国饮食文化的课堂展示，写邮件请你推荐一种中国特色美食，请给他写一封回信，内容包括：
1. 美食简介;
2. 推荐理由。
注意：1. 词数100左右;
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Sam,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
10．假设你是晨光中学的学生李津。在世界地球日即将到来之际，你校与英国友好校将在线举办“绿动校园，青春飞扬”的主题摄影展，以此来记录校园环保活动中的精彩瞬间。现组委会向同学们征集照片，你打算参加此项活动。请按照以下提示用英语给组委会写一封信来推荐你的照片：
（1）描述照片的内容；
（2）说明选择该照片的理由；
（3）表达对该照片入选的愿望。
参考词汇：绿动校园，青春飞扬Green Campus, Flying Youth
注意：
（1）词数不少于100；
（2）可适当加入细节，使内容充实、行文连贯；
（3）开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数。
Dear Sir/Madam,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Jin
参考答案
1．Dear William,
Learning that you are interested in the study tour but at a loss about which city to visit, I’d like to recommend Guangzhou to you.
Guangzhou, the capital city of Guangdong, is a perfect combination of old and new. For one thing, it is an ancient city with rich historical sites, such as Chen Clan Academy, Xiguan and Shameen, where you can immerse yourself in its profound history and splendid Lingnan culture. For another, Guangzhou enjoys a high reputation for modern complexes, among which the iconic Canton Tower is what you can’t miss. Equally impressive is the Cantonese cuisine, which will give you a feast for your appetite.
I’m sure that you will find Guangzhou a worthwhile city to explore. Wish you a meaningful and unforgettable study tour!
                                                                                                                                                                          Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。交换生朋友William对学校开展的研学旅游活动很感兴趣，要求考生写信给他推荐一个研学城市。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
完美的：perfect → ideal
丰富的：rich → abundant
确信的：sure → certain
难以忘怀的：unforgettable → memorable
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Guangzhou, the capital city of Guangdong, is a perfect combination of old and new.
拓展句：Guangzhou, which is the capital city of Guangdong, is a perfect combination of old and new.
[高分句型1] Learning that you are interested in the study tour but at a loss about which city to visit, I’d like to recommend Guangzhou to you. (运用了连词that引导宾语从句)
[高分句型2] Equally impressive is the Cantonese cuisine, which will give you a feast for your appetite. (运用了关系代词which引导限制性定语从句)
2．Dear Organizers,
I’m writing to share some ideas for the upcoming “Exploring Cultural Heritage” event.
Firstly, I propose organizing visits to local cultural heritage sites for students to explore and learn. This would deepen our understanding of our country’s rich history and culture, fostering a sense of national pride and cultural identity. Secondly, hosting themed lectures or workshops by experts would offer insights into the value and significance of cultural heritage, enhancing our academic knowledge and overall development. Lastly, hands-on activities such as traditional craft making or folk performances would allow us to experience the charm of our traditional culture firsthand and acquire practical skills and knowledge.
In summary, by incorporating diverse activities, we can effectively showcase the allure and importance of cultural heritage while promoting a deeper appreciation and inheritance of our traditions. Thank you for considering these suggestions. Looking forward to a successful event!
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。考生所在学校将组织开展“走进文化遗产”主题活动，现向全校学生征求活动建议。请你给组织者写信。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
培养：foster→develop
获得：acquire→obtain
提供：offer→provide
举行：host→hold
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：In summary, by incorporating diverse activities, we can effectively showcase the allure and importance of cultural heritage while promoting a deeper appreciation and inheritance of our traditions.
拓展句：In summary, It is by incorporating diverse activities that we can effectively showcase the allure and importance of cultural heritage while promoting a deeper appreciation and inheritance of our traditions.
【高分句型1】In summary, by incorporating diverse activities, we can effectively showcase the allure and importance of cultural heritage while promoting a deeper appreciation and inheritance of our traditions.（运用了while引导的时间状语从句的省略）
【高分句型2】This would deepen our understanding of our country’s rich history and culture, fostering a sense of national pride and cultural identity.（运用了现在分词作状语）
3．Dear Frank,
In response to your letter inquiring about a Chinese motto, I strongly recommend to you the idiom Yu Gong Yi Shan, which can definitely keep your willing heart to learning Chinese!       
This idiom actually originates from a touching legend, which literally tells us how Old Man Yu led his family to remove the two mountains blocking the doorway of their house, accomplishing this mission impossible with the help of God. I believe the idiom is an ideal motto for you because it highlights the moral that if we keep trying and never give up, we will eventually achieve our aim, however hard it is, which is a universal value applicable to language learning. Moreover, by embracing this legend, learners can immerse themselves in Chinese culture and gain insights into the beliefs and historical narratives that shape Chinese society.      
 I’m fully aware how challenging it is for a foreigner to learn Chinese and I’m deeply convinced that the understanding of this idiom will fuel your enthusiasm for Chinese. Attached to the letter is my humble calligraphy of the four characters “Yu Gong Yi Shan”, which, I guess, can figure as a reminder.       
Hope you enjoy it!
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给英国交换生Frank写信，向他推荐一个中国成语，作为鼓励他学习中文的座右铭。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
推荐：recommend→put forward
完成：accomplish→achieve
并且：morever→furthermore
激发：fuel→simulate
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Hope you enjoy it!
拓展句：I hope you can be fond of it and look forward to sharing with you the feelings after learning it.
【高分句型1】In response to your letter inquiring about a Chinese motto, I strongly recommend to you the idiom Yu Gong Yi Shan, which can definitely keep your willing heart to learning Chinese! （运用了which引导定语从句）
【高分句型2】This idiom actually originates from a touching legend, which literally tells us how Old Man Yu led his family to remove the two mountains blocking the doorway of their house, accomplishing this mission impossible with the help of God.（运用了which引导定语从句，how引导宾语从句，现在分词作定语和状语）
4．范文
A role model around me
When it comes to the role model around me, it’s nobody but Wang Hua. Liu Wei is my classmate, who is strong and independent. He comes from a poor family. What makes matter worse is that he suffered from a disease in Senior Two. Because of the illness, he even asked a three-months leave from school. During that time, he not only fought against the disease but kept on studying.
Whenever facing the difficulty, he never gives up. Life is not easy for Liu Wei, but he still loves life. He is always an example for everyone to follow.
As a student of Chenguang Middle School, I want nominate my classmate Wang Hua as the “Campus Star”. Wang Hua is a remarkable individual who consistently exhibits exceptional qualities in both academic and personal aspects.
Wang Hua excels in all subjects, especially in mathematics and science. He is always ready to help others with their studies, patiently explaining difficult concepts and encouraging his peers to strive for excellence. However, his achievements are not limited to academics. He is also actively involved in various volunteer activities, such as assisting the elderly and participating in environmental protection projects.
What I have learned from Wang Hua is his dedication to learning and his commitment to serving others. He is a role model who inspires me to work harder and be more compassionate. His positive attitude and unwavering spirit are qualities that I admire and aspire to emulate.
Therefore, I strongly recommend Wang Hua as the “Campus Star”. His dedication, kindness, and leadership qualities make him a deserving candidate for this honor. I believe that his example will inspire others to follow in his footsteps and strive for excellence in all aspects of their lives.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生用英语推荐你的同学王华，参加“校园之星”优秀学生评选活动。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
热爱：love→have a passion for
面对：face→in the face of
非凡的：remarkable→outstanding
相信：believe→hold the view that
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Life is not easy for Liu Wei, but he still loves life.
拓展句：Although life is not easy for Liu Wei, he still loves life.
[高分句型1] What makes matter worse is that he suffered from a disease in Senior Two. (运用了what引导主要从句)
[高分句型2] I believe that his example will inspire others to follow in his footsteps and strive for excellence in all aspects of their lives. (运用了that引导宾语从句)
5．Dear Jim,
I’m thrilled to hear your intention to participate in the “Amazing Chinese People” online short video competition. For your inspiration, I’d like to recommend a figure who truly deserves to be featured.
My suggestion is to focus on Dr. Zhong Nanshan, a renowned respiratory expert and a hero in the fight against COVID-19. His dedication to science, courage in speaking the truth, and relentless efforts to protect public health have earned him widespread respect and admiration.
By showcasing Dr. Zhong’s achievements and struggles, you will not only present an amazing Chinese person but also convey the spirit of perseverance and responsibility that defines many great Chinese individuals.
Looking forward to seeing your creation!
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给Jim回信，推荐短视频采访的人。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
建议：suggestion→advice
奉献：dedication→devotion
参加：participate in→take part in
关注：focus on→concentrate on
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：My suggestion is to focus on Dr. Zhong Nanshan, a renowned respiratory expert and a hero in the fight against COVID-19.
拓展句：My suggestion is to focus on Dr. Zhong Nanshan, who is a renowned respiratory expert and a hero in the fight against COVID-19.
[高分句型1] For your inspiration, I’d like to recommend a figure who truly deserves to be featured. (运用了who引导定语从句)
[高分句型2] By showcasing Dr. Zhong’s achievements and struggles, you will not only present an amazing Chinese person but also convey the spirit of perseverance and responsibility that defines many great Chinese individuals. (运用了动名词作宾语和that引导的定语从句)
6．Dear Peter,
I’m thrilled to know about your interest in Chinese songs. I’d like to recommend an app called NetEase Music. This app has a vast library of Chinese songs, and each song is accompanied by lyrics, which can be very helpful for learning Chinese.
I frequently use NetEase Music myself. I appreciate its user-friendly interface and straightforward operation. Moreover, its lyrics feature is outstanding, with lyrics scrolling in sync with the music, helping me understand the meaning of the songs better. I believe you’ll enjoy this app as well.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给外国朋友Peter回复一封邮件，推荐一款学习中文歌曲的app，包含app简介和使用体验两个要点。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
激动的：thrilled→excited
巨大的：vast→huge
带有：be accompanied by→possess
简单的：straightforward→uncomplicated
2. 句式拓展
原句子句：I frequently use NetEase Music myself. I appreciate its user-friendly interface and straightforward operation.
拓展句：I frequently use NetEase Music myself because I appreciate its user-friendly interface and straightforward operation.
【高分句型1】This app has a vast library of Chinese songs, and each song is accompanied by lyrics, which can be very helpful for learning Chinese.（运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句） 
【高分句型2】Moreover, its lyrics feature is outstanding, with lyrics scrolling in sync with the music, helping me understand the meaning of the songs better.（运用了with复合结构以及现在分词作状语）
7．
I am writing to recommend Zhang Jie as the Service Star of the Year of the beautiful corridor. I choose him for the following reasons.
First of all, Zhang Jie, whose work ranges from cleaning the hallways to helping his neighbors, is hard-working and he works from morning till night. The work of cleaning is dirty and tiring. However, he never complains about it. Besides, he is full of responsibility. Not only does him do the work that belongs to him, but also he devotes to some extra work, like taking care of neighbors’ children. Third, he is willing to build a harmonious community. He tries his best to guard the security of the community. 
I hope that he can get the award.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给社区负责人Owen写信推荐员工张杰为楼道服务之星。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
选择：choose→ select
此外：besides→ in addition
照顾：take care of→ tend
充满：be full of → be filled with
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：The work of cleaning is dirty and tiring. However, he never complains about it.
拓展句：Though the work of cleaning is dirty and tiring, he never complains about it.
【高分句型1】First of all, Zhang Jie, whose work ranges from cleaning the hallways to helping his neighbors, is hard-working and he works from morning till night.（运用了whose引导的非限制性定语从句）
【高分句型2】Not only does him do the work that belongs to him, but also he devotes to some extra work, like taking care of neighbors’ children.（运用了部分倒装和that引导的限制性定语从句，not only…but also…连接的并列句）
8．Dear David,
I’m thrilled to hear about your plans to visit China for your graduation trip! Among the countless cities, I highly recommend Beijing, the capital of China.
Beijing, a city with a rich historical and cultural heritage, offers a unique blend of ancient and modern. Here, you can witness the majesty of the Forbidden City and the tranquility of the Summer Palace. Moreover, the lively Hutong areas provide a glimpse into traditional Beijing life. 
I’m sure Beijing will leave a lasting impression on your China journey. Look forward to hearing about your adventures!
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生用英文写信向David推荐自己眼中最具代表性的中国城市。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
激动的：thrilled→excited
无数的：countless→numerous
强烈：highly→strongly
此外：moreover→besides
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Beijing, a city with a rich historical and cultural heritage, offers a unique blend of ancient and modern.
拓展句：Beijing, which is a city with a rich historical and cultural heritage, offers a unique blend of ancient and modern.
[高分句型1] I’m sure Beijing will leave a lasting impression on your China journey. (运用了省略that引导的宾语从句)
[高分句型2] Look forward to hearing about your adventures! (运用了动名词短语作宾语)
9．Dear Sam,
Thank you for your trust. As for me, I will definitely recommend Sichuan hot pot to you.
Hot pot enjoys the greatest popularity in China. Families and friends often gather around a big hot pot, eating and chatting cheerfully. The steaming pot is usually filled with chili peppers with bright red oil on the top.
Because everyone is free to choose their favorite food, hot pot has become a representative of Chinese values of openness, equality and sharing. That is why I strongly recommend it to you.
Have a try, and I’m sure you will love it.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇是应用文写作。你的英国笔友Sam最近在准备有关中国饮食文化的课堂展示，写邮件请你推荐一种中国特色美食，要求给他写一封回信。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
肯定地：definitely→ surely
愉快地：cheerfully→ delightedly
装满：be filled with→ be full of
喜欢：love→ enjoy
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句： As for me, I will definitely recommend Sichuan Hot Pot to you.
拓展句： As for me, I will definitely recommend Sichuan Hot Pot to you, which is undoubtedly both delicious and savory.
[高分句型1]Families and friends often gather around a big hot pot, eating and chatting cheerfully.(运用了现在分词作状语的结构)
[高分句型2]Because everyone is free to choose their favorite food, hot pot has become a representative of Chinese values of openness, equality and sharing. (运用了because引导的原因状语从句)
10．Dear Sir/Madam,
I am Li Jin, a student from Chenguang High School. With the World Earth Day approaching, I am thrilled to participate in the “Green Campus, Flying Youth” photography exhibition to be held online by our school and our British sister school.
I would like to submit a photo that features a group of students planting trees with enthusiasm on a sunny afternoon. I choose this photo because it captures the essence of our campus’ environmental protection efforts and caters to the theme of “Green Campus, Flying Youth”.
I sincerely hope that my photo will be selected for the exhibition. It would be an honor to have my work displayed with the other outstanding entries and to contribute to the global effort of promoting environmental awareness. Thank you for considering my submission.
Yours,
Li Jin
【写作解析】
本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生给组委会写一封信来推荐照片，描述照片的内容，说明选择该照片的理由，表达对该照片入选的愿望。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
兴奋的：thrilled→excited
参加：participate in→take part in
提交：submit→hand in
对……做贡献：contribute to→make contributions to
2. 句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：I choose this photo because it captures the essence of our campus’ environmental protection efforts and caters to the theme of “Green Campus, Flying Youth”.
拓展句：The reason why I choose this photo is that it captures the essence of our campus’ environmental protection efforts and caters to the theme of “Green Campus, Flying Youth”.
【高分句型1】With the World Earth Day approaching, I am thrilled to participate in the “Green Campus, Flying Youth” photography exhibition to be held online by our school and our British sister school.(使用了With复合结构、不定式作状语)
【高分句型2】It would be an honor to have my work displayed with the other outstanding entries and to contribute to the global effort of promoting environmental awareness. (使用了It作形式主语且不定式作真正主语的句型、have sth. done结构)

documents.local_content:
第 1 页
推荐信


第 2 页
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 你的美国网友David看完电影《哪吒之魔童降世》海外版后非常喜欢, 写信想请你再推荐一部中国电影。请你根据以下要点给他回信: 
　　1. 表示高兴; 
　　2. 推荐一部电影; 
　　3. 推荐的理由(至少两条)。
注意: 1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。

第 3 页
Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称 (I)为主
时态
一般现在时, 一般将来时
要点
1. 说明写信目的
2. 推荐的电影和推荐的理由
3. 表达希望

第 4 页
Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1: 我很高兴知道你对中国电影《哪吒之魔童降世》感兴趣。
一般表达: I am glad to know you’re interested in the Chinese film, Ne Zha. 
句式升级(高级词汇, 被动语态): 
I’m delighted to know you’re __________ by the Chinese film, Ne Zha. 
fascinated

第 5 页
要点2:  这部动画电影也是以中国经典神话故事为基础, 和《哪吒之魔童降世》
有许多相似之处。
一般表达:  This animated film _______________classic Chinese fairy tales, and ____ 
_____________________Ne Zha. 
句式升级(定语从句): 
This animated film, __________________________________________, has much in 
common with Ne Zha. 
is also based on 
has
much in common with 
which is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales

第 6 页
Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear David, 
　　I’m delighted to know you’re fascinated by the Chinese film, Ne Zha. And I’m perfectly willing to recommend another impressive Chinese movie at your request. 
　　Since I know animated films are your favorites, you can’t miss Monkey King: Hero Is Back. This animated film, which is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales, has much in common with Ne Zha, so I think it’ll appeal to you. Additionally, Monkey King and Ne Zha are both regarded as heroes by Chinese people. Through these two movies, you will get a better understanding of Chinese culture. 
　　I hope you’ll find the movie well worth seeing. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

第 7 页
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明目的
①Our school’s approaching 100th birthday will be celebrated this July. Could you please recommend a student to address at the opening ceremony in English?
我们学校将在今年七月庆祝即将到来的百年校庆。你能推荐一位学生在开幕式上用英语发言吗?
②Hearing/Learning that you are coming to visit China, I would like to recommend several places of interest to you. 
听说你要来中国, 我想向你推荐几个名胜古迹。

第 8 页
2. 篇中——紧扣要点, 推荐理由
①He is an all-round student with excellent grades in all subjects. As a boy with great potential, he is good/skillful at solving difficult problems. 
他是一个全面的学生, 各科成绩优异。作为一个很有潜力的男孩, 他善于解决难题。
②In addition, what makes him a model student is his positive attitude towards life. 
此外, 使他成为模范学生的是他积极的生活态度。

第 9 页
3. 结尾——表达希望, 盼回复
①Your taking my recommendation into consideration will be highly expected. Keenly anticipate your prompt reply. 
希望您能考虑我的建议。热切期待您的及时答复。
②I do hope that you can find my recommendation beneficial. Looking forward to your early/prompt reply. 
我希望我的推荐对你有帮助。期待你的早日/及时回复。

第 10 页
【拓展训练】
　　假定你是李华, 你的英国朋友Peter打算这个寒假来中国旅游, 让你推荐一个城市, 你想推荐杭州作为他旅游行程的首选。请用英语给他写封信, 内容包括: 
　　1. 推荐城市; 
　　2. 推荐理由; 
　　3. 你的祝愿。
注意: 
　　1. 词数80左右; 
　　2. 可适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
_________________________________________________________________

第 11 页
【参考范文】
Dear Peter, 
　　I’m delighted to know you’re coming to China for your winter holiday. Personally, I’d like to recommend the city of Hangzhou to you. 
　　When it comes to Hangzhou, the first thing that comes to mind is West Lake, which has been a scenic spot for hundreds of years. Besides, there are many tourist attractions in and around the city, such as Tiger-running Spring, the Lingyin Monastery and Spring Dawn at Su Causeway. Most importantly, Hangzhou is home to delicious food, such as Dongpo Pork and Longjing Shrimp. 

第 12 页
　　I hope the nice weather and convenient transportation here can make your trip more enjoyable. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

sections.text: 推荐信

Step 1: 审题布局
人称
第一人称 (I)为主
时态
一般现在时, 一般将来时
要点
1. 说明写信目的
2. 推荐的电影和推荐的理由
3. 表达希望

Step 2: 巧饰亮点
要点1: 我很高兴知道你对中国电影《哪吒之魔童降世》感兴趣。
一般表达: I am glad to know you’re interested in the Chinese film, Ne Zha. 
句式升级(高级词汇, 被动语态): 
I’m delighted to know you’re __________ by the Chinese film, Ne Zha. 
fascinated

要点2:  这部动画电影也是以中国经典神话故事为基础, 和《哪吒之魔童降世》
有许多相似之处。
一般表达:  This animated film _______________classic Chinese fairy tales, and ____ 
_____________________Ne Zha. 
句式升级(定语从句): 
This animated film, __________________________________________, has much in 
common with Ne Zha. 
is also based on 
has
much in common with 
which is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales

Step 3: 衔接成篇
Dear David, 
　　I’m delighted to know you’re fascinated by the Chinese film, Ne Zha. And I’m perfectly willing to recommend another impressive Chinese movie at your request. 
　　Since I know animated films are your favorites, you can’t miss Monkey King: Hero Is Back. This animated film, which is also based on classic Chinese fairy tales, has much in common with Ne Zha, so I think it’ll appeal to you. Additionally, Monkey King and Ne Zha are both regarded as heroes by Chinese people. Through these two movies, you will get a better understanding of Chinese culture. 
　　I hope you’ll find the movie well worth seeing. 
Yours, 
Li Hua

【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 说明目的
①Our school’s approaching 100th birthday will be celebrated this July. Could you please recommend a student to address at the opening ceremony in English?
我们学校将在今年七月庆祝即将到来的百年校庆。你能推荐一位学生在开幕式上用英语发言吗?
②Hearing/Learning that you are coming to visit China, I would like to recommend several places of interest to you. 
听说你要来中国, 我想向你推荐几个名胜古迹。

2. 篇中——紧扣要点, 推荐理由
①He is an all-round student with excellent grades in all subjects. As a boy with great potential, he is good/skillful at solving difficult problems. 
他是一个全面的学生, 各科成绩优异。作为一个很有潜力的男孩, 他善于解决难题。
②In addition, what makes him a model student is his positive attitude towards life. 
此外, 使他成为模范学生的是他积极的生活态度。

3. 结尾——表达希望, 盼回复
①Your taking my recommendation into consideration will be highly expected. Keenly anticipate your prompt reply. 
希望您能考虑我的建议。热切期待您的及时答复。
②I do hope that you can find my recommendation beneficial. Looking forward to your early/prompt reply. 
我希望我的推荐对你有帮助。期待你的早日/及时回复。

【参考范文】
Dear Peter, 
　　I’m delighted to know you’re coming to China for your winter holiday. Personally, I’d like to recommend the city of Hangzhou to you. 
　　When it comes to Hangzhou, the first thing that comes to mind is West Lake, which has been a scenic spot for hundreds of years. Besides, there are many tourist attractions in and around the city, such as Tiger-running Spring, the Lingyin Monastery and Spring Dawn at Su Causeway. Most importantly, Hangzhou is home to delicious food, such as Dongpo Pork and Longjing Shrimp.

I hope the nice weather and convenient transportation here can make your trip more enjoyable. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
