求助信
【试题探究】
　　假定你是李华, 你和同学根据英语课文改编了一个短剧。请你给外教Miss Evans写一封邮件, 请她帮忙指导。邮件内容包括: 
　　1. 剧情简介; 
　　2. 指导内容; 
　　3. 商定时间、地点。
注意: 写作词数应为80左右。
Step 1: 精准审题　谋篇布局
人称
第一人称、第二人称
时态
一般现在时和现在完成时
要点
1. 写邮件的目的
2. 说明求助事项
Step 2: 字斟句酌　巧饰亮点
要点1: 我写邮件是想就我们改编自课本的一个剧本征求您的意见。
①高级词汇: I’m writing to ask you for advice regarding a play adapted from our textbook. 
②高级句式(利用定语从句升级): I’m writing to ask you for advice regarding a play that we have adapted from our textbook. 
要点2: 我们不确定情节是否完整, 我们也想知道如何使用适当的语气来完美地说台词。
①高级词汇和句式(宾语从句): We are uncertain whether the plot is complete. We are also wondering how to use proper tones to speak the lines perfectly. 
②高级句式(利用not only. . . but also合并两个句子): We are not only uncertain whether the plot is complete, but also we are wondering how to use proper tones to speak the lines perfectly. 
③高级句式(利用倒装句升级): Not only are we uncertain whether the plot is complete, but also we are wondering how to use proper tones to speak the lines perfectly. 
Step 3: 衔接过渡　斐然成篇
Dear Miss Evans, 
　　How is everything going? I’m writing to ask you for advice regarding a play that we have adapted from our textbook. 
　　The play is about how money influences the attitude of people treating others. However, not only are we uncertain whether the plot is complete, but also we are wondering how to use proper tones to speak the lines perfectly. Hopefully, you would be so kind as to give us some guidance. 
　　If it’s convenient for you, let’s meet at 8: 30 a. m. tomorrow in the school theater. We’d appreciate it if you could do us a favor. 
Yours, 
Li Hua
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 请求帮助
①I wonder if you could do me a favor to pick up my uncle at the airport. 我想知道你是否能帮我一个忙, 到机场接我叔叔。
②Would you like to do me a favor to have my draft polished?
你愿意帮我润色草稿吗?
2. 篇中——详细描述, 讲清困难
①Faced with the above problems, I am anxious to get your help. Would you please offer me some advice on maths learning?
面对上述问题, 我渴望得到你的帮助。你能给我一些数学学习建议吗?
②Now, I struggle a lot in my study. I’ve found that hardly do I take sports due to too much homework. 现在, 我在学习上很痛苦。我发现由于作业太多, 我几乎没时间运动。
3. 结尾——盼回复, 希望得到帮助
①I wonder if you can help me with these difficulties. I would really appreciate it if you could help me. 
我想知道你能不能帮我解决这些困难。如果你能帮助我, 我真的很感激。
②I would appreciate it very much if you could offer me some necessary/timely help(give/lend me some practical/valuable advice). 
如果你能给我一些必要的帮助/及时的帮助(给我一些实用的/有价值的建议)我会很感激。
【拓展储备】
　　假定你是李华。最近你校英语俱乐部将举办主题为“魅力中国”的演讲比赛, 请给你的外教Cheslie 写一封电子邮件, 请她帮助润色你的演讲稿并给予你有关演讲技巧的指导。内容包括:  
　　1. 写信原因; 
　　2. 你的困惑; 
　　3. 请求帮助。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80左右;  
　　2. 可适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯。
Dear Cheslie, 
　　I am writing to ask you to do me a favor. 
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
【参考范文】
Dear Cheslie, 
　　I am writing to ask you to do me a favor. I’ll participate in an English speech contest with the title “Charming China”. I’ve finished my speech draft, but I find it far from satisfactory. 
　　Firstly, I’m not sure of some proper expressions in English and not aware of the mistakes in grammar and sentence structures. Would you please go through the attachment to this email and then help me correct the mistakes and polish the speech draft? Besides, I am pretty nervous about the speech, so I’d like you to offer me some presentation skills, which can improve my performance. I’d appreciate it if you could give me your guidance. 
　　Looking forward to your early reply!
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
【要点精练】
1．假定你是李华，你的英语听力存在一些问题，你想让你的英国笔友Wesley给你推荐几个提高英语听力水平的网站。请你给他发一封电子邮件，内容包括：
1. 你的英语听力情况介绍；
2. 提出请求；
3. 期待回复。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Wesley,
How are you doing?
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
2．假设你是李华，去纽约旅游，从机场乘一辆黄色的出租车去假日饭店(Holiday Inn)，到达酒店后发现遗失了一件行李箱。在失物招领处，工作人员要求你用英文写一份书面材料。 
内容包括：
● 行李遗失的过程；
● 行李箱的概况；
● 联系电话: 1-703-3543269。
注意：1. 字数80左右。2.文章中不能出现个人真实信息。
Dear Sir/Madam,
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
3．假定你是学生李华，你写了一篇介绍剪纸艺术的英文博客（blog），希望请外籍教师Bob润色一下。请你给他写一封电子邮件。内容包括：
1. 写信的事由：
2. 表达感激。
注意：1. 写作词数应为80个左右：
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Bob.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely.
Li Hua
4．假定你是李华。自进入高中以来你妈妈不允许你使用智能手机，她认为这会影响学习和视力，而你认为智能手机能解决学习中的困惑且方便与同学交流。你们之间的冲突让你感到很苦恼。请你用英语给某英语报社编辑 Mr. Advice 写一封信寻求帮助。
注意：
1. 词数120左右（开头和结尾已给出，但不计入总词数）；
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
5．假定你是李华，你的英国朋友Jenny这学期作为交换生第一次离开父母来到中国学习，常常感觉孤独，来信向你求助。请你给Jenny回信，要点包括：
1、表示理解;  
2、你的建议及理由;   
3、表示祝愿。
注意：1.词数80左右;
2.可适当增添细节，以使行文连贯;
3.信的开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数。
Dear Jenny,
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
LiHua
6．假定你是学校音乐俱乐部的负责人李华，在做户外音乐会的准备工作时遇到了一些问题。请给有组织经验的美国笔友Jack 写一封电子邮件，内容包括：
1. 介绍准备情况；2. 征求建议。
Dear Jack,
______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours, sincerely
 Li Hua
7．假设你是李华，是一名高三学生，你面临着毕业也面临着职业的选择，但是你很迷茫，不知道如何选择和判断自己未来适合从事哪种工作，为此你写信给已是大学一年级的美国朋友Lily，希望她能给你一些建议。信的内容如下：
①你面临职业选择的迷茫；
②希望对方给出一些建议；
③感谢和祝福对方。
注意事项：
①词数在80左右；
②可以适当增加细节使行文流畅。
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
8．假定你是校英语戏剧社社长李华，在排练课本剧《百万英镑》The Million Pound Note中At The Tailors这一幕时遇到一些困难，希望得到同样酷爱戏剧表演的外教Betty老师的指导。你发邮件邀请她来排练现场，并请求她的帮助。内容包括：(1)发出诚挚邀请；(2)说明排练难处；(3)请求现场指导。
注意：
(1)写作词数应为80左右；
(2)请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
参考词汇：排练v. rehearse   n. rehearsal 
Dear Betty,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
参考答案
1．Dear Wesley,
How are you doing? I am writing to ask you to do me a favor. As you know, my English listening skills are not as strong as I’d like them to be. Despite my efforts to improve, I still find it challenging to understand spoken English, especially when it comes to accents or fast-paced conversations.
Considering your proficiency in English and your familiarity with online resources, I was wondering if you could recommend some websites or online platforms that are specifically designed to enhance English listening skills. 
I’d greatly appreciate your assistance and look forward to your reply.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。题目要求学生以李华的身份，给英国笔友Wesley发一封电子邮件，请求他给听力存在一些问题的自己推荐几个提高英语听力水平的网站。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
尽管：despite→in spite of
英语口语：spoken English→oral English
考虑到：considering→given/in view of
提高：enhance→elevate
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：I am writing to ask you to do me a favor.
拓展句：I am writing to ask if you can do me a favor.
[高分句型1] Despite my efforts to improve, I still find it challenging to understand spoken English, especially when it comes to accents or fast-paced conversations. (运用了when引导时间状语从句)
[高分句型2] Considering your proficiency in English and your familiarity with online resources, I was wondering if you could recommend some websites or online platforms that are specifically designed to enhance English listening skills. (运用了if引导宾语从句、that引导限制性定语从句)
2．Dear Sir/Madam,
I’m Li Hua, a tourist from China. This morning, I arrived at New York airport and took a yellow taxi to Holiday Inn. Unfortunately, on reaching the hotel, I discovered one of my suitcases lost in the taxi. What was worse, I took no notice of the plate number. 
The suitcase is a black plastic one, about 60cm by 40cm by 16cm. There is a video camera, two pairs of pants and some books for children in it. The camera has recorded all my experience in this country, which means a lot to me.
When you have got ANY information of my suitcase, please contact me at 1-703-3543269.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】这是一封求助信。要求考生以李华的身份，就你去纽约旅游，从机场乘一辆黄色的出租车去假日饭店(Holiday Inn)，到达酒店后发现遗失了一件行李箱，在失物招领处，工作人员要求你用英文写一份书面材料一事，写一封求助信。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
到达：arrive at → attain the destination of
注意：take notice of → be mindful of
大约：about→ approximately
得到：get→ obtain
2.句式拓展
同义句改写
原句：This morning, I arrived at New York airport and took a yellow taxi to Holiday Inn.
拓展句：This morning, upon my arrival at New York airport, I embarked on a journey in a yellow taxi, which conveyed me to Holiday Inn.
【高分句型1】Unfortunately, on reaching the hotel, I discovered one of my suitcases lost in the taxi.（使用了介词短语作状语）
【高分句型2】The camera has recorded all my experience in this country, which means a lot to me.（使用了关系代词which引导的非限制性定语从句，先行词为前面一整句话表示的内容）
3．Dear Bob,
I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to request your expert guidance on my recent blog post, “A Journey Through the Intricate Labyrinths of Chinese Paper-Cutting Art,” where I delve into the beauty and cultural legacy of this age-old craft. Given your linguistic prowess and deep cultural understanding, I believe your input would significantly enhance its clarity and appeal.
I kindly ask for your assistance in reviewing my draft, seeking any grammatical corrections, refining sentence structures, and offering insights to better articulate the distinctive techniques and rich history of paper-cutting. Your feedback will not only refine my writing but also deepen the readers’ appreciation of this fascinating tradition.
Thank you in anticipation of your support.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生请外教Bob写信润色一篇介绍剪纸艺术的英文博客。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
帮助：assistance→help
提高：enhance→increase
提供：offering→providing
迷人的：fascinating→charming
2.句式拓展
同义句替换
原句：Thank you in anticipation of your support.
同义句：I eagerly anticipate your valuable support, knowing it will significantly contribute to the excellence of my blog post.
【高分句型1】I am writing to request your expert guidance on my recent blog post, “A Journey Through the Intricate Labyrinths of Chinese Paper-Cutting Art,” where I delve into the beauty and cultural legacy of this age-old craft. (运用了where引导的非限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】Your feedback will not only refine my writing but also deepen the readers’ appreciation of this fascinating tradition. (运用了not…only…but…also…连接的并列句)
4．Dear Mr. Advice,
I am Li Hua, a Senior High student. I have been troubled by a problem and have to ask you a favor with the hope that you will be kind enough to help me out.
My mother has not allowed me to use my smartphone since the beginning of the new term. In her opinion, smartphones will have a negative effect on my studies and eyesight. However, I don’t agree with her. With the phone, I can easily find answers to some difficult questions. Meanwhile, I can share my worries and joys with my friends online, which can help to reduce my stress.
What do you think I should do? I’d appreciate it if you can offer me some practical suggestions.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。考生自进入高中以来，妈妈不允许考生使用智能手机，她认为这会影响学习和视力，而考生认为智能手机能解决学习中的困惑且方便与同学交流。和妈妈之间的冲突让考生感到很苦恼，要求考生按照要求用英语给某英语报社编辑 Mr. Advice 写一封信寻求帮助。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
帮助某人：help sb. out→ give sb. a hand
允许：allow→ permit
意见，看法：opinion→ view
消极的：negative→ passive
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句 
原句：I am Li Hua, a Senior High student.
拓展句：I am Li Hua, who is a Senior High student.
【高分句型1】I have been troubled by a problem and have to ask you a favor with the hope that you will be kind enough to help me out. (运用了that引导的同位语从句)
【高分句型2】Meanwhile, I can share my worries and joys with my friends online, which can help to reduce my stress. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
5．Dear Jenny,
You wrote that you always feel lonely because it’s the first time that you have been away from your parents and studied in China as an exchanged student. I understand you quite well and perhaps the following suggestions may be helpful. 
First of all, I recommend that you make video calls with your parents from time to time, which will help to reduce your loneliness. Besides, it would be a good idea to take part in some extra-curricular activities. In this way, you can make more friends and lead a more colorful life.
I do hope that my advice will be of some use to you and that you will adapt to the new life soon.   
Yours ,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。你的英国朋友Jenny作为交换生感觉孤独，来信向你求助，现要求考生给他回信。其内容包括：表示理解、你的建议及理由和表示祝愿。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
建议： suggestion→advice
首先：first of all →to begin with 
 而且：besides→moreover 
 适应：adapt to→fit in with 
 2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Besides, it would be a good idea to take part in some extra-curricular activities. In this way, you can make more friends and lead a more colorful life. 
拓展句：Besides, it would be a good idea to take part in some extra-curricular activities, through which you can make more friends and lead a more colorful life. 
【高分句型1】First of all, I recommend that you make video calls with your parents from time to time, which will help to reduce your loneliness. （运用了虚拟语气和which引导的非限制性定语从句） 
【高分句型2】I do hope that my advice will be of some use to you and that you will adapt to the new life soon. （运用了that引导的宾语从句） 
6．Dear Jack,
How is everything going with you? I am in charge of our school concert club. Now I come across some problems when preparing for an outdoor concert. Knowing that you have rich experience in organizing such kind of event, I’m writing to ask for your suggestions.
I have already made some preparations for it. For example, the time and place as well as the theme of the concert have been announced publicly to us students. But the difficulties that I’m faced with during arrangement (安排、筹备) upset (使苦恼) me so much. To begin with, I’m not sure about how to arrange the venue (布置场地) to leave a good impression on the audience. What makes me more frustrated is that I don’t know how to host the concert. By the way, is it necessary for the performers to put on make-up? I’m very anxious to get your suggestions about the problems mentioned above. I’m convinced that your precious advice will make a great difference to my preparing for the concert.
Looking forward to your early reply at your most convenience.
Yours, sincerely
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。你是学校音乐俱乐部的负责人李华，在做户外音乐会的准备工作时遇到了一些问题。要求考生给有组织经验的美国笔友Jack 写一封电子邮件介绍准备情况和征求建议。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
负责：be in charge of→take charge of
活动：event→ activity
沮丧的：frustrated→depressed
焦虑的：anxious→ worried/nervous
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句： I’m very anxious to get your suggestions about the problems mentioned above. 
拓展句：I’m very anxious to get your suggestions about the problems which are mentioned above. 
【高分句型1】Knowing that you have rich experience in organizing such kind of event, I’m writing to ask for your suggestions.（运用了现在分词作状语和that引导的宾语从句结构）
【高分句型2】What makes me more frustrated is that I don’t know how to host the concert. （运用了what引导的主语从句和that引导的表语从句）
7．
Dear Lily,
I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing to share with you my confusion about my future career choice. As a high school senior, I am at a crossroads, uncertain about which path to take.
With graduation looming, I find myself overwhelmed with possibilities, yet clueless as to which one would be the most suitable for me. I know you went through this phase not too long ago, and I was wondering if you could offer some insight or advice based on your experience.
Perhaps you could share how you narrowed down your options or what factors you considered when making your decision. Any guidance would be greatly appreciated.
Thank you in advance for your help. I wish you all the best in your studies and hope to see you soon.
Sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇是应用文写作。你是一名高三学生，你面临着毕业也面临着职业的选择，但是你很迷茫，不知道如何选择和判断自己未来适合从事哪种工作，要求考生为此写信给已是大学一年级的美国朋友Lily，希望她能给你一些建议。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
不确定：uncertain→unsure
迫近的：looming→approaching
合适的：suitable→fit/appropriate
感激：appreciated→grateful
2. 句式拓展
简单句合并为复合句
原句：I am writing to share with you my confusion about my future career choice. As a high school senior, I am at a crossroads, uncertain about which path to take.
拓展句：I am writing to share with you the confusion I am experiencing regarding my future career choice as a high school senior who stands at a crossroads, uncertain about the path to take.
[高分句型1]With graduation looming, I find myself overwhelmed with possibilities, yet clueless as to which one would be the most suitable for me.(运用了with的复合结构和which引导的宾语从句)
[高分句型2]I know you went through this phase not too long ago, and I was wondering if you could offer some insight or advice based on your experience.(运用了省略引导词的宾语从句和if引导的宾语从句)
8．Dear Betty,
As the president of our school’s English Drama Club, I am currently facing some challenges while rehearsing the play The Million Pound Note and I am writing to seek your assistance. 
I would be grateful if you could provide guidance on character development, blocking, and overall stage direction. Please let me know when and where you would be available to meet for these rehearsals. Your insights would be invaluable to our club. Thank you in advance for considering my request, and I eagerly await your response.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。考生是校英语戏剧社社长，在排练课本剧《百万英镑》时遇到一些困难，希望得到同样酷爱戏剧表演的外教Betty老师的指导，要求考生按照要求发邮件邀请她来排练现场，并请求她的帮助。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
当前：currently→ at present
寻求：seek→ search after
帮助：assistance→ help
感激的：grateful→ appreciative
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Knowing that you are very interested in Tai Chi, I am writing to invite you to attend a Tai Chi class held by Youth Palace.
拓展句：Because I know that you are very interested in Tai Chi, I am writing to invite you to attend a Tai Chi class held by Youth Palace.
【高分句型1】I would be grateful if you could provide guidance on character development, blocking, and overall stage direction.（运用了if引导的条件状语从句）
【高分句型2】Please let me know when and where you would be available to meet for these rehearsals.（运用了祈使句的肯定形式、when and where引导的宾语从句）

Li Hua

【参考范文】

　　I am writing to ask you to do me a favor. I’ll participate in an English speech contest with the title “Charming China”. I’ve finished my speech draft, but I find it far from satisfactory.

Would you please go through the attachment to this email and then help me correct the mistakes and polish the speech draft? Besides, I am pretty nervous about the speech, so I’d like you to offer me some presentation skills, which can improve my performance. I’d appreciate it if you could give me your guidance. 
　　Looking forward to your early reply!

Li Hua

第 2 页

【试题探究】
　　你校将举办英语演讲比赛。请你以Be smart online learners为题写一篇发言稿参赛, 内容包括: 
　　1. 分析优势与不足; 2. 提出学习建议。

第 3 页

发言稿

2. 网上学习的不足

第 7 页
Step 3:  衔接成篇
Be smart online learners
　　Online learning has become an important way to learn recently. However, online learning has both advantages and disadvantages. 
　　Its advantages are obvious. Online learning allows us to learn anytime and anywhere. Besides, we can absorb all kinds of resources to learn more efficiently. However, its disadvantages cannot be ignored. Staring at the screen for long time is harmful to our eyes. Worse still, we don’t have many opportunities to interact with our teachers and classmates. 

第 8 页
　　Then how to be smart online learners?First, we should be brave to discuss our problems with others. Second, it is wise to take a short break after learning for 30 minutes. 
　　In conclusion, only by being smart online learners can we truly enjoy the benefits of modern technology.

②Music can make us feel relaxed both mentally and physically, thus helping reduce our pressure at work and in life. 
音乐可以使我们身心放松, 从而帮助我们减少工作和生活中的压力。

第 11 页

我们衷心希望你们今晚过得开心。

祝贺展览会圆满成功!

　　2. 你对劳动的理解。

Labor—A Traditional Virtue
　　Good morning, everyone. 
　　Today, I would like to talk about the theme “Labor—A Traditional Virtue” in the context of the upcoming Labor Education Week at our school. 
　　Recently, I had the opportunity to participate in a labor experience program organized by our school. We spent a whole day working at a local farm, planting vegetables, and doing various physical tasks. Although it was tiring, I felt a great sense of accomplishment at the end of the day. 

第 14 页
　　Through this experience, I gained a deeper understanding of the value of labor. Labor not only helps us develop a strong work ethic but also teaches us something essential such as teamwork, responsibility, and perseverance. 
　　Thank you for your attention.

Be smart online learners
　　Online learning has become an important way to learn recently. However, online learning has both advantages and disadvantages. 
　　Its advantages are obvious. Online learning allows us to learn anytime and anywhere. Besides, we can absorb all kinds of resources to learn more efficiently. However, its disadvantages cannot be ignored. Staring at the screen for long time is harmful to our eyes. Worse still, we don’t have many opportunities to interact with our teachers and classmates.

Then how to be smart online learners?First, we should be brave to discuss our problems with others. Second, it is wise to take a short break after learning for 30 minutes. 
　　In conclusion, only by being smart online learners can we truly enjoy the benefits of modern technology.

【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开场白
①Thank you from the bottom of my heart for giving me this chance to speak to you today. 
我从心底感谢你们今天给我这个机会在你们面前演讲。
②I really appreciate your making time in your schedules to attend the meeting today. 
我非常感谢你们今天抽空来参加这个会议。

2. 篇中——拓展话题, 论证观点
①In a sense, reading provides me with a safe harbor where I can escape from worries in real life, rest my soul and immediately get recharged. 
从某种意义上说, 阅读给我提供了一个安全的港湾, 在那里我可以逃避现实生活中的烦恼, 让我的灵魂得到休息, 并立即得到恢复。
②Music can make us feel relaxed both mentally and physically, thus helping reduce our pressure at work and in life. 
音乐可以使我们身心放松, 从而帮助我们减少工作和生活中的压力。

3. 结尾——发出号召、呼吁或祝福
①We sincerely hope that you will have a wonderful time tonight. 
我们衷心希望你们今晚过得开心。
②Best wishes for a very successful exhibition!
祝贺展览会圆满成功!

【参考范文】
Labor—A Traditional Virtue
　　Good morning, everyone. 
　　Today, I would like to talk about the theme “Labor—A Traditional Virtue” in the context of the upcoming Labor Education Week at our school. 
　　Recently, I had the opportunity to participate in a labor experience program organized by our school. We spent a whole day working at a local farm, planting vegetables, and doing various physical tasks. Although it was tiring, I felt a great sense of accomplishment at the end of the day.

Through this experience, I gained a deeper understanding of the value of labor. Labor not only helps us develop a strong work ethic but also teaches us something essential such as teamwork, responsibility, and perseverance. 
　　Thank you for your attention.

征文（投稿）
【试题探究】
(2023· 全国乙卷改编)
　　学校英文报组织同学们分享自己在假期中学到的新技能, 请你以“Learning a new skill”为题写一篇短文投稿。内容包括: 
　　1. 简要描述; 　2. 体验和感受。
Step 1:  精准审题　谋篇布局
类 型
投稿
人 称
第一人称(I)
时 态
一般现在时; 一般过去时
要 点
1. 描述学到的新技能
2. 过程与体验
3. 感受和收获
Step 2:  字斟句酌　巧饰亮点
要点1: 一开始, 读五线谱上的音符是相当困难的。
一般表达: In the beginning, reading the notes on the stave was quite hard. 
→一开始, 读五线谱上的音符是相当困难的, 但是我没有放弃。(高级表达)
In the beginning, it was quite difficult to read the notes on the stave, but I didn’t give up. 
要点2: 虽然经过几个小时的练习, 我的手指会感到疼痛, 但如果我能完整地演奏一首曲子, 我就会感到满足。
Although my fingers were painful after a few hours’ practice, I felt satisfied if I could play a music piece completely. 
要点3: 即使我不会把弹钢琴作为我的终身职业, 我仍然会把它作为我最大的爱好。
Even though I will not make playing the piano as my life career, I will still regard it as my first hobby. 
Step 3:  衔接过渡　斐然成篇
Learning a new skill 
　　When I was in my primary school, I had an opportunity to attend a musical contest held in my school. That was the first time I had watched a live musical performance. The fantastic players touched me deeply. 
　　I asked my parents to allow me to take up a piano lesson as a beginner. In the beginning, it was quite difficult to read the notes on the stave, but I didn’t give up. I spent most of my leisure hours practicing the piano. Although my fingers were painful after a few hours’ practice, I felt satisfied if I could play a music piece completely. 
　　Even though I will not make playing the piano as my life career, I will still regard it as my first hobby. 
【句式储备】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 引出话题
①Nowadays, more and more foreigners are becoming increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture. The reasons why there exists this phenomenon can be listed as follows. 
如今, 越来越多的外国人逐渐对中国传统文化感兴趣。存在这种现象的原因可以列举如下。
②I’m Li Hua, an editor of English newspaper of our school. Knowing you are familiar with the culture in your country, I’m writing to invite you to contribute an essay to share something with us. 
我是李华, 是我们学校英文报的编辑。我知道你对你的国家的文化很熟悉, 所以我写信邀请你写一篇文章与我们分享一些东西。
2. 篇中——详细描述, 讲清理由
①Among the many symbols that represent China and its unique culture, the Great Wall is on the top of my recommendation list. 在代表中国及其独特文化的众多象征中, 长城是我的首选推荐。
②Originally built by Emperor Qinshihuang and expanded and strengthened in the Ming Dynasty, it became the world’s largest military structure. 
它最初由秦始皇建造, 并在明朝扩建和加强, 成为世界上最大的军事建筑。
3. 结尾——再次总结全文
①In my view, it’s our country’s being strong that has made the cultural aspect of our country more appealing and charming. 在我看来, 正是我们国家的强大使我们国家的文化方面更具吸引力和魅力。
②I appreciate it because it is unique in the world. Besides, it makes drinking tea more enjoyable, and also gives us an insight into people’s lifestyle in the Song Dynasty. 我欣赏它, 因为它在世界上是独一无二的。此外, 它使喝茶变得更加愉快, 也让我们了解了宋代人们的生活方式。
【拓展储备】
　　21st Century Teens英文报正在就“越来越多的外国人爱上中国传统文化”这一现象举办征文活动, 请你写一篇英语短文投稿, 内容要点如下: 
　　1. 分析原因; 
　　2. 你的看法。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯; 
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
_________________________________________________________________
【参考范文】
　　Nowadays, more and more foreigners are becoming increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture. The reasons why there exists this phenomenon can be listed as follows. 
　　For one thing, China has a long history and evolves colorful, mysterious and unique cultures in its development, which makes it more attractive. For another, our country’s economy has been developing at a good pace. During their stay, they are also exposed to and fascinated by our diverse traditional cultures. 
　　And I think every one of us should take responsibility to spread our excellent traditional culture to the world. Only in this way can our country go further and be more stable on the way to realizing the Chinese Dream.

1．假定你是李华，上周你参加了学校组织的“走进社区”社会实践活动，请你向校英文报投稿，介绍本次活动。内容包括：

4．假定你是李华，请你给某英文报刊“人与自然”专栏写一篇与自然灾害有关的短文。内容包括：
1. 描述自然灾害的现象和后果；

5．近年来中学生的身体健康越来越受到重视，体育运动更是中学生的必修课。你校英语社团将举办以“热爱运动”为主题的征文活动。请根据以下提示，以“Enjoy sports, enjoy life”为题写一篇英语短文投稿。

8．近年来，国内因各种原因导致的火灾频发，造成不少人员伤亡。为了增加学生的安全自救常识，提高防火安全意识，请你根据以下提示，以“How to Survive a Fire”为题为学校英语时报投一篇英文稿件。内容包括：
1. 目前火灾事故现状；

9．上周五，你校组织了一次走访社区传统文化传承人的活动。请你写一篇新闻稿，向校英语报投稿，内容包括：
1. 走访过程；2.谈谈收获。

1.写作词数应为 80左右；2.可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。

10．假定你是李华，请向21st Century Teens的“Sunshine Sports”专栏投稿，介绍一下你校的阳光体育活动。要点包括：
1. 活动目的； 
2. 组织形式； 
3. 个人收获。 
注意：1. 词数80左右； 
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。

参考答案
1．
A Community-based Social Practice Activity
Last week, I had the privilege of participating in our school’s community-based social practice activity. It deepened my understanding of community service.
We visited a nearby community and engaged in various activities. We helped clean up the environment, interacted with residents, and organized cultural performances. The highlight was assisting at a local charity event, where we raised funds for needy families.
This activity left me with a profound sense of fulfillment. It was a rewarding experience that not only enriched my school life but also taught me the value of community engagement. I am grateful for this opportunity and look forward to more such activities in the future.
【写作解析】本篇是应用文写作。要求考生在上周参加了学校组织的“走进社区”社会实践活动后，向校英文报投稿，介绍本次活动。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
参加：participate in→take part in
活动：activity→event
各种各样的：various→kinds of
感激：grateful→thankful/appreciative
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Last week, I had the privilege of participating in our school’s community-based social practice activity. It deepened my understanding of community service.
拓展句：Last week, I had the privilege of participating in our school’s community-based social practice activity, which deepened my understanding of community service.
[高分句型1]The highlight was assisting at a local charity event, where we raised funds for needy families.(运用了where引导的非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2]It was a rewarding experience that not only enriched my school life but also taught me the value of community engagement.(运用了that引导的定语从句和not only...but also...连接并列的谓语)
2．范文
My Amazing Chinese Lunar New Year Experience
The Chinese Lunar New Year is one of the most important festivals in China and the customs and traditions of celebrating the event vary from place to place. For me, the most enjoyable activity is to decorate my home with the traditional paintings, which can add my personal touches to the celebrations.
Last year, I experimented with paper-cutting I had just learned and succeeded in creating various beautiful “loongs” or Chinese dragons. Before I started the project, I surfed the Internet and tried to learn about the dragon as much as possible. It was a really cultural adventure!
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生以“My Amazing ______ Experience”为题写一篇短文投稿。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
重要的：important→vital
传统的：traditional→conventional
令人愉快的：enjoyable→pleasing
各种各样的：various→a variety of
2.句式拓展
同义句转换
原句：Last year, I experimented with paper-cutting I had just learned and succeeded in creating various beautiful “loongs” or Chinese dragons.
拓展句：Last year, not only did I experiment with paper-cutting I had just learned, but also I succeeded in creating various beautiful “loongs” or Chinese dragons.
[高分句型1] The Chinese Lunar New Year is one of the most important festivals in China and the customs and traditions of celebrating the event vary from place to place. (运用了动名词作宾语)
[高分句型2] For me, the most enjoyable activity is to decorate my home with the traditional paintings, which can add my personal touches to the celebrations. (运用了which引导非限制性定语从句)
3．    There are many famous cities in the world. However, Beijing is one of my favorite cities. Beijing is located in the northeast of China. Home to over 20 million people, the capital of China is also the political centre of the country. There are many famous historical places of interest in the city of Beijing, which attracts a large number of tourists from all over the world every year. The Forbidden City, the Great Wall and Tian-anmen Square all show Beijing’s rich cultural heritage to the world. When you stay in Beijing, one of the most unforgettable experiences is to taste the famous Beijing Roast Duck. It is very delicious and I enjoy it very much.
    Therefore, it is well worth visiting for people from all around the world.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给英文报拟开设的Cities in the world栏目投稿，介绍中国的首都北京。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
著名的：famous→well-known
然而：however→nevertheless
坐落于：be located in→be situated in
大量的：a large number of→numerous/plenty of
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：There are many famous cities in the world.
拓展句：There are many cities which are renowned for their fame in the world.
【高分句型1】There are many famous historical places of interest in the city of Beijing, which attracts a large number of tourists from all over the world every year. (运用了which引导的非限定性定语从句)
【高分句型2】When you stay in Beijing, one of the most unforgettable experiences is to taste the famous Beijing Roast Duck. (运用了when引导的时间状语从句)
4．One possible version:
As we all know, natural disasters, such as the earthquakes, sandstorms, floods and so on, do much damage to human. Thus, countless houses are in ruins, numerous fields are destroyed, and millions of people suffer great economical loss.
There are several reasons for these disasters. The quick population growth has a bad effect on nature, since it means higher demands for supplies. What’s more, people lack the consciousness of environmental protection, making them lose the ability to deal with emergencies.
In my opinion, we are supposed to make every effort to keep the balance between human and nature. Only in this way can we humans survive.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生按照要求给某英文报刊“人与自然”专栏写一篇与自然灾害有关的短文。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
因此：thus→ therefore
无数的：countless→ innumerable
很多的：numerous→ a lot of
几个：several→ a few
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句 
原句：As we all know, natural disasters, such as the earthquakes, sandstorms, floods and so on, do much damage to human. 
拓展句：It is known to all that natural disasters, such as the earthquakes, sandstorms, floods and so on, do much damage to human. 
【高分句型1】As we all know, natural disasters, such as the earthquakes, sandstorms, floods and so on, do much damage to human. （运用了As引导的非限制性定语从句）
【高分句型2】What’s more, people lack the consciousness of environmental protection, making them lose the ability to deal with emergencies.（运用了现在分词making作状语）
5．Enjoy sports, enjoy life
Today doing sports is becoming more and more important to us. As students, we can do different kinds of sports after class. As for me, I like playing football best, so I often play it with my friends after school for an hour. It’s very interesting.
There is no doubt that doing sports is helpful to us. It can not only build up our bodies but also keep us healthy and strong. What’s more, doing sports can help to relax ourselves. The most important is that we can make friends when we do sports.
To keep doing sports, we should love sports first, because love is the greatest power. Second, making a plan is very important. It makes doing sports more effective. Last but not least, we can do sports with a partner who has the same interest with you.
Enjoy sports, and it will make us better!
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于说明文，要求考生以“Enjoy sports, enjoy life”为题写一篇英语短文，向学校英语社团将举办的以“热爱运动”为主题的征文活动投稿。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
重要的：important→significant
种类：kind→sort
有益的：helpful→beneficial
另外：what’s more→in addition
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：As for me, I like playing football best, so I often play it with my friends after school for an hour.
拓展句：As for me, I like playing football best and that’s why I often play it with my friends after school for an hour.
[高分句型1] The most important is that we can make friends when we do sports. (运用了that引导的表语从句和when引导的时间状语从句)
[高分句型2] To keep doing sports, we should love sports first, because love is the greatest power. (运用了because引导的原因状语从句)
6．
I’m Li Hua, a student in Grade 3. I believe installing a countdown to the Gaokao reminder in the classroom is not a wise choice. Firstly, it can create unnecessary pressure and anxiety among students, affecting their mental health. Secondly, it may distract students from focusing on their studies and preparing for the exam effectively.
Instead, I propose that we create a positive and supportive learning environment. Teachers and students can work together to set realistic goals and formulate effective study plans. Regular study sessions and mock exams can also help students assess their progress and prepare better for the Gaokao. By fostering a healthy and encouraging atmosphere, we can empower students to face the Gaokao with confidence and ease.
【写作解析】本篇是应用文写作。要求考生就“教室里安装高考倒计时牌(Countdown to the Gaokao Reminder)”这种做法发表意见，认为不合理，并写一篇短文投稿。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
认为：believe (that)→hold the belief that
首先：firstly→to begin with
影响：affect→influence
专注于：focus on→concentrate on
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Firstly, it can create unnecessary pressure and anxiety among students, affecting their mental health.
拓展句：Firstly, installing a countdown to the Gaokao reminder can create unnecessary pressure and anxiety among students, which in turn affects their mental health negatively.
[高分句型1] I believe installing a countdown to the Gaokao reminder in the classroom is not a wise choice. (省略that的宾语从句)
[高分句型2] Instead, I propose that we create a positive and supportive learning environment. (that引导的宾语从句)
7．Beauty on the Campus
To inspire students to appreciate the beautiful campus as well as those touching events in the school life, we have planned to launch a writing competition, whose theme is “Beauty on the Campus”.
As the name suggests, you’re supposed to write about the people or things that have touched you. You can also focus on the beautiful campus in every season of the year. It’s our sincere hope that all of you can get involved in the competition and share your experience with us. You can submit your article, which is restricted to 1,000 words, by May 30.
Your participation is welcome!
【写作解析】本篇书面表达是一篇应用文。要求考生，写一篇征文启事，邀请同学们参加以“Beauty on the Campus”为主题的征文比赛。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
激励某人做某事：inspire sb. to do sth.→encourage sb. to do sth.
令人感动的：touching→moving
参加：get involved in→participate in
集中精力于：focus on→concentrate on
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：You can also focus on the beautiful campus in every season of the year.
拓展句：You can also focus on the beautiful campus in every season of the year, which is undoubtedly a good topic.
[高分句型1]
It’s our sincere hope that all of you can get involved in the competition and share your experience with us.（运用了it作形式主语，that引导主语从句）
[高分句型2]
You can submit your article, which is restricted to 1,000 words, by May 30.（运用了which引导非限制性定语从句）
8．How to Survive a Fire
In recent years, fire accidents have become a great concern in our country. Many fires have broken out in residential areas, factories, and public spaces leading to significant loss of life and property. It is crucial to enhance our awareness of fire safety and equip ourselves with essential self-rescue measures to effectively cope with such emergencies.
During a fire, quick thinking and immediate action make a difference between life and death. Firstly, it’s important to stay calm and call the fire department immediately to report the fire. If possible, escape through fire escape exits and use stair s instead of elevators. If trapped, seal off doors with wet towels to keep smoke out. Remember to cover your nose and mouth with wet cloth while crawling low beneath smoke to avoid breathing in poisonous gases.
It is our collective responsibility to prioritize the fire safety. Regular inspections, practicing fire drills, and ensuring the availability of functional fire extinguishers can make a significant difference. Only with joint efforts can we build a safer and safer community.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于说明文，要求考生以“How to Survive a Fire”为题为学校英语时报投一篇英文稿件。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
至关重要的：crucial→vital
提高：enhance→boost
首先：firstly→first and foremost
处理：cope with→deal with
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Firstly, it’s important to stay calm and call the fire department immediately to report the fire.
拓展句：Firstly, it’s important that we stay calm and call the fire department immediately to report the fire.
[高分句型1] If possible, escape through fire escape exits and use stair s instead of elevators. (运用了if引导的条件状语从句和省略句)
[高分句型2] Only with joint efforts can we build a safer and safer community. (运用了部分倒装句)
9．Last Friday, our school organized a meaningful visit to local inheritors of traditional culture, providing an invaluable opportunity for students to explore and appreciate our rich cultural heritage.
During the visit, students were warmly welcomed by the inheritors and had the chance to observe firsthand how traditional crafts and arts are passed down from generation to generation. The inheritors shared their stories and expertise, demonstrating the intricate skills required to maintain these age-old practices.
This enriching experience left students with a deeper understanding of the importance of preserving cultural heritage. The visit not only broadened students’ horizons but also fostered a sense of respect and appreciation for our cultural roots.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文写作中的新闻稿。要求考生就上周五学校组织的一次走访社区传统文化传承人的活动写一篇新闻稿，向校英语报投稿。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
无价的：invaluable→ precious/valuable
机会：opportunity → chance
重要性：importance → significance
培养：foster→ develop
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Last Friday, our school organized a meaningful visit to local inheritors of traditional culture, providing an invaluable opportunity for students to explore and appreciate our rich cultural heritage.
拓展句：Last Friday, our school organized a meaningful visit to local inheritors of traditional culture, which provided an invaluable opportunity for students to explore and appreciate our rich cultural heritage.
【高分句型1】During the visit, students were warmly welcomed by the inheritors and had the chance to observe firsthand how traditional crafts and arts are passed down from generation to generation.（运用了how引导的宾语从句）
【高分句型2】The visit not only broadened students’ horizons but also fostered a sense of respect and appreciation for our cultural roots.（运用了not only…but also…引导的并列句）
10．Aiming to relieve study pressure, enhance students’ physical and mental health, our school has launched the “Sunshine Sports” campaign over the past term.
Among a series of options, which include badminton, volleyball, tennis, table tennis and gymnastics, students select one autonomously based on interest. After confirming choices and grouped, they are guided to play certain sports respectively by PE teachers at 4 o’clock every Tuesday afternoon on the playground or in the school gym. 
I picked badminton as my event. After months’ training, my skills have been sharpened and my health improved obviously, and I am seldom seen sleepy in class now! It’s indeed a project worth promoting.
【写作解析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生向21st Century Teens的“Sunshine Sports”专栏投稿，介绍一下学校的阳光体育活动。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
增强：enhance→strengthen
挑选：select→pick out
明显地：obviously→evidently
压力：pressure→stress
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：It’s indeed a project worth promoting.
拓展句：It’s indeed a project that is worth promoting.
[高分句型1]Aiming to relieve study pressure, enhance students’ physical and mental health, our school has launched the “Sunshine Sports” campaign over the past term.（运用了现在分词作状语）
[高分句型2]Among a series of options, which include badminton, volleyball, tennis, table tennis and gymnastics, students select one autonomously based on interest.（运用了which引导非限制性定语从句）

第 1 页
征文(投稿)


第 2 页
【真题再现】
(2023· 全国乙卷改编)
　　学校英文报组织同学们分享自己在假期中学到的新技能, 请你以“Learning a new skill”为题写一篇短文投稿。内容包括: 
　　1. 简要描述; 　2. 体验和感受。

第 3 页
Step 1:  审题布局
类 型
投稿
人 称
第一人称(I)
时 态
一般现在时; 一般过去时
要 点
1. 描述学到的新技能
2. 过程与体验
3. 感受和收获

第 4 页
Step 2:  巧饰亮点
要点1: 一开始, 读五线谱上的音符是相当困难的。
一般表达: In the beginning, reading the notes on the stave was quite hard. 
→一开始, 读五线谱上的音符是相当困难的, 但是我没有放弃。(高级表达)
In the beginning, __________________________________on the stave, but I didn’t 
give up. 
it was quite difficult to read the notes 

第 5 页
要点2: 虽然经过几个小时的练习, 我的手指会感到疼痛, 但如果我能完整地演奏一
首曲子, 我就会感到满足。
_____________________________________________________, I felt satisfied if I 
could play a music piece completely. 
要点3: 即使我不会把弹钢琴作为我的终身职业, 我仍然会把它作为我最大的爱好。
_______________________________________________________, I will still regard it 
as my first hobby. 
Although my fingers were painful after a few hours’ practice
Even though I will not make playing the piano as my life career

第 6 页
Step 3:  衔接成篇
Learning a new skill 
　　When I was in my primary school, I had an opportunity to attend a musical contest held in my school. That was the first time I had watched a live musical performance. The fantastic players touched me deeply. 

第 7 页
　　I asked my parents to allow me to take up a piano lesson as a beginner. In the beginning, it was quite difficult to read the notes on the stave, but I didn’t give up. I spent most of my leisure hours practicing the piano. Although my fingers were painful after a few hours’ practice, I felt satisfied if I could play a music piece completely. 
　　Even though I will not make playing the piano as my life career, I will still regard it as my first hobby. 

第 8 页
【句式构储】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 引出话题
①Nowadays, more and more foreigners are becoming increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture. The reasons why there exists this phenomenon can be listed as follows. 
如今, 越来越多的外国人逐渐对中国传统文化感兴趣。存在这种现象的原因可以列举如下。

第 9 页
②I’m Li Hua, an editor of English newspaper of our school. Knowing you are familiar with the culture in your country, I’m writing to invite you to contribute an essay to share something with us. 
我是李华, 是我们学校英文报的编辑。我知道你对你的国家的文化很熟悉, 所以我写信邀请你写一篇文章与我们分享一些东西。

第 10 页
2. 篇中——详细描述, 讲清理由
①Among the many symbols that represent China and its unique culture, the Great Wall is on the top of my recommendation list. 在代表中国及其独特文化的众多象征中, 长城是我的首选推荐。
②Originally built by Emperor Qinshihuang and expanded and strengthened in the Ming Dynasty, it became the world’s largest military structure. 
它最初由秦始皇建造, 并在明朝扩建和加强, 成为世界上最大的军事建筑。

第 11 页
3. 结尾——再次总结全文
①In my view, it’s our country’s being strong that has made the cultural aspect of our country more appealing and charming. 在我看来, 正是我们国家的强大使我们国家的文化方面更具吸引力和魅力。
②I appreciate it because it is unique in the world. Besides, it makes drinking tea more enjoyable, and also gives us an insight into people’s lifestyle in the Song Dynasty. 我欣赏它, 因为它在世界上是独一无二的。此外, 它使喝茶变得更加愉快, 也让我们了解了宋代人们的生活方式。

第 12 页
【拓展训练】
　　21st Century Teens英文报正在就“越来越多的外国人爱上中国传统文化”这一现象举办征文活动, 请你写一篇英语短文投稿, 内容要点如下: 
　　1. 分析原因; 
　　2. 你的看法。
注意: 
　　1. 写作词数应为80个左右; 
　　2. 可以适当增加细节, 以使行文连贯; 
_________________________________________________________________

第 13 页
【参考范文】
　　Nowadays, more and more foreigners are becoming increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture. The reasons why there exists this phenomenon can be listed as follows. 
　　For one thing, China has a long history and evolves colorful, mysterious and unique cultures in its development, which makes it more attractive. For another, our country’s economy has been developing at a good pace. During their stay, they are also exposed to and fascinated by our diverse traditional cultures. 

第 14 页
　　And I think every one of us should take responsibility to spread our excellent traditional culture to the world. Only in this way can our country go further and be more stable on the way to realizing the Chinese Dream.

【句式构储】
1. 篇头——开篇表意, 引出话题
①Nowadays, more and more foreigners are becoming increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture. The reasons why there exists this phenomenon can be listed as follows.

②I’m Li Hua, an editor of English newspaper of our school. Knowing you are familiar with the culture in your country, I’m writing to invite you to contribute an essay to share something with us.

2. 篇中——详细描述, 讲清理由
①Among the many symbols that represent China and its unique culture, the Great Wall is on the top of my recommendation list. 在代表中国及其独特文化的众多象征中, 长城是我的首选推荐。
②Originally built by Emperor Qinshihuang and expanded and strengthened in the Ming Dynasty, it became the world’s largest military structure. 
它最初由秦始皇建造, 并在明朝扩建和加强, 成为世界上最大的军事建筑。

3. 结尾——再次总结全文
①In my view, it’s our country’s being strong that has made the cultural aspect of our country more appealing and charming. 在我看来, 正是我们国家的强大使我们国家的文化方面更具吸引力和魅力。
②I appreciate it because it is unique in the world. Besides, it makes drinking tea more enjoyable, and also gives us an insight into people’s lifestyle in the Song Dynasty. 我欣赏它, 因为它在世界上是独一无二的。此外, 它使喝茶变得更加愉快, 也让我们了解了宋代人们的生活方式。

　　Nowadays, more and more foreigners are becoming increasingly interested in traditional Chinese culture. The reasons why there exists this phenomenon can be listed as follows. 
　　For one thing, China has a long history and evolves colorful, mysterious and unique cultures in its development, which makes it more attractive. For another, our country’s economy has been developing at a good pace. During their stay, they are also exposed to and fascinated by our diverse traditional cultures.

句式的选择与应用
1.主语(S)+谓语(V).
【典型例句】
①What happened over there?那儿发生了什么? 
②The guests will soon be arriving.客人不久将到达。
【拓展训练】
①你本应该早点起床的。
You ought to ___________________________________. 
②比赛路线从我们学校门口开始,到南山脚下结束。
The racing route ___________________________________ at our school gate and ___________________________________ at the foot of the South Hill.
2.主语(S)+系动词(V)+表语(P).
【典型例句】
①Her job is looking after children.
她的工作是照顾小孩。
②The weather is becoming colder and colder.
天气变得越来越冷。
【拓展训练】
①她的梦想是成为一名工程师。
___________________________________
②在不久的将来, 我们的学校将变成更让人喜爱的地方。
___________________________________ in the near future. 
3.主语(S)+谓语(V)+宾语(O).
【典型例句】
①Farmers in my hometown grow all kinds of vegetables.我家乡的农民种植各种各样的蔬菜。 
②Danny runs a big bookstore.
丹尼经营一家大的书店。
【拓展训练】
①学生和老师们都度过了一段愉快的时光。
___________________________________
②因此,它的票房收入可能会稍微上升一点。
Therefore,___________________________________. 
4.主语(S)+及物动词(V)+间接宾语(O)+直接宾语(O).
【典型例句】
①His wife Tina cooked us a delicious dinner.
他的妻子蒂娜给我们做了一顿美味的晚餐。
②The competition offers adolescents a good chance to show their talents.这场竞赛给青少年提供了一个很好的展示才华的机会。
【拓展训练】
①我要告诉你我最近的生活和学习情况。
___________________________________ about my life and study in recent days. 
②这张画向我们展示了一个令人心动的时刻。
___________________________________
5.主语(S)+及物动词(V)+宾语(O)+宾语补足语(C).
【典型例句】
①Our teacher encouraged us to be persons enjoying labor.我们的老师鼓励我们成为热爱劳动的人。
②Mom asked me to find relevant information on the Internet.妈妈要求我在网上找一些相关信息。
【拓展训练】
①我们已把我们的城市变成了一座美丽的花园。
___________________________________
②孩子们觉得放鞭炮很有趣。
___________________________________
6.主语(S)+谓语(V)(不及物动词)+状语(A)(副词、名词、介词短语等).
【典型例句】
①He lives in the countryside.他住在乡下。
②Suddenly a little rabbit jumped out in front of my horse.突然一只小兔子从我马前跳了出来。
【拓展训练】
①(2022 ·新高考Ⅱ卷)布朗一家住在多伦多郊外的一栋公寓楼里。
The Brown family ___________________________________ an apartment building ___________________________________ Toronto. 
②这两个骑自行车的人出现在马路对面。
___________________________________
7.主语(S)+谓语(V)+宾语(O)+状语(A).
【典型例句】
①Tom put his books on the desk.
汤姆把他的书放在书桌上。
②They treat us very well.他们对我们很好。
【拓展训练】
①我必须通过阅读关于文化方面的书籍来提高自己。
___________________________________
②你能够写一些有关你们当地的美国文化的东西吗?
___________________________________
8.There be+主语+其他.
【典型例句】
①There’s a restaurant around the corner.
拐角处有一家餐馆。
②There stands a hill in the middle of the park.
在公园中央有一座小山。
【拓展训练】
①不远处有一座桥, 沿着桥你就能找到那棵树并摘到更多水果。
Not far away ___________________________________. 
②下周我校将举行中国剪纸展。
Next week ___________________________________ exhibition held by our school. 
【语篇填空】
根据所给信息补全短文, 注意句式结构的使用。
Dear Leslie,
How are you? Glad to see you have made some progress in Chinese learning and I’m writing to tell you something about our next lesson.
The lesson will be given from 3 pm to 5 pm on the afternoon of next Tuesday in the classroom 502.In the class, ___________________________________ (你将主要学习唐诗), which reflects traditional Chinese culture and is deeply loved by Chinese.You can feel the beauty of Chinese by learning Tang poetry.___________________________________ (你最好课前做好充足的准备) and have a brief understanding of the history of Tang Dynasty,___________________________________ (它会让你轻松地上完这节课). 
___________________________________ (如果有什么我能帮你的), please don’t hesitate to tell me.Looking forward to meeting you. 
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【综合演练】
1．假定你是李华，你的外国朋友Ken打算用AI工具来辅助他的汉语学习，发来邮件询问你的意见。请你回复邮件，内容包括：
1. 提出建议；
2. 简述原因；
3. 表达期待。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Ken,
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
2．假定你是校英语戏剧社社长李华，原定于下周举行的英语戏剧表演赛因故推迟，请你给担任评委的外教Katherine写邮件，内容包括：
1. 表达歉意；
2. 说明理由；
3. 后续调整。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Katherine, 
I’m Li Hua, leader of the English drama club. 
__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely, 
Li Hua
3．假设你是李华，你所在的学校为了帮助学生应对高考压力，组织了一次名为“轻松备考，快乐学习”（Relax and Prepare with Joy）的减压活动。请你根据以下要点，用英文写一篇报道，介绍这次活动的情况。要点包括：
1.活动的时间和地点；
2.活动过程； 
3.活动的意义。
注意：1.词数80左右；
2.可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
4．假定你是李华，你的瑞士朋友Richard暑期想来中国旅游，他发来邮件请你给他推荐一些值得游览的城市。请你给他回一封邮件，内容包括：
1.推荐旅行城市以及理由；
2.提供一些在华旅行的小贴士。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；
2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Richard，
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
5．假定你是李华，你校将于下周末举办英语朗诵比赛（recitation competition），请给你的外教Mr. Wesley写一封电子邮件，请他给你指导一下英语发音。内容包括：
1. 朗诵比赛情况介绍；
2. 请求老师帮助；
3. 附带你的朗读录音。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Mr. Wesley,
How is everything going with you?
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
6．假设你是红星中学高二学生李华，下一届青运会（The Youth Games ）将在你们城市举行，现在正在招募志愿者，你想成为其中一员，请你用英文给组委会写一封电子邮件，内容应包括：
1. 自我介绍；
2. 申请理由；
3. 自身优势.
注意:1.100 词左右；
2.开头结尾已给出，不计入总词数。
Dear Sir/Madam,
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua

documents.local_content:
第 1 页
句式的选择与应用

第 2 页
1.主语(S)+谓语(V).
【典型例句】 
①What happened over there?那儿发生了什么? 
②The guests will soon be arriving.客人不久将到达。

第 3 页
【拓展训练】 
①你本应该早点起床的。
You ought to __________________. 
②比赛路线从我们学校门口开始,到南山脚下结束。
The racing route ________ at our school gate and _______ at the foot of the South Hill.
have got up earlier
started
ended

第 4 页
2.主语(S)+系动词(V)+表语(P).
【典型例句】 
①Her job is looking after children.
她的工作是照顾小孩。
②The weather is becoming colder and colder.
天气变得越来越冷。
【拓展训练】 
①她的梦想是成为一名工程师。
________________________________
②在不久的将来, 我们的学校将变成更让人喜爱的地方。
__________________________________________in the near future. 
Her dream is to become an engineer. 
Our school will become a more enjoyable place 

第 5 页
3.主语(S)+谓语(V)+宾语(O).
【典型例句】 
①Farmers in my hometown grow all kinds of vegetables.我家乡的农民种植各种各样的蔬菜。 
②Danny runs a big bookstore.
丹尼经营一家大的书店。
【拓展训练】 
①学生和老师们都度过了一段愉快的时光。
_________________________________________
②因此,它的票房收入可能会稍微上升一点。
Therefore,__________________________________________________. 
The students and teachers shared a great time. 
its box-office income will probably enjoy a slight increase

第 6 页
4.主语(S)+及物动词(V)+间接宾语(O)+直接宾语(O).
【典型例句】 
①His wife Tina cooked us a delicious dinner.
他的妻子蒂娜给我们做了一顿美味的晚餐。
②The competition offers adolescents a good chance to show their talents.
这场竞赛给青少年提供了一个很好的展示才华的机会。
【拓展训练】 
①我要告诉你我最近的生活和学习情况。
______________________about my life and study in recent days. 
②这张画向我们展示了一个令人心动的时刻。
_____________________________________
I will tell you something 
The picture shows us a touching moment. 

第 7 页
5.主语(S)+及物动词(V)+宾语(O)+宾语补足语(C).
【典型例句】 
①Our teacher encouraged us to be persons enjoying labor.
我们的老师鼓励我们成为热爱劳动的人。
②Mom asked me to find relevant information on the Internet.
妈妈要求我在网上找一些相关信息。
【拓展训练】 
①我们已把我们的城市变成了一座美丽的花园。
______________________________________
②孩子们觉得放鞭炮很有趣。
________________________________________________
We have made our city a beautiful garden. 
Children find setting off firecrackers very interesting. 

第 8 页
6.主语(S)+谓语(V)(不及物动词)+状语(A)(副词、名词、介词短语等).
【典型例句】 
①He lives in the countryside.他住在乡下。
②Suddenly a little rabbit jumped out in front of my horse.突然一只小兔子从我马前跳了出来。
【拓展训练】 
①(2022 ·新高考Ⅱ卷)布朗一家住在多伦多郊外的一栋公寓楼里。
The Brown family _______ an apartment building ________ Toronto. 
②这两个骑自行车的人出现在马路对面。
______________________________________
live in
outside
The two cyclists turned up across the road. 

第 9 页
7.主语(S)+谓语(V)+宾语(O)+状语(A).
【典型例句】 
①Tom put his books on the desk.
汤姆把他的书放在书桌上。
②They treat us very well.他们对我们很好。
【拓展训练】 
①我必须通过阅读关于文化方面的书籍来提高自己。
_______________________________________________________
②你能够写一些有关你们当地的美国文化的东西吗?
______________________________________________________________
______________
I have to improve myself by reading some books about culture. 
Would you please write something about the culture in your part of the 
United States? 

第 10 页
8.There be+主语+其他.
【典型例句】 
①There’s a restaurant around the corner.
拐角处有一家餐馆。
②There stands a hill in the middle of the park.
在公园中央有一座小山。
【拓展训练】 
①不远处有一座桥, 沿着桥你就能找到那棵树并摘到更多水果。
Not far away ____________________________________________________. 
②下周我校将举行中国剪纸展。
Next week _________________________________ exhibition held by our school. 
there is a bridge that can lead you to the tree for more fruit
there will be a Chinese paper-cutting

第 11 页
【语篇填空】
根据所给信息补全短文, 注意句式结构的使用。
Dear Leslie,
  How are you? Glad to see you have made some progress in Chinese learning and I’m writing to tell you something about our next lesson.

第 12 页
      The lesson will be given from 3 pm to 5 pm on the afternoon of next Tuesday in 
the classroom 502.In the class, _______________________________(你将主要学习
唐诗), which reflects traditional Chinese culture and is deeply loved by Chinese.You 
can feel the beauty of Chinese by learning Tang poetry._____________________ 
_______________________(你最好课前做好充足的准备) and have a brief 
understanding of the history of Tang Dynasty,______________________________ 
_________________(它会让你轻松地上完这节课). 
   __________________________________ (如果有什么我能帮你的), please 
don’t  hesitate to tell me.Looking forward to meeting you. 
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
you will mainly learn Tang poetry 
You’d better make full
preparations before class 
which makes it easy for you to go
through the class 
If there is anything that I can help you

词汇的选择与锤炼
1.替换常用简单词(短语)
(1)名词(短语)变换

→youngsters/youths/adolescents

(2)动词(短语)变换

 awareness of

(4)其他词(组)变换

【典型例句】
①On the one hand, too much praise might lead to children’s lack of enthusiasm to explore new things(缺乏探索新事物的热情), for they are afraid they won’t meet parents’ expectations(满足父母的期望).
②Considering the enormous benefits(考虑到巨大的益处), which we can earn steadily from tennis practice, including preventing us from getting short-sighted (防止我们近视)and helping us keep physically healthy, we are lost in the training course.
【拓展训练】
①The special day allows people to ___________________________________(对……表达爱和情感) their fathers. 
②___________________________________(是明智的)for people to use their cellphones ___________________________________(更恰当地). 
③___________________________________(没有充分的准备), you can hardly expect to answer all the questions correctly and obtain satisfactory marks, let alone be admitted into ___________________________________(梦想的大学). 
④Tracy said she had already ___________________________________(通知苏珊) the change of the appointment. 
⑤People generally thought it impossible for the Chinese team to win the championship in the Rio Olympic Games, but they ___________________________________(克服许多障碍) and ___________________________________(最终创造了奇迹). 
⑥Drama Night ___________________________________ (预定)be held on the evening of next Friday in the theatre hall. 
⑦___________________________________(此外), having been awarded scholarship twice in our school, I have ___________________________________(极好的学术成就). 
⑧This phenomenon has ___________________________________ (成为焦点)we must face today because of ___________________________________ (许多严重后果)caused by improper use of cellphones. 
2.变化所用词的词性
在作文中, 可以通过改变一个词的词性, 使文章富有变化, 让阅卷者感受到考生对词汇各种用法的掌握水平和灵活运用的程度。常见的变化词性的策略有名词变动词、动词变名词、形容词变名词等。
(1)名词变动词
People are concerned about the gradual disappearance of the traditional values.
→People are concerned because the traditional values are gradually disappearing.
传统价值观正在渐渐地消亡, 这让人们很担忧。
(2)动词变名词
After watching his performance, I found he could really dance very well.
→After watching his performance, I found him a really good dancer.
看了他的表演之后, 我发现他跳舞跳得很棒。
(3)形容词变名词
I wrote a letter to Tom to thank him for his being so kind.
→I wrote a letter to Tom to thank him for his kindness.
我写信给汤姆对他的善良表示感谢。
3.善用短语
汉语
高级短语
努力

从事

【拓展训练】
①The special day allows people to show their love and affection for(对……表达爱和情感) their fathers. 
②It’s advisable/wise(是明智的)for people to use their cellphones more appropriately/properly(更恰当地). 
③Without sufficient preparation(没有充分的准备), you can hardly expect to answer all the questions correctly and obtain satisfactory marks, let alone be admitted into a desirable university(梦想的大学). 
④Tracy said she had already informed Susan of(通知苏珊) the change of the appointment. 
⑤People generally thought it impossible for the Chinese team to win the championship in the Rio Olympic Games, but they overcame many hurdles(克服许多障碍) and eventually worked miracles/wonders(最终创造了奇迹). 
⑥Drama Night is scheduled to (预定)be held on the evening of next Friday in the theatre hall. 
⑦Additionally(此外), having been awarded scholarship twice in our school, I have excellent academic performance(极好的学术成就). 
⑧This phenomenon has become a concern/focus (成为焦点)we must face today because of many serious consequences (许多严重后果)caused by improper use of cellphones. 
2.变化所用词的词性
在作文中, 可以通过改变一个词的词性, 使文章富有变化, 让阅卷者感受到考生对词汇各种用法的掌握水平和灵活运用的程度。常见的变化词性的策略有名词变动词、动词变名词、形容词变名词等。
(1)名词变动词
People are concerned about the gradual disappearance of the traditional values.
→People are concerned because the traditional values are gradually disappearing.
传统价值观正在渐渐地消亡, 这让人们很担忧。
(2)动词变名词
After watching his performance, I found he could really dance very well.
→After watching his performance, I found him a really good dancer.
看了他的表演之后, 我发现他跳舞跳得很棒。
(3)形容词变名词
I wrote a letter to Tom to thank him for his being so kind.
→I wrote a letter to Tom to thank him for his kindness.
我写信给汤姆对他的善良表示感谢。

All in all, I sincerely invite(诚挚地邀请) you to come to our school and see for yourself. 
Yours,
Li Hua

参考答案
1．Dear Tom,
It’s great to hear from you. Knowing that you’re interested in famous figures in Chinese history, I am very glad to share with you my favourite one.
Talking of my favourite figure in Chinese history, I can’t help thinking of Qu Yuan, a great patriotic poet with Lisao as his masterpiece. In honour of him, the Dragon Boat Festival was born. Whenever I read his poems, I am lost in thought. His spirit encourages me to love my country and try something new.
If you’re interested in him, I’ll find his work for you. Looking forward to your early reply.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给Tom回信，介绍一位喜欢并且崇拜的历史人物。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
为纪念：in honour of→in memory of
感兴趣：be interested in→take interest in
高兴：glad→delighted
想起：think of→recall
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Talking of my favourite figure in Chinese history, I can’t help thinking of Qu Yuan, a great patriotic poet with Lisao as his masterpiece.
拓展句：Talking of my favourite figure in Chinese history, I can’t help thinking of Qu Yuan, who was a great patriotic poet with Lisao as his masterpiece.
[高分句型1] If you’re interested in him, I’ll find his work for you. (运用了if引导条件状语从句)
[高分句型2] Whenever I read his poems, I am lost in thought. (运用了whenever引导让步状语从句)
2．Dear teachers and fellow students,
I am deeply honored to welcome you all to our school’s English Drama Society’s annual showcase. 
This event is a celebration of our creativity, hard work, and passion for the English language and theater. Tonight, we will be treated to a series of compelling performances, each reflecting the unique vision and talent of our members.
We hope you enjoy the show and are inspired by the stories and characters brought to life on our stage.
【写作分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生为你校英语话剧社拟举办英语话剧展演活动写一篇开幕辞。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
荣幸：honored→privileged
精彩的：compelling→splendid
喜爱：enjoy→be fond of
热情：passion→enthusiasm
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Tonight, we will be treated to a series of compelling performances, each reflecting the unique vision and talent of our members.
拓展句：Tonight, we will be treated to a series of compelling performances, which reflects the unique vision and talent of our members.
[高分句型1] Tonight, we will be treated to a series of compelling performances, each reflecting the unique vision and talent of our members. (运用了独立主格结构)
[高分句型2] We hope you enjoy the show and are inspired by the stories and characters brought to life on our stage. (运用了省去that的宾语从句和过去分词作定语)
3．Notice
Next week, our school will hold an English lecture on The World Wildlife Day. 
The lecture will be given from 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. in the school auditorium on Sunday. The content of the lecture will include the significance of the day and ways to protect wildlife. Besides, there will be a question-and-answer session where you can put forward your ways to protecte the wildlife. I believe that after the lecture, you will get the chance to know how you can do in daily life to protect wildlife.
Everyone who is interested in the lecture is welcome to attend.
The Student Council
March, 1
【写作分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生就你校将于下周将举行的一场英文讲座写一则英文通知。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
举办：hold→host
重要性：significance→importance
此外：besides→in addition
提出：put forward→come up with
2.句式拓展
合并简单句
原句：The lecture will be given from 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. in the school auditorium on Sunday. The content of the lecture will include the significance of the day and ways to protect wildlife.
拓展句：The lecture will be given from 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. in the school auditorium on Sunday, the content of which will include the significance of the day and ways to protect wildlife.
【高分句型1】Besides, there will be a question-and-answer session where you can put up with your ways to protecte the wildlife. (运用了where引导的限制性定语从句)
【高分句型2】I believe that after the lecture, you will get the chance to know how you can do in daily life to protect wildlife.(运用了that引导的宾语从句和how引导的宾语从句)
4．
“Duolingo” is an excellent app that combines fun and effective English learning methods. It offers a wide range of interactive lessons, ranging from vocabulary exercises, quizzes to speaking and listening tasks. What’s worth mentioning is that it uses game-like elements to make learning more engaging and enjoyable.
After using Duolingo for a while, I find it is such an incredibly useful tool that I’m willing to say learning English has become an indispensable part of my life. With varieties of exercises and the user-friendly interface, not only does it make my learning experience pleasurable and productive but also it deepens my insight into English learning.
If you’re struggling to find a useful tool for English learning, Duolingo is definitely worth a try. I’m firmly convinced that you’ll love it as much as I do.
【写作分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一篇短文向校英语社团“Learning English”的微信公众号投稿，向同学们推荐一款兼顾趣味与英语学习的app。
【要点分析】1. 词汇积累
杰出的：excellent→outstanding
提供：offer→provide
非常地：incredibly→remarkably
各种各样的：varieties of→a diversity of
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：It offers a wide range of interactive lessons, ranging from vocabulary exercises, quizzes to speaking and listening tasks.
拓展句：It offers a wide range of interactive lessons, which range from vocabulary exercises, quizzes to speaking and listening tasks.
【高分句型1】“Duolingo” is an excellent app that combines fun and effective English learning methods. (运用了that引导的定语从句)
【高分句型2】What’s worth mentioning is that it uses game-like elements to make learning more engaging and enjoyable. (运用了that引导的表语从句和what引导的主语从句)
【高分句型3】With varieties of exercises and the user-friendly interface, not only does it make my learning experience pleasurable and productive but also it deepens my insight into English learning. (运用了部分倒装)
5．Dear Frank,
      How are you doing? I’m writing to invite you to go for a morning run with me, which may benefit both of us in an amazing way.
      When I was in junior high school, I often got sick due to lack of exercise. So I picked up running in the morning. Since then, running has played an important role in my life, without which I wouldn’t have built strong body. I think it is a good way to keep fit. That’s why I want to invite you to join me. Before running, it is necessary to have some preparation exercises, such as pressing legs and swinging arms. What’s more, make sure appropriate shoes and clothing are worn.
      I hope you can join me in exercising. Looking forward to your early reply.
                                                                                                                                                                  Best regards,
                                                                                                                                                                  Li Hua
【写作分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生按照提示给交换生Frank发邮件，邀请Frank一起晨跑。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
重要的：important→significant
健康的：fit→healthy
必要的：necessary→essential
另外：what’s more→in addition
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：Before running, it is necessary to have some preparation exercises, such as pressing legs and swinging arms.
拓展句：Before running, it is necessary that we have some preparation exercises, such as pressing legs and swinging arms.
[高分句型1] I’m writing to invite you to go for a morning run with me, which may benefit both of us in an amazing way. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] Since then, running has played an important role in my life, without which I wouldn’t have built strong body. (运用了“介词+which”引导的非限制性定语从句)
6．Dear Mr. Smith,
I’m Li Hua from Class 5, Grade 3 of our school. I’m writing to seek your help regarding idioms. I find it quite challenging to grasp the meanings of some idioms while reading English texts. They often confuse me, and I’m not sure how to interpret them correctly. I know that idioms are a crucial part of English language learning, and I am eager to improve my understanding of them.
I would really appreciate it if you could share some strategies or tips on how to better understand and remember idioms. Your guidance would be invaluable to me. Thank you very much for your time and support.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生给外教Mr. Smith 写封邮件，说明自己在英语阅读过程中时对一些习语感到的困惑并向对方寻求帮助。
【要点分析】1.词汇积累
关于：regarding→concerning
理解：grasp→comprehend
使困惑：confuse→puzzle
无价的：invaluable→priceless
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：They often confuse me, and I’m not sure how to interpret them correctly.
拓展句：They often confuse me, and I’m not sure how I can interpret them correctly.
【高分句型1】I find it quite challenging to grasp the meanings of some idioms while reading English texts.（运用了状语从句的省略，不定式作真正宾语，it为形式宾语）
【高分句型2】I know that idioms are a crucial part of English language learning, and I am eager to improve my understanding of them.（运用了that引导的宾语从句）

2.变化所用词的词性
  在作文中, 可以通过改变一个词的词性, 使文章富有变化, 让阅卷者感受到考生对词汇各种用法的掌握水平和灵活运用的程度。常见的变化词性的策略有名词变动词、动词变名词、形容词变名词等。
(1)名词变动词
People are concerned about the gradual disappearance of the traditional values.
→People are concerned because the traditional values are gradually disappearing.
传统价值观正在渐渐地消亡, 这让人们很担忧。

(2)动词变名词
After watching his performance, I found he could really dance very well.
→After watching his performance, I found him a really good dancer.
看了他的表演之后, 我发现他跳舞跳得很棒。
(3)形容词变名词
I wrote a letter to Tom to thank him for his being so kind.
→I wrote a letter to Tom to thank him for his kindness.
我写信给汤姆对他的善良表示感谢。

quickly as possible

衔接的选择与巧用
1.用好连接词
在句与句之间、段与段之间恰当地使用一些承上启下的连接性词语是语言连贯性得以实现的最常用手段。常见的连接性词语归纳如下:
(1)起始关系: to begin with, first of all, as we all know, as is known, as is shown in..., according to 等。
As we all know(众所周知), good learning habits contribute to efficient study.
(2)时间顺序: at the beginning, then, later, finally, at last, in the end, afterwards, since then, after that, immediately, meanwhile等。
At the beginning(起初), I collected all the things scattered in the rooms and put them in place.Then I wiped the dust off all the furniture.After that, I mopped the floor.
(3)条件关系: if, unless, in case(of), as/so long as, on condition that, provided (that)等。
I would be very grateful if you could meet my uncle at the airport.
(4)转折关系: but, yet, however, while, otherwise, on the contrary, nevertheless等。
However, not until the match was over did we realize that we lost it.
(5)因果关系: because, as, since, for, thanks to, due to, as a result of, so, therefore, as a result/consequence等。
Therefore, there is no reason for us to look down upon ordinary jobs.
(6)并列关系: and, or, as well as, not only...but also..., either...or..., not...but..., neither...nor...等。
We will have a good time there and I will send you some photos taken there.
(7)递进关系: besides, what’s more, moreover, furthermore, what’s worse, still less, to make matters worse, worse still, more importantly等。
Many of them can hardly look after themselves,still less manage their own lives.
(8)列举事实: such as, for example/instance, take...for example, that is to say, as follows, in other words, on the one hand...on the other hand..., for one thing...for another...等。
On the one hand(一方面), I can earn some money by doing it to help my parents; on the other hand(另一方面), I can gain some experience from it, which will do good to my future life.
(9)表示观点: in my opinion, in my view, from my point of view, as far as I am concerned, as for me, personally等。
As far as I am concerned(就我而言), they stand for love, friendship and unity.
(10)总结: in short, in brief, in conclusion, in a word, to sum up, all in all, on the whole, in general, generally speaking等。
All in all(总之), traveling is the best choice for us to enrich our lives and get ready for the new challenges.
2.写好衔接句
(1)引出开头
It is well-known to us that...
我们都知道……
As far as my knowledge is concerned...
据我所知……
Recently the problem of...has been brought into focus.
=Nowadays there is growing concern over the problem of...
最近……问题引起了关注。
(2)表达不同观点
People’s views on...vary from person to person.Some hold that...However, others believe that...人们对……的观点因人而异。有些人认为……然而,其他人相信……
People may have different opinions on...
人们对……可能会持有不同见解。
(3)表示结尾
In short, it can be said that...
总之, 可以说……
From what has been mentioned above, we can come to the conclusion that...
综上所述, 我们可以得出结论……
(4)提出建议
It is high time that...
该是……的时候了。
Only in this way can we...
只有这样, 我们才能……
(5)预示后果
Obviously, if we don’t control the problem, the chances are that...will lead us in danger.
显然,如果我们不控制问题,很有可能……会把我们引向危险之中。
(6)给出原因或顺序
For one thing,...;for another,...
On the one hand,...;on the other hand,...
一方面,……;另一方面,……
【语篇填空】
请根据上下文填写适当的连接词, 并体会其用法。
Dear Lucy,
I’m sorry to hear that you are having difficulty in learning math.________________ is well-known to us, math is playing a more and more important role in the development of science.
You’d better have both feet on the ground in several aspects.________________, interest is the best teacher, ________________ try to get interested in it.________________, it’s really important to form a good habit of learning math.________________, you should make every effort to develop all kinds of abilities concerning learning math. 
Please remember that hard work pays off.
Yours,
Li Hua
