专题07 应用文之报道
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2023
2023年浙江1月卷
提纲式
报道“认识我们身边的植物”活动
2020
2020全国II卷
提纲式
报道一次采摘活动
2020全国I卷
提纲式
报道5公里越野赛跑活动
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
报道是对新近发生的事情进行的如实描述。对客观事实进行报道而形成的信息就是新闻，反映在新闻信息中的内容必须具有真实性和可传达性，因此，报道的特点就是用事实说话。
【写作方法】
报道一般包含：标题、导语、主体和结语。
标题：浓缩概括全文的中心实质问题，提炼要点，吸引读者。
导语：揭示事件的核心内容。
主体：消息的主要部分，它用充足的事实表现主题，是对导语内容的进一步展开和阐释。
结语：一般是最后一段话或一句话，是对全文内容的概括性总结。
据此可遵循以下写作步骤：
第一步，提炼报道的要点并列出标题；
第二步，揭示事件核心内容的导语，
第三步，对主题进行扩展和解释；
第四步，对报道进行概括性总结。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
常见开头——目的、时间、地点、参与人员等
1.为了.....，（以.....为主题）xxx活动由谁于xxx时间xxx地点举行/组织，吸引谁的广泛关注/谁积极参与。
With the aim of..., xxx 活动 (themed...) was held/organized by sb.+地点+时间，attracting one’s widespread attention/ one’s active participation.
2.xxx时间见证了xxx活动由xxx发起，获得巨大反响/深受欢迎。
xxx时间 witnessed xxx 活动 launched by sb., gaining impressive responses/great popularity.
活动过程及意义——运动(赛事)体验类、文艺活动类、演讲讲座类
运动(赛事)体验类
1.沐浴在温暖阳光下，我们情绪高涨参与xxx活动(远足/赛跑等)，展现了我们的.....（具体的品质：活力/韧性等）
Bathed(Immersed) in the warm sunshine, we got involved in xxx活动(hike/race) in high spirits, displaying our....( vitality/resilience)
2.尽管xxx (过程艰苦/比赛激烈)，没有一个人放弃，而是坚持到最后（努力配合彼此），因此赢得大家的赞赏/给大家留下深刻印象。
Despite/In spite of/Regardless of xxx( the hard journe/competitive game)，no one gave up but persisted to the end( made efforts to cooperate with each other), thus earning everyone’s admiration/ leaving an indelible mark on everyone.
3.户外类型：在xxx时间xxx地点集合，我们充满期待地前往xxx地点。一路上（一到那里），某物就展现在我们面前，使我们充满惊奇。最后迎来活动的高光时刻，那时我们......
Gathering(Assembling) +地点+时间，we headed toward+地点with high expectations. All the way( Upon arrival), we were greeted by sth. unfolding before our eyes, astonishing us a lot. Eventually came the highlight of the activity when we...
文艺活动类（可参照邀请信部分内容）
1.如期举行，该活动向某人展示了一系列的xxx(艺术品之类的)，这不仅....，而且....
As scheduled, this activity displayed to sb. a wide range of xxx, which not only...., but also...
2.活动期间，参与者们向观众呈现了精彩的xxx(表演/歌曲/朗诵等)，对观众来说是一场视(听)盛宴/给他们带来非凡的体验。
During the activity, participants presented to the audience brilliant xxx (performances/songs/recitation), which were a visual(-audio) enjoyment/ bringing them remarkable experience.
演讲/讲座类
该活动，以....为主题/以......为特色，将分成两(三)部分,每部分给大家留下印象深刻。
The activity, themed.../featuring...., fell into two(three) parts, each leaving an indelible mark on everyone involved. 
2. 首先，该活动以A作为开始，在A中学生们......，紧跟着是由谁来做的活动B，详细介绍了.......。最后，活动C给该活动画上圆满的句号。
Initially, the activity began with A, where students ... Then followed B done by sb., with a detail introduction on... In the end,  C  brought the activity to a successful end. 
活动反响、意义等
1.所有人对这个活动高度赞赏，认为其不仅具有富有趣味，又充满教育意义。
All thought highly of this activity, considering it not only entertaining but also educational.
2.这个活动无疑是成功的，通过它，大家对....兴趣/热情/意识等得到提高，决心做某事。
This activity was undoubtedly a success, through which everyone’s interest in/enthusiasm for/ awarenss of..was enhanced, with resolve to do sth.
3.这个活动获得大家广泛认可，因为其使得他们.......，及激励他们.......
This activity gained widespread recognition from everyone due to the fact that it enabled them to do..., and inspired them to do...
【写作模板】
       活动名称 Successfully Held
       时间witnessed a/an 形容词activity titled “题目” held by 主办方+地点, which involved 参与人, with the intention of目的（动词用doing）.
      As scheduled, the activity started with 活动1, which活动1意义. Then, under the guidance of指导人,a series of fascinating activities were organized, ranging from活动2 to活动3. Undoubtedly, There were many moments when we were amazed at the excellent performances of 参与人. However, what impressed me most was that 精彩瞬间（完整句子表述）
     The activity benefited us a lot, through which not only did we 感受1(动词原形）, but we also 感受2(动词过去式）.
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2023年浙江1月卷】
上周末你参加了校学生会组织的“认识我们身边的植物”活动。请为校英文报写篇报道，内容包括：
1. 活动的过程；
2. 收获与感想。
注意：
1. 写作词数应为80左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Getting to Know the Plants Around Us
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Getting to Know the Plants Around Us
      Last weekend, I participated in a “Getting to Know the Plants Around Us” activity organised by our Students’ Union. 
      The activity began with a lecture by a local botanist, who taught us about the different characteristics and uses of various plant species. We then went on a natural walk to observe and collect samples of different plants. Throughout the event, I was struck by the incredible variety of plants that exist in our world and learned about plants that are used for medical purposes, as well as those that provide food and shelter for animals. I also gained a greater appreciation for the role that plants play in maintaining the balance of our ecosystem.
       Overall, it was a valuable and enriching experience. 
【导语】本篇书面表达属于应用文。要求考生为校英文报写篇报道，介绍上周末校学生会组织的“认识我们身边的植物”活动。
【详解】1. 词汇积累
参与：participate in → attend
开始：begin → start
观察，调查：observe → survey
震惊：strike → astonish/surprise
2. 句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句： Last weekend, I participated in a “Getting to Know the Plants Around Us” activity organised by our Students’ Union.
拓展句： Last weekend, I participated in a “Getting to Know the Plants Around Us” activity organised by our Students’ Union, which benefited me a lot.
【点睛】
【高分句型1】The activity began with a lecture by a local botanist, who taught us about the different characteristics and uses of various plant species.（运用了who引导的非限制性定语从句）
【高分句型2】Throughout the event, I was struck by the incredible variety of plants that exist in our world and learned about plants that are used for medical purposes, as well as those that provide food and shelter for animals.（运用了一般过去时的被动语态和定语从句）
【2020全国II卷】
上周末，你和同学参加了一次采摘活动。请你为班级英语角写一篇短文，介绍这次活动，内容包括:
1. 农场情况；
2. 采摘过程；
3. 个人感受
注意:
1. 词数100左右；
2. 题目已为你写好。
My Weekend
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
My Weekend
Organized by the student union, a group of volunteers went to Hope Farm to help the farmers pick peaches last weekend. The farm is situated at the foot of a mountain, the sky is blue and the air is fresh. We were attracted by the beautiful scenery. There are different kinds of fruit trees as well as a variety of animals.
On arriving, we saw red ripe peaches hanging on the tree. Using baskets and ladders, We first picked the ones that were most beautiful in color, then those that were ripe and soft. I couldn’t wait to take a bite, and the sweet juice went down my throat.
I was grateful for this opportunity to get close to nature. Not only would I be able to experience fruit picking, but I could also feast on the sweetness!
【详解】第一步：根据提示可知，上周末，你和同学参加了一次采摘活动。请你为班级英语角写一篇短文，介绍这次活动。内容包括： 1. 农场情况； 2. 采摘过程； 3. 个人感受。
第二步：根据写作要求确定关键词（组），如：pick peaches, is situated, beautiful scenery, fruit trees ,a variety of animals, Using baskets and ladders, take a bite, be grateful for, get close to nature, feast on the sweetness.
第三步：根据提示和关键词（组）进行遣词造句，注意主谓一致和时态问题。本文用一般现在时和一般过去时。
第四步：连句成文，注意使用恰当的连词进行句子之间的衔接和过渡，书写一定要规范清晰，保持整洁美观的卷面是非常重要的。
【点睛】
范文内容完整，语言规范，语篇连贯，词数适当。作者在范文中使用了较多高级表达方式，如 Organized by the student union, a group of volunteers went to Hope Farm to help the farmers pick peaches last weekend. 和Using baskets and ladders运用了非谓语动词；We first picked the ones that were most beautiful in color, then those that were ripe and soft. 运用了定语从句；Not only would I be able to experience fruit picking, but I could also feast on the sweetness!运用了连词not only…but…和倒装句。全文中没有中国式英语的句式，显示了很高的驾驭英语的能力。另外，文章思路清晰，层次分明，上下句转换自然，为文章增色添彩。
【2020全国I卷】
假定你是李华, 上周日你校举办了5公里越野赛跑活动。请你为校英文报写一篇报道, 内容包括:
1. 参加人员；
2.跑步路线:从校门口到南山脚下；
3. 活动反响。
注意:
1. 写作词数应为80左右:
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
A Cross-Country Running Race
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
A Cross-Country Running Race
Last Sunday witnessed an extraordinary cross-country running race, which nearly drew the attention of every student and teacher of our school.
The students selected from every class took part in the competition. The route measured five kilometers, from our school gate to the foot of Nanshan Mountain. Every runner tried their best to finish the task, with their classmates along the way giving them necessarily help as well as encouragement. At last, all the runners managed to arrive the finish line, receiving cheers from all the directions.
The activity was highly spoken of, because not only did it provide chance for us to exercise, but also made us more cohesive.
【解析】这是一篇应用文。本篇要求考生就上周日学校举行的5公里越野赛活动写一篇新闻报道。
【详解】体裁:应用文
时态:根据提示，时态应以一般过去时为主
结构:总分总
要求:
1. 参加人员
2. 跑步路线
3. 活动反响
第二步:列提纲(重点词组)
attend/witness/ draw one’s attention/ manage to do sth./ measure/ speak highly of/ provide sth. for sb.
第三步:连词成句
1. Last Sunday witnessed an extraordinary cross-country running race, which nearly drew the attention of every student and teacher of our school.
2. The students selected from every class took part in the competition.
3. The route measured five kilometers, from our school gate to the foot of Nanshan Mountain.
4. Every runner tried their best to finish the task, with their classmates along the way giving them necessary help as well as encouragement.
5. At last, all the runners managed to arrive the finish line, receiving cheers from all the directions.
6. The activity is highly spoken of, because not only does it provide chance for us to exercise, but also makes us more cohesive.
第四步:连句成篇(加入衔接词或从句)
表示并列的连词:and/but/or/so…
状语从句连词:because/ if/ though/ although…
定语从句连词:which/ that/ when/ where…
第五步:修改润色(加入高级词汇或短语)
【点睛】
范文内容完整，要点全面，语言规范，语篇连贯，词数适当，上下文意思连贯，符合逻辑关系。作者在范文中使用了一些高分句型，例如:Last Sunday witnessed an extraordinary cross-country running race, which nearly drew the attention of every student and teacher of our school. 中which引导非限制性定语从句；The activity is highly thought of, because not only does it provide chance for us to exercise, but also makes us more cohesive.中使用了部分倒装。
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【重庆康德2024年高三第二次联合诊断检测】
近期你校拟开展“劳动教育周”活动，学生们有不同意见，请就这一话题给校报英文版写一篇报道，内容要求：1.学生们的不同看法；2.你的意见。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
A Debate on Labour Education Week
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
A Debate on Labour Education Week
These days will witness an activity, the Labor Education Week, in our school, which has aroused a heated debate among students. Opinions vary from person to person.
Some believe that labor education can promote practical ability and enhance teamwork spirit. Others, however, argue that it will occupy their study time and affect their academic results.Generally speaking, the supporters emphasize the diverse range of labor value, while the opponents worry about its potential risks.
As for me, not only is labor education a skill learning, it also plays an important part in personality shaping, which is worth a try.
【重庆市主城区2024届高三下学期第二次学业质量抽测】
上周你校举行了主题为“Reading and Sharing”读书分享活动。请你为校英语报写一篇报道，内容包括：1.活动目的；2.活动过程；3.活动反响。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Reading and Sharing
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Reading and Sharing
Last Friday afternoon witnessed an activity themed with Reading and Sharing in the lecture hall, with the purpose of promoting cultural inheritance and inspiring students' passion for reading.
The event began with an brief introduction by the host, followed by students’ sharing of their reading experience with a great variety of books, ranging from science fiction and literary classics to biographies. They had a free talk about their understanding and reflection of what they read,having a good taste of the joy brought by reading.
The reading and sharing exploded in popularity among teachers and students, immersing them in it and giving them an impressive cultural feast.
【2024年高考新课标卷终极押题卷】
上周末你校举办了“急救知识进校园”的活动。请你为校英文报写一篇报道，内容包括：1.活动的过程；2.活动的影响。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
First Aid Knowledge Hits the Campus
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
First Aid Knowledge Hits the Campus
Last weekend witnessed an activity with the theme of "First Aid knowledge Hits the Campus", which brought a feast of first aid knowledge to students.
Our school invited experienced emergency doctors and nurses, who taught the students how to do first aid through vivid explanations as well as demonstrations. What followed was the first aid practice under the patient guidance of the professionals. A student selected from each class were given an opportunity to perform first aid exercises to guarantee their mastery of the basic skills.
By learning through practice, not only has this activity improved the students' first aid awareness, it has also equipped them with the knowledge to handle minor injuries and understand when to seek help.

专题08 应用文之求助信
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2020
2020全国III卷
提纲式
请求外教对于the Steamboat改编短剧的支持
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
求助信是一种写给朋友或机构的正式信件，请求他们提供帮助、支持或资金，以实现某个目标或完成某项任务。通常，求助信会详细说明请求帮助的原因、需要的具体支持以及如何使用这些支持。
【写作方法】
求助信是当个人遇到一些自己无法解决的问题或困难时向别人请求帮助的一种书信。通常包括三部分内容:
1.表明写信目的，请求帮助。
2.要清晰陈述请求帮助的具体内容。
3.希望得到帮助。注意语气委婉、真诚，并要向收信人表示感谢。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
1、首段常用语
① Hearing you have much experience in ... , I am writing to ask you for help.
听说您在......方面很有经验，在此我写信向您求助。
② I have some difficulty in doing ..., which bothers me a lot. So I have no choice but to turn to you for help.
我在做......方面有困难，这很困扰我。所以我别无选择只能向您求助。 
2、主体部分常用语
① I am encountering three problems which trouble me a lot. To begin with ... What's more ... What troubles me most is ... 我遇到的三个问题很困扰我。首先 ...... 另外 ...... 最困扰我的是 ......
② Unfortunately, I find it quite difficult to do ...  不幸的是，我觉得做 ...... 很困难。
3、结尾常用语
① Faced with the above problems, I am anxious to get your help. Would you please offer me some advice on ... ?
面对以上问题，我渴望得到您的帮助。您能给予一些关于....... 的建议吗？
② I wonder if you can help me with these difficulties. I really appreciate it if you could help me.
我想知道您能不能帮我解决这些困难。如果您能帮我，我真的感激不尽。
【写作模板】
Dear _____________，
      I am Li Hua, a student from ×××school. (正式一些的求助信需要进行自我介绍) / How are you doing these days? (求助熟悉的人需要寒暄问候一下) I’m writing to you in the hope of seeking for help. (说明写信目的) / I wonder whether I could ask you to do me a favor. (正式一点的求助）
      Faced with so many problems, I have to turn to you for help. First, I have trouble in ________遇到的困难1_________. What’s more, _____遇到的困难2______ is also very difficult for me to do. (中间段具体说明困难) Would you like to introduce to me some good ways to_________so that I can ________more easily? I do believe you can help me solve these puzzles.
       I would be greatly grateful to you if you could lend me a helping hand. I am looking forward to receiving your earliest reply.（表达谢意，期待来信）
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2020全国III卷】
假定你是 李华，你和同学根据英语课文改编了一个短剧。给外教Miss Evans写封邮件，请她帮忙指导。邮件内容包括:
1. 剧情简介；
2. 指导内容；
3. 商定时间地点。
注意:
1. 词数100左右;
2. 结束语已为你写好。
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Dear Miss Evans,
How is everything going! I am writing in sincerity to ask you a favor regarding a play we adapted according to the textbook. 
We’d like to combine your culture with ours by adapting the classic novel The Steamboat for a short English play. The play is set on a big storm after midnight, on the raft down the river navigation, we see a steamboat that is going to sink. We saved a scared boy. However, the adaption is quite a challenge. Having written the English script, we don’t want anything inappropriate to spoil the play. So would you please spare some time to review the draft script attached to this email and make necessary changes? If it is convenient, may I pay you a visit at your office next Tuesday to give you more details?
Given your busy schedule, I’d be very appreciative if you offer to give some professional advice. Look forward to your early reply. Best regards!
Yours truly,
Li Hua
【分析】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一封邮件，请求外教 Miss Evans对于the Steamboat改编短剧的支持。
【详解】
第一步：审题
体裁：应用文
时态：根据提示，时态应为一般现在时，一般过去时和一般将来时。
结构：总分总法
第一段说明写这封邮件的目的；第二段详细说明英语戏剧的剧情介绍和指导内容细节问题；第三段表达感谢，并期待早日得到回复。 
第二步:列提纲 （重点词组）
write to；according to ；combine ； adaption ；challenge；attached to ；convenient
第三步：连词成句
根据提示及关键词（组）进行遣词造句，注意主谓一致和时态问题。
第四步：连句成篇（衔接词）
连句成文，注意使用恰当的连词进行句子之间的衔接与过渡，书写一定要规范清晰。
第五步：润色修改
【点睛】范文内容完整，要点全面，语言规范，语篇连贯，词数适当，上下文意思连贯，符合逻辑关系。作者在范文中使用了较多主从复合句，如：If it is convenient, may I pay you a visit at your office next Tuesday to give you more details? 这句话运用了if引导的条件状语从句。全文中没有中国式英语的句式，显示了很高的驾驭英语的能力。另外，文章思路清晰、层次分明，上下句转换自然，为文章增色添彩。
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【广州市2024年第二次模拟考试】
你校英文报将增设主题为“讲好中国故事”的栏目。你是栏目负责人李华，请给外教Kate写邮件咨询她对栏目的建议。内容包括：1.介绍设想；2.咨询建议。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Dear Kate,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Kate,
I am Li Hua, the person in charge of the school English newspaper’s new column “Sharing Chinese Stories”. I am writing to seek your advice on this column.
The column will share China's history, culture, science and technology, education and other topics in the form of short stories, to make China voice better heard. How do you think we can better tell Chinese stories to our exchange students? Plus we find ourselves in a dilemma on how to attract more readers.We are also wondering if there is any better way to improve the quality and impact of our program.
We would appreciate it if you could give us some advice of value. Your favorable reply will be highly expected. 
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【浙江省精诚联盟2023-2024学年高二上学期返校考英语试题】
假定你是校英语戏剧社社长李华，在排练课本剧《百万英镑》The Million Pound Note中At The Tailor’s这一幕时遇到一些困难，希望得到同样酷爱戏剧表演的外教Betty老师的指导。你发邮件邀请她来排练现场，并请求她的帮助。内容包括：1.发出诚挚邀请：2.说明排练难处：3.请求现场指导。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Betty,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Betty,
I'm Li Hua, president of the English Drama Club. It is really a headache for us to rehearse the scene, At The Tailor's from the textbook play The Million Pound Note. Given that you are an enthusiast in dramatic performances, we would like you to give us your expert guidance.
First and foremost, the adaptation of this scene and the lines baffles us a lot, because the students have limited vocabulary and cannot devote too much time to the rehearsal. I wonder if you could help us to adapt the lines together? What also concerns us is how to combine the lines with the players’ body language, making the play accurate in expression and vivid in performance.
Your presence and guidance are highly expected. Looking forward to your reply. 
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【天台中学2023年秋季学期高一年级】
假定你是李华，你校要举办英文短剧展演，你们小组改编了一个关于友情的英文短剧，准备参赛。请你给你的外教Harry写一封邮件，请他帮忙指导，内容包括：1.剧情简介；2.指导内容；3.指导时间和地点。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Harry,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Harry,
I'm Li Hua from Class 1, Senior 1. An English short play show organized by the school is scheduled to be held. My group chose friendship as the theme and adapted the play. I am writing to ask for your help in providing us with some professional guidance.
Our play is mainly about two students who have a disagreement over academic problems. Neither of them, however, can let go of the friendship. They apologize to each other and make up eventually. Despite the simple story, it is really a headache for us to express ourselves with body language. Every day at 4 p.m. will witness our rehearsal in Room 101 on the first floor of the Art Building. Your guidance is highly expected.
Looking forward to your favorable reply. 
Yours,
Li Hua

专题09 应用文之申请信
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2019
2019高考英语全国 I 卷
提纲式
申请在当地美术馆剧版中国画展中做志愿者
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
申请信种类较多，如求职申请、加人某组织或活动的申请、报考申请、留学申请等，其目的在于让对方了解自己的经验、能力、成就以及愿望等，所以个人情况介绍应该是申请信的核心内容，应尽可能向对方说明本人的长处，以便留下好印象，获得面谈的机会。
【写作方法】
由于此类题目常有较多的文字提示，写作时除了应注意格式上的要求，还应注意审题全面，不能遗漏要点，并要注意人称和时态的变化，避免出现逻辑混乱，可以遵循“三段法”来写作。
第一段，简要说明信息来源，并陈述自己能胜任；
第二段，突出自己的特点，具体说明能胜任的原因；
请求尽快答复并给予机会。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
1、首段常用语
① I am  ... , a Chinese student who ... I'm more than delighted to learn that ...
我是...... ， 一名 ...... 的中国学生。得知 ......， 我非常高兴。
② I would like to do some voluntary work for the exhibition, so I'm writing to apply for the position as a volunteer.  我想为展览做一些志愿工作，所以写信申请志愿者的职位。
2、主体部分常用语
① To begin with, I have a good command of English and I am familiar with ... 首先，我精通英语并且熟悉...... 
② I have a good knowledge of English, enabling me to communicate with others well.  
我精通英语，这使我能够很好地与他人交流。
③ I am easy-going and have strong team spirit, which helps me to get along well with others. 
我性格随和，有很强的团队精神，这有助于我与他人友好相处。 
3、结尾常用语
Given the precious chance, I hold the firm belief that I can perfectly live up to your expectations. 
如果能够得到这个宝贵的机会，我坚信我可以完美地达到您的期望。
【写作模板】
Dear Sir or Madam,
I write this letter to apply for the position that you have advertised in________________________(报纸/网站名称) of________________________(广告发布时间).
Not only do I have the qualifications for this job, but also I have the right personality for a ______________ (工作名称). On one hand, _____________________(第一个原因). On the other hand, ______________________(另一个原因).
Should you grant me a personal interview, I would be most grateful. If you need to know more about me，please feel free to contact me at any time at________________________(电话号码).
Thank you for considering my application, and I am looking forward to meeting you.
Yours Sincerely, 
Li Hua
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2019高考英语全国I卷】
假定你是李华，暑假在伦敦学习，得知当地美术馆要举办中国画展览。请写一封信申请做志愿者，内容包括：
1. 写信目的；
2. 个人优势；
3. 能做的事情。
注意：1. 词数100左右；
2. 可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯；
3. 结束语已为你写好。
Dear Allen,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Dear Sir，
①I am Li Hua, a student from China, who is studying in London during the summer holiday. ②Knowing an exhibition of Chinese painting will be held at the gallery next month, I am writing to apply for the chance to become a volunteer.
I have the following advantages. ③First of all, I speak English fluently, which allows me to communicate with visitors without difficulty. Second, as a Chinese painting lover, I know a lot about this art form. If accepted, I can introduce Chinese painting skills to visitors, which can help them know more about Chinese culture.
I think I am qualified to be a volunteer. Please give me a chance.
Yours,
Li Hua
【写作思路】试题要求考生给中国画展览的组织者写一封申请信，申请做一名志愿者。本篇书面表达可用三段写作：第一段是导语段，包括自我介绍、写信背景和写信目的；第二段是主体段，主要陈述自己具备的优势和自己能做的事情；最后一段是结尾段，表示希望申请被批准。
【一句多译】
①My name is Li Hua, and I am a Chinese student studying in London during the summer holiday.
②表达方式一：I know that there will be an exhibition of Chinese painting at the gallery next month, so I am writing to apply to become a volunteer.
表达方式二：I know that the gallery will host an exhibition of Chinese painting,so I am writing to recommend myself as a volunteer.
③First, I am so good at English that I can communicate with native speakers without difficulty.
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【浙江省杭州市四校联考2023-2024学年高一上学期10月月考】
假如你是李华，你校的英语阅读社团（English Reading Club）正在招募新成员，你非常渴望加入，请你用英语写一封申请信，内容包括：1.自我介绍；2.喜欢阅读的书籍类型；3、加入英语阅读社团的原因。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Dear Sir or Madam,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Sir or Madam,
I'm Li Hua, a freshman in our school. Learning that the English Reading Club is recruiting new members, I am writing to apply to be one of them.
As an outgoing and sociable boy, I am a reading enthusiast. I read a wealth of books, among which western literary works are my favorite. (The spellbinding classics give me a deep insight into foreign history and culture, broaden my horizons, and bring me extraordinary enjoyment and endless thinking as well.) The English Reading Club, therefore, becomes what I’m eager to join. For one thing, challenging to read books in the original will definitely improve my English level. For another, I can make more like-minded friends.
I would appreciate it if you could consider my application. Looking forward to your early reply. 
Li Hua
【广东省揭阳市揭东区2023-2024学年高三上学期期中考试】
假设你是李华。你校的新外教Mr. Johnson刚到校就职。想找一名学生助手协助他在中国的工作与生活。据此，请你写一封邮件，内容包括：1.写信目的；2.你的个人优势；3.表达期待。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Mr. Johnson,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Mr. Johnson,
I am Li Hua, a student of Class 1, Senior 3. Learning that you need a student to help you with your work and life in China, I am writing to apply to be your assistant.
In contrast to other students, I have clear significant advantages. On one hand, my proficiency in English makes it easier for me to communicate with you. On the other hand, it has brought me a wealth of experience to get myself involved in various English speech competitions and voluntary work for receiving foreign guests in our school. Equally important is that I am no stranger to the transportation here, so that I can take you to have a good view of the local cultural landscape and taste the specialty food on weekends.
I would appreciate it if you could give priority to my application. Looking forward to your favorable reply. 
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【2024届高三年级三模适应性检测】
假设你是李华，听闻《中国日报》（China Daily）为了宣传中国传统文化，正在招募志愿者向海外介绍中国著名历史文化景点，你很想参加本次宣传活动，请你就此事给报社写一封英文申请信，内容包括：1.写信目的；2.自荐理由；3.申请参与。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Sir/Madam,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Sir/Madam,
I am Li Hua, a passionate advocate for Chinese traditional culture. Learning that you are recruiting volunteers to introduce China's renowned historical and cultural senic spots to the world, I am eager to apply for the position.
For one thing, my proficiency in English makes it easier for me to communicate with foreigners and share Chinese stories with them to make China voice better heard. For another, I always serve as the volunteer in the school exchange program, and take the exchange students to visit the attractions with the weight of history, which has gained me a wealth of experience. I am highly confident that I am the very person you are seeking after to promote Chinese culture.
I would appreciate it if you could give priority to my application. Looking forward to your favorable reply. 
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua

专题10 应用文之通知
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2018
2018年全国Ⅱ卷
提纲式
通知大家观看一部英语短片Growing Together
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
通知可分为口头通知和书面通知。口头通知所使用的语言具有明显的口语特征，通俗易懂。在做口头通知时，称呼可以为ladies and gentlemen（较正式）；everyone（非正式）或boys and girls（学生）来表示，要先将听众的注意力吸引过来，而后再做通知。
【写作方法】
通知有两种：书面通知和口头通知（审好题！！！看考察什么，书面通知用书面化语言，口头通知用口语化语言）一般都考书面通知！
Step 1 开门见山：写作目的＋点明事件
Step 2 写作要点：时间 地点 参与者 活动内容
Step 3 参与要求/注意事项/呼吁参加
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
1.文娱活动场所
canteen餐厅 school dining hall学校食堂 dormitory宿舍 laboratory/lab实验室
campus校园 classroom教室 teaching building教学楼 teachers' office 教师办公室 library图书馆 lecture theatre阶梯教室comfortable playground舒适的操场 
2.文娱活动名称
举办汉服节 hold the Hanfu Festival 
举办一个音乐节 hold a music festival
印章雕比赛 seal engraving competition
刺绣展 embroidery exhibition      
书法比赛 calligraphy competition
举办一个演唱会 hold a concert
参观手工艺术展visit a handicraft exhibition  
举办一个惊喜晚会throw a surprise party
举办一个校园文化秀hold a school’s Camp Culture Show 
演讲比赛an English Speech Contest
话剧比赛an English Short Play Competition
朗诵比赛an English Recitation Competition
合唱比赛a Singing Competition 
小说比赛a Fiction Writing Contest
加入英语俱乐部join an English club
垃圾分类海报设计比赛Garbage Classification Poster Design Competition
3.文娱活动目的
为了做某事：
To do.…/In order to do..
For the purpose of doing..
With the aim of doing...
提高我们的...意识raise our awareness of....
激发我们对…的兴趣fuel our passion for ....
加深我们对…的理解deepen our understanding of....
为了提高大家学习英语的兴趣to arouse our interest in learning English
为了鼓励大家的艺术创造力to stimulate/ encourage our students’ artistic creativity
为了激发大家（做…）的热情to arouse our students’ passion for .../ to kindle our students ‘enthusiasm for...
了解中国传统文化have an insight into the unique traditional Chinese culture
缓解压力relieve stress
焕新身体和思维refresh our body and mind
拓宽我的知识面以及丰富的课外生活expand my scope of knowledge and enrich my extra-curricular experiences
提高我们的创造力和动手能力promote our creativity and hands-on ability
提高人们对保护...的意识raise people’s awareness of protecting...
4.文娱活动要求
在给定的时间内完成演讲 complete the speech within given time
表演一个短话剧  perform a short play
准备一个五分钟之类的经典诗歌prepare an English classic to recite within 5 minutes
上演各种各样的表演节目put on a wide variety of performances
可以以个人或团体的名义上交Submissions can be made as an individual or as a team
以个人或小组的形式参加participate in the competition as an individual or in a team
在截止日期之前报名sign up by the deadline
准时参加attend it on time.
①遵守纪律型：
请保持安静，不要乱丢垃圾，不要提前离开。
Please keep quiet, don't throw litter away and don't leave in advance.
②积极参与型
请认真思考，举手回答问题，踊跃参加活动。
Please think carefully, raise your hand to answer the questions, and participate actively.
5.文娱活动意义
引起那些渴望感受多样中国文化人群的共鸣strike a chord with those who crave to experience diverse Chinese culture
丰富了我对传统艺术的理解enrich my understanding of traditional art
沉浸在自然的魅力中immerse oneself in the charm of nature
让我们从繁重的作业中放松give us relaxation from heavy schoolwork
让我对伟大而又辉煌的中国文化感到自豪make me feel proud of our great and glorious Chinese culture
增加我们的知识并理清一些文化困惑accumulate our knowledge and clear some cultural confusion
充分发挥我们的主动性、积极性和创造性give full play to our initiative, enthusiasm and creativity
增进友谊、锻炼身体enhance/promote our friendship and build up our bodies
增强毅力、增进友谊strengthen our perseverance and enhance our friendship
领略当地独特的自然风景appreciate the unique natural scenery
品尝到到当地的美食savor local delicacies
交到志同道合的朋友make many friends with common interests ( that share common interests) / form a circle of friends with similar hobbies / meet many like-minded friends.
【写作模板】
NOTICE
       To enrich our school life and arouse students’ enthusiasm for ______(活动主旨) , ______(活动)is going to be held at ______(活动地点) on ______(活动时间).
    Contestants are required to ______(活动要求). All entries must be submitted to ______(报名地点) by ______(截止时间) . All the ______(参赛内容) will be graded carefully by our foreign teachers. Winners of the contest will be awarded with ______(颁发奖品).
     Those who show their keen interests in the activity will be highly appreciated. Keenly anticipate your participation.
Student Union
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2018年全国Ⅱ卷】
你受学生会委托为校宣传栏“英语天地”写一则通知，请大家观看一部英语短片Growing Together，内容包括：
(1)短片内容：学校的发展；
(2)放映时间、地点；
(3)欢迎对短片提出意见。
注意：
(1)词数100左右；
(2)可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Boys and girls,
May I have your attention, please? Recently, an outstanding movie will be shown in our campus. Welcome to join us end enjoy it! Here are some relevant details about it.
To begin with, the name of the movie is Growing together, which is about the development of our beloved school; as a result, it will be not only meaningful but also interesting. Besides, it will be in the library from 2:00 to 4:00 in the afternoon on June 9th . What’s more, everyone of you will be welcome to take part in it, enjoying the movie, having a heated discussion afterwards and giving your own comments.    
Hopefully, you would make it to our activity. I have the confidence that you will have a great time.
The Student Union
【写作点拨】
英语书面通知的时态应该以一般将来时为主，多使用被动语态、简单句。在通知中不应当过度的使用较复杂的词语和读起来拗口的句子。
第二个注意点：层次一定要清晰，一个层次要表达一件事情，使人看起来一目了然。
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【浙江强基联盟2024年5月高三全国“优创名校”联考】
6月5日是世界环境日(World Environment Day)，届时你校将组织观看UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration倡议的宣传片。请你写一则通知，刊登在校英语报上，内容包括：1.观看时间和地点；2.观看意义；3.观看要求。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Notice about Watching a Promotion Video
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Notice about Watching a Promotion Video
With World Environment Day on the way, our school will organize a viewing of a promotion video——“UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration” at 2 p.m. on June 5 in the Academic Lecture Hall. The event aims to raise our awareness of the importance of environmental protection and encourage everyone to participate in the restoration and protection of ecosystem.
Watching the video will not only give us a deeper insight into global environmental issues, but also stimulate our sense of responsibility and mission to protect our planet. Please take your seat 10 minutes early and keep quiet during the viewing. Each and every one of you is also expected to take active actions in daily life and contribute your share to building a "beautiful China".
Looking forward to your active participation!
【黑龙江省大庆中学2023--2024学年度高二年级下学期月考】
为弘扬中国传统文化，你校学生会将举办一场以“经典咏流传（Everlasting Classics）”为主题的论语诵读大赛（Recitation Contest for the Analects of Confucius），假如你是校学生会主席李华，邀请全校师生前来观看。请你根据提示写一则通知，内容包括：1.大赛目的；2.大赛时间、地点；3. 大赛内容。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
NOTICE
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The Students' Union
【答案】
NOTICE
The Students' Union will hold a Recitation Contest for the Analects of Confucius with the theme of Everlasting Classics in order to inherit and promote the excellent traditional Chinese culture through the Confucian classic, and promote cultural exchanges between teachers and students of our school. Both teachers and students are highly expected to admire the contestants’ superb performances, feel the charm of classics together, and witness the excellent readers.
As scheduled, the contest falls at 8 a.m. next Saturday in the school lecture hall, running for half a day. An article from the Analects of Confucius will be chosen to read and different views on the classic will be shared.
All teachers and students are welcome to watch and witness the cultural feast together. Looking forward to your active participation! 
The Students' Union
【绍兴市2024届高三二模】
假定你是某国际学校学生会主席李华，本学期你校将为外籍学生开设一系列以中国传统文化为主题的研讨活动（workshop）, 请你写一则通知，内容包括：1.介绍活动；2.阐明理由；3.邀请参加。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Notice
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
The Students' Union
【答案】
Notice
Every Saturday afternoon will witness a series of workshops focusing on traditional Chinese culture. The workshops, which are accessible to all international students, cover various topics with Chinese characteristics, ranging from calligraphy and tea art to paper cutting. An opportunity of exposure to these typical events is provided, with the guidance of proficient and experienced teachers. Through these activities,we believe, not only can you feel the charm of traditional Chinese culture, you can also broaden your horizons and have a deeper insight into different cultures.
Opportunity never knocks twice. Your active participation is highly expected. Let us come together to explore the profound Chinese culture and enjoy the wonderful time! 
The Students' Union

专题11 应用文之感谢信
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2019
2019年浙江卷第二次高考
提纲式
感谢Alex的帮助
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
感谢信是对收信人的某一行为表示感谢的信件。在受到别人的邀请，表扬或帮助后，被邀请者、被表扬者或被帮助者往往需写一封感谢信。
【写作方法】
感谢信的写作，可以分以下三段进行：
第一段， 简述写信的目的，诚挚地表达谢意；
第二段， 表明感谢的原因，回顾对方所做的具体事情；
第三段， 再次向对方表示感谢并表达希望回报对方的愿望。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
首段：表达真挚谢意
1. Thank you so much for your generous help.非常感谢您慷慨的帮助。
2.1 am sincerely grateful to you for your timely help.我真诚地感谢你及时的帮助。
3.1t was so kind of you to treat me as your own sister.谢谢你把我当作自己的妹妹。
4.1 am so grateful to you for what you have done for me.我很感谢你为我所做的一切。
5.1 would like to convey my thanks to you for your kind help.我想感谢你的帮助。
6. I’m writing to thank you for the few wonderful days in London.我写信感谢你帮我在伦敦度过的快乐日子。
7.1 am writing to express/show/convey my sincere thanks to you for your help.我写信真诚地感谢你的帮助。
8. For this reason, I am writing this letter to express my sincere thanks to you.为此，我写这封信是为了表达我对你真诚的感谢。
中间段：解释感谢的原因或对方的帮助给自己带来的好处
1.Thanks to your help, I have made rapid progress in my English.多亏了你的帮助，我的英语有了飞速的进步。
2. Without/But for your help(If it were not for your help) ,I would not have made so much progress in my English. 
要是没有你的帮助，我的英语不会取得如此大的进步。
3.1 extend you again a thousand thanks for the great favor.我太感谢你的帮助了。
结尾段：再次感谢
1.Thanks again for helping me.再次感谢你对我的帮助。
2.Thank you again for your generous help.再次感谢你的慷慨帮助。
3. 1 would appreciate it if you could accept my sincere thanks.如果你能接受我诚挚的感谢，我将不胜感激。
4. Your kindness and help will always be remembered.我将永远铭记你的善意和帮助。
5.1 deeply/greatly appreciate your hospitality（款待）．我深深感谢你们的盛情款待。
【写作模板】
Dear __×××__ ,
      How is everything going?（用于比较熟悉的人之间简单打招呼）/ I'm Li Hua, a student from ××× Middle School.（用于正式的感谢信中自我介绍） 
I am writing to extend/express/show my sincere/heartfelt gratitude for ______(开头说明感谢对方的原因).
      But for your assistance in ______(对方给予的具体帮助), I would not have ______(运用虚拟语气句式表达没有对方帮助时会产生的后果).
    You have given me so much help that I will never forget. Last month, ______(回忆感谢对方做出的细节1-2点).
      Again, I would like to express my warm thanks to you! Please accept my gratitude. （结尾再次表达感谢之意）/ Wish you have a healthy body and lead a happy life! （也可以表达自己对另一方的祝福）/ If there is a chance, welcome to China, I am looking forward to your coming. / I am looking forward to meeting you one day to express my heartfelt thanks for your generous help face to face.（还可以邀请对方来中国参观）
                                                    Yours sincerely,
                                                            Li Ming
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2019年浙江卷第二次高考】
假定你是李华，经常帮助你学习英语的朋友Alex即将返回自己的国家。请给他写一封邮件，内容包括：
1. 表示感谢；
2. 回顾Alex对你的帮助；
3. 临别祝愿。
注意：
1. 词数80左右；
2. 可适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【河北省保定部分高中2023-2024学年高一下学期3月月考】
假定你是李华，你在刚刚结束的校英语作文比赛中荣获一等奖。请给帮助你的外教George写一封邮件，内容包括：1.告知比赛结果；2.回顾他的帮助；3.表达感谢。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Dear George,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
【2024届湖南省雅礼中学高三月考】
假如你是李华，你在口语课上回答错误，引得全班哄堂大笑。外教Julia及时救场，你想写封信表达你的感谢。内容包括：1.当时的情况；2.外教的做法；3.你的感受。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Julia,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
【宁波市2023学年第一学期期末九校联考】
假定你是李华，最近你因在学业上遇到了困难而十分沮丧，你的英国朋友Edward推荐你读一些科学家的励志故事。阅读之后，你收获颇丰，打算写一封信给他，内容包括：1.表示感谢；2.分享收获。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Edward,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Li Hua

专题12 应用文之推荐信
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2024
2024浙江1月卷
提纲式
推荐一项适合课间开展的运动
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
推荐信是写给单位、学校等介绍或说明应聘或求学人员情况的信件，其格式比较正规，用语也很正式。推荐信一般包括以下内容：应聘者的姓名、个人素质、工作态度和学习成绩；与推荐人之间的关系等。
【写作方法】
推荐信的写作，可以分以下三段进行：
第一步，自我介绍并说明推荐的人物，说明写信的目的;
第二步，介绍被推荐者，说明推荐理由；
第三步，表示谢意，期待对方回复。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
首段交代写信背景，开门见山表明写信目的：
1.Our school will celebrate its 100th birthday this July./Our school’s approaching 100th birthday will be celebrated this July. Could you please recommend a student to address at the opening ceremony in English?
2.Hearing/Learning that you are coming to visit China, I would like to recommend several place interest to you.
3.I’m delighted to learn that you are going to visit Beijing, and I would like to offer my recommendation.
4.Delighted to know that you are going to learn English, I consider it a wise choice to visit 
5.It affords me much pleasure to recommend John to you. 
主体部分：紧扣要点，推荐条件写2--3个，适当增加细节：
A.Initially, motivated and devoted to serving others, the speaker is supposed to hold a positive attitude towards life and enjoy a good fame or high popularity among students.
B.Additionally/Aside from it, not only can he have excellent performance in all school subjects, but also is furnished with extraordinary ability of spoken and written English.
C.Plus, I would be even better if the speaker is involved in relevant experience of public speaking. 
6.I recommend it mainly for the following two reasons.
7.One reason why I recommend it/sb. is that ...

9.Li Ming, a graduate from Peking University, majors in computer software design. 
尾段写作：紧扣要点---表示感谢；增加细节---期待回信。

11.If you need further information, don’t hesitate to contact me. Looking forward to your early/prompt reply.

【写作模板】

①It is my great pleasure to recommend  ______（要推荐的人）to you.②During his/her graduate years he/she was my ______ . ③As his/her ______ I found him/her ______(介绍与此人的关系)。
④His/Her performance in the school years was outstanding. ⑤First, he/she had been and showed great talents in ______ . ⑥In addition, he/she has a very pleasant personality. ⑦He has developed a strong sense of ______, and working with him/her is always_______. ⑧I can state that he/she has all the qualities of being ______.（介绍此人的能力）
⑨Therefore, I here recommend him/her to you with all my heart. ⑩Should you favor him/her with a position in your company/Should you accept him/her in your university？I am sure that his/her future conduct/academic work will prove worthy of your confidence. I look forward to hearing from you at the earliest possible moment.

                                                        Li Hua

专题12 应用文之推荐信
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2024
2024浙江1月卷
提纲式
推荐一项适合课间开展的运动
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
推荐信是写给单位、学校等介绍或说明应聘或求学人员情况的信件，其格式比较正规，用语也很正式。推荐信一般包括以下内容：应聘者的姓名、个人素质、工作态度和学习成绩；与推荐人之间的关系等。
【写作方法】
推荐信的写作，可以分以下三段进行：
第一步，自我介绍并说明推荐的人物，说明写信的目的;
第二步，介绍被推荐者，说明推荐理由；
第三步，表示谢意，期待对方回复。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
首段交代写信背景，开门见山表明写信目的：
1.Our school will celebrate its 100th birthday this July./Our school’s approaching 100th birthday will be celebrated this July. Could you please recommend a student to address at the opening ceremony in English?
2.Hearing/Learning that you are coming to visit China, I would like to recommend several place interest to you.
3.I’m delighted to learn that you are going to visit Beijing, and I would like to offer my recommendation.
4.Delighted to know that you are going to learn English, I consider it a wise choice to visit 
5.It affords me much pleasure to recommend John to you. 
主体部分：紧扣要点，推荐条件写2--3个，适当增加细节：
A.Initially, motivated and devoted to serving others, the speaker is supposed to hold a positive attitude towards life and enjoy a good fame or high popularity among students.
B.Additionally/Aside from it, not only can he have excellent performance in all school subjects, but also is furnished with extraordinary ability of spoken and written English.
C.Plus, I would be even better if the speaker is involved in relevant experience of public speaking. 
6.I recommend it mainly for the following two reasons.
7.One reason why I recommend it/sb. is that ...
8.He is an all-round students with excellent grades in all subjects; As a boy with great potential, he is good/skillful at solving difficult problems.
9.Li Ming, a graduate from Peking University, majors in computer software design. 
尾段写作：紧扣要点---表示感谢；增加细节---期待回信。
10.I would appreciate it very much if you could do me the favor. Your early/prompt reply is highly expected.
11.If you need further information, don’t hesitate to contact me. Looking forward to your early/prompt reply.
12.Your taking my recommendation into consideration will be highly appreciated/expected.
13.I do hope that you can find my recommendation beneficial. Looking forward to your early/prompt reply.
【写作模板】
Dear ______ , 
①It is my great pleasure to recommend  ______（要推荐的人）to you.②During his/her graduate years he/she was my ______ . ③As his/her ______ I found him/her ______(介绍与此人的关系)。
④His/Her performance in the school years was outstanding. ⑤First, he/she had been and showed great talents in ______ . ⑥In addition, he/she has a very pleasant personality. ⑦He has developed a strong sense of ______, and working with him/her is always_______. ⑧I can state that he/she has all the qualities of being ______.（介绍此人的能力）
⑨Therefore, I here recommend him/her to you with all my heart. ⑩Should you favor him/her with a position in your company/Should you accept him/her in your university？I am sure that his/her future conduct/academic work will prove worthy of your confidence. I look forward to hearing from you at the earliest possible moment.
Yours sincerely,
                                                        Li Hua
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2024浙江1月卷】
请你写一篇短文向校英文报“Sports and Health”栏目投稿，向同学们推荐一项适合课间开展的运动，内容包括：
1. 介绍这项运动；
2. 说明推荐理由。
注意： 
1. 写作词数应为80个左右；
2. 请按如下格式在答题卡的相应位置作答：
Stand Up and Exercise, Everybody!
____________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
【答案】
Stand Up and Exercise, Everybody!
Everybody! Are you tired of sitting in class all day? How about incorporating some physical activity into your daily routine? One great option is the “Stand Up and Stretch” exercise. This simple routine involves standing up from your desk, stretching your arms, legs and back, and taking a few deep breaths. It’s a quick and easy way to get your blood flowing and re-energize your body and mind. This exercise is recommended for several reasons.
First, it helps to combat the negative effects of prolonged sitting, such as back pain and stiffness. Second, it can improve your focus and concentration, making it easier to stay engaged in class. Lastly, it promotes a healthy and active lifestyle, which is essential for overall well-being.
So, next time you feel a bit sluggish during class, remember to stand up and stretch! It’s a small change that can make a big difference in your day.
【导语】本篇书面表达属于应用文，要求考生写一篇短文向校英文报“Sports and Health”栏目投稿，向同学们推荐一项适合课间开展的运动。
【详解】
1.词汇积累
厌倦：be tired of→be fed up with
首先：first→above all
减轻：combat→relieve
提高：improve→enhance
2.句式拓展
简单句变复合句
原句：This simple routine involves standing up from your desk, stretching your arms, legs and back, and taking a few deep breaths.
拓展句：This is a simple routine that involves standing up from your desk, stretching your arms, legs and back, and taking a few deep breaths.
【点睛】
[高分句型1] Lastly, it promotes a healthy and active lifestyle, which is essential for overall well-being. (运用了which引导的非限制性定语从句)
[高分句型2] This simple routine involves standing up from your desk, stretching your arms, legs and back, and taking a few deep breaths. (运用了动名词作宾语)
[高分句型2] It’s a small change that can make a big difference in your day. (运用了that引导的定语从句)
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【浙江省金华第一中学2024届高三上学期10月月考】
假定你是某国际学校学生会主席李华，你校将组织高三学生参观大学。学生可以从“专业及课程介绍(Major and Course Description)”、“参观图书馆、实验室(Library & Laboratory Visiting)”和“与教授面对面(Dialogue with Professors)”三个活动中选取一个作为此次参观的主要活动。请你写一封邮件给活动组织者，内容包括：(1)推荐活动；(2)推荐理由。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Dear Sir or Madam,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours Sincerely.
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Sir or Madam,
I'm Li Hua, president of the Student Union. Learning that a visit to the university for senior three students is scheduled by our school, I think Library and Laboratory Visiting is my top recommendation.
For one thing, wandering through the sea of books, the students will have an impressive view of the wide variety of university collections. Plus they can also immerse themselves in the positive and productive learning atmosphere of the university students in the library study room. For another, the laboratory will provide access to advanced research equipment at close range, and give them a deep insight into the most advanced frontier science, therefore offering valuable reference for their career planning.
I would appreciate it if my recommendation could be adopted. Best wishes! 
Yours Sincerely.
Li Hua
【天台中学2024年春季学期高一年级开学考】
假定你是李华，你的爱尔兰笔友Adam热衷于中国历史文化。他计划今年假期来华旅游，希望你给他推荐旅游城市。请你给他写一封邮件，内容包括：1.表示欢迎；2.推荐旅游城市；3.表示祝愿。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Adam,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Adam,
I hope this email finds you well! I'm more than happy to learn that you are scheduled to visit China on your holiday. Since you are a Chinese culture enthusiast, Hangzhou, the capital of Zhejiang Province, is my top recommendation.
For one thing, Hangzhou is a well-known historical and cultural city with a wealth of cultural relics and beautiful legends, such as the picturesque West Lake, which is famous for its beautiful scenery, and Lingyin Temple with a combination of religion, history, culture and natural beauty, to name just a few. For another, the subway line provides a direct access to most of the attractions in Hangzhou. Equally impressive are the special snacks, which will give you a feast for your appetite.
Looking forward to your early arrival. Have a good time! 
Yours,
Li Hua
【成都七中2023-2024学年度高三上入学考试】
假定你是李华，你的爱尔兰网友Tom下周来你市参加短期语言培训，他发来邮件请你帮忙推荐一家酒店方便学习期间入住。请给他回信，主要内容包括：1.表示欢迎；2.推荐理由；3.表达祝愿。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Tom,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
【答案】
Dear Tom,
Welcome to our city for a short-term language training next week. Since you write to ask me about a hotel, XX hotel is my top recommendation.
For one thing, XX hotel is wallet-friendly and within reach of your training site. For another, it is well equipped with free WIFI, which makes it convenient for you to study while at the hotel. Equally important is that the service is very good, and you can enjoy the city's delicious food as well.
Looking forward to your early arrival. Wish you a pleasant study and life in my city! 
Yours,
Li Hua

专题13 应用文之道歉信
*** 考情分析 ***
年份
卷别
形式
话题
2021
2021年北京卷
提纲式
因故不能赴约而致歉并建议再约
*** 写作指导 ***     
【题型分析】
道歉信的目的是向收信人表达歉意，请求对方谅解自己的某种过失。道歉信通常包括以下内容：表示歉意，道歉的原因，出现差错的原因，提出弥补措施，请求原谅。
【写作方法】
首段：陈述写信意图，对某事表示歉意。
主体段落：说明道歉的具体原因，应展开。在主体段落中，写信人应当在陈述理由时照顾读信人的感受，切忌强词夺理。
结尾段：再次表明歉意，请求收信人的谅解。还可以建议对自己的过失采取何种补救措施。
*** 素材宝库 ***     
【常用句式】
1. 道歉信中开头段常用句式和套话
I am writing this letter to express my regret…我写这封信是想表达我的遗憾……
I am writing to apologize for…我写信是为……道歉。
I would like to give you my apology for…我想……向你道歉。
I am very sorry to say that…我很抱歉……
I must apologize about (not) doing sth…对于做了/没做……，我必须道歉。
Please accept my sincere apology for…请接受我对于^的真诚道歉。
I am writing to say sorry for…我写信是想对……说抱歉。
I am terribly sorry, but…我很抱歉，但是……
2.中间段：陈述理由+补救措施
陈述理由:
理由：I should have been able to attend your lecture, but due to the fact that something urgent happened, I'll have to take the place of my mother to pick my aunt up at the airport, whose flight happens to arrive on Saturday night. And it's the first time that my aunt has returned to my hometown since she studied abroad several years ago. So I have no choice/option but to cancel the appointment with you.
我本应该参加你的讲座，但由于发生了紧急的事情，我要代替母亲到机场接我阿姨，她的航班在周六晚抵达，这是阿姨自从几年前去留学第一次回国。我别无选择只好取消和你的约会。
补救措施：
1.I want you to know how bad we feel about it and to assure you that it will happen again.我想让你知道我们有多难过，我向你保证这不会再发生了。
2.I hope that this does not cause you too much inconvenience.我希望这不会给你带来太多的不便。
3.It would be very kind( considerate)of you to give me another chance to do sth. I promise it will never happen again.你太好了，再给我一次机会做某事。我保证不会再发生这种事情。
4.If it is convenient for you, let's have another appointment to do sth.如果方便的话，我们再约去做某事。
5.Would you mind if I change the appointment time?你会介意我改变约会的时间吗?
6.By the way, can we have dinner together some time next week?顺便说一下，我们在下周的某个时间一起吃晚饭好吗?
7.ls it possible that I make up for the loss by doing sth.?可能让我做某事来弥补损失吗?
3.道歉信中结尾段常用句式和套话
Once again, I am sorry for any inconvenience caused.我对于所造成的任何不便再次道歉。
Please allow me to say sorry again.请允许我再一次说抱歉。
Hope you can accept my apologies and understand my situation.希望你们能够接受我的道歉，理解我的处境。
I sincerely hope that you will be able to think in my position and accept my apologies.我真诚的希望你能够站在我的位置想一想，并且接受我的道歉。
I want to let you know how regretful I am feeling now.我想让你知道我现在感觉多么的遗憾。
I am sorry that I can’t… but trust that you will be able to understand.很抱歉我不能……，但我相信，你会理解的。
【写作模板】
Dear ________,
I am excessively sorry to say/tell you that ①______________ (直接表达自己不能实现先前的愿望或约定). ②Now, I am writing you this letter of apology to show my deep regret__________ (表达歉意). ③Please accept my sincere apology__________(诚恳希望对方能接受道歉). ④I fear you are displeased at _________(表达出自己的心情，并请求对方原谅).⑤I hope you will understand me and excuse me for__________(过渡句). ⑥Let me explain(开始介绍道歉的原因). ⑦The reason for my delay/absence was that _________(阐述自己当时的处境和情况). ⑧I had no way out because ___________ (总结自己道歉的原因). ⑨Therefore it’s not in my power to ___________(希望下次再次实现愿望). ⑩Naturally, I want to suggest ____________. I shall be glad if you will kindly write and tell me when and where you____________(约定下次约会的时间和地点)
We may meet again and I hope to see you soon.
Sincerely Yours,                                                                                                                                                                                            Li Hua
*** 高考真题精讲 ***
【2021年北京卷】
假设你是红星中学高三学生李华。你和英国好友Jim原定本周末一起外出，你因故不能赴约。请你用英文给他写一封电子邮件，内容包括：
1.表达歉意并说明原因；
2.提出建议并给出理由。
注意：
1.词数100左右；
2.开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数。
Dear Jim,
___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
*** 名校模拟题提升练 ***
【华附、省实、广雅、深中2024届高三四校联考】
假定你是李华，你的英国朋友Jerry写信邀请你寒假期间去伦敦游玩，你因故无法前往，请你回信表达歉意，内容包括：1.谢绝的理由；2.提议暑假去拜访他。
注意：1.写作词数应为80个左右；2.请按如下格式在答题纸的相应位置作答。
Dear Jerry,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours Sincerely.
Li Hua
【衢州、丽水、湖州2023年11月三地市高三教学质量检测】
假定你是李华，你与爱尔兰交换生Philip原定本周日上午一起修改英文演讲稿，因故不能赴约。请给他写一封邮件，内容包括：1.表达歉意；2.说明原因；3.另约时间。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear Adam,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
【英语周报2023年春季学期高一】
假定你是李华，计划今年暑假去美国拜访你的笔友William，但现在因故不得不取消这一计划。请你给William写一封邮件，内容包括：1.表示歉意；2.说明原因；3.期待回复。
注意：1.写作词数应为80左右；2.请按如下形式在答题卡的相应位置作答。
Dear William,
________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________
Yours,
Li Hua
